domains.name: patient
domains.description: Master data for all individuals receiving healthcare services. SSOT for patient identity, demographics, MRN (Medical Record Number), MPI (Master Patient Index), insurance coverage, emergency contacts, consent records, SDOH (Social Determinants of Health), patient preferences, and PHI-protected identity information. Referenced by every clinical and financial domain via patient_id FK.

products.name: mpi_record
products.description: Master Patient Index (MPI) golden record — the enterprise-wide authoritative identity for every individual receiving healthcare services. Owns patient_id (SSOT), MRN-to-enterprise-ID crosswalk mappings across all facilities and EHR systems, identity resolution status, overlay/duplicate flags, merge/unmerge history with surviving and non-surviving MRNs, merge rationale, algorithm, confidence scores, approving analyst, and reversal history, cross-facility linkage keys, external HIE identifiers, and national health identifiers. Referenced by every clinical and financial domain via patient_id FK. Aligned with HL7 FHIR Patient resource, IHE PIX/PDQ profiles, and supports international patient identity standards (NHS Number, EHIC, national health IDs). Sourced from enterprise MPI tools, EHR ADT systems, and HIE platforms.
products.reference: Master Patient Index (MPI) — HL7 FHIR Patient Resource

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the MPI golden record in the enterprise lakehouse. Serves as the enterprise-wide patient_id referenced by every clinical and financial domain. Role: MASTER_PARTY (enterprise identity anchor).
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; HL7 FHIR Patient Resource R4

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: The facility identifier of the healthcare organization where this patient identity was first registered and the MPI record originated. Links to the facility master for cross-facility identity management.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; CMS Conditions of Participation; HL7 FHIR Organization

attributes.name: surviving_mpi_record_id
attributes.description: For non-surviving (merged/deprecated) MPI records, the mpi_record_id of the surviving golden record that absorbed this identity. Null for active golden records. Supports merge history traversal and MRN crosswalk resolution.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; HL7 FHIR Patient.link (type=replaced-by); AHIMA MPI Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this MPI golden record was first created in the enterprise MPI system. Serves as the authoritative record creation audit timestamp. Required for HIPAA audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; HL7 FHIR Meta; IHE PIX/PDQ; ISO 27001

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The patient's date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format. Core PHI identifier used for identity matching, age-based clinical decision support, eligibility verification, and regulatory reporting. One of the 18 HIPAA PHI identifiers.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514(b)(2); HL7 FHIR Patient.birthDate; IHE PIX/PDQ

attributes.name: date_of_death
attributes.description: The date of the patient's death in yyyy-MM-dd format. Populated when deceased_flag is True. Sourced from EHR ADT, state vital records, or Social Security Death Index. Used for mortality reporting, quality measures, and population health analytics.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient.deceasedDateTime; NCHS National Death Index; CMS Quality Reporting; HEDIS

attributes.name: deceased_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is deceased. True = patient is deceased. Used to suppress deceased patients from active care management workflows, population health outreach, and appointment scheduling.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient.deceased; CMS Conditions of Participation; NCHS Death Registration Standards

attributes.name: enterprise_patient_number
attributes.description: The enterprise-wide, human-readable unique patient identifier assigned by the MPI system. Serves as the SSOT identity key across all facilities, EHR systems, and HIE platforms. Distinct from facility-level MRNs.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; HL7 FHIR Patient.identifier; CMS Interoperability Rule

attributes.name: ethnicity_code
attributes.description: The patient's self-reported ethnicity using OMB codes (2135-2=Hispanic or Latino, 2186-5=Not Hispanic or Latino, UNK=Unknown/Not Reported). Collected per CMS health equity and USCDI requirements.
attributes.references: OMB Race and Ethnicity Standards (1997); CDC Ethnicity Codes; CMS Health Equity Framework; USCDI v3; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: first_registration_date
attributes.description: The date the patient was first registered in the enterprise MPI system. Represents the earliest known encounter with the healthcare organization. Used for longitudinal care analytics and patient tenure reporting.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient; CMS Conditions of Participation; AHIMA MPI Best Practices

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: The patient's self-reported gender identity. Collected per CMS and ONC requirements for health equity reporting and SDOH documentation. Distinct from sex at birth. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: male|female|transgender_male|transgender_female|nonbinary|genderqueer|other|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Health Equity Framework; ONC 21st Century Cures Act; HL7 FHIR Patient.extension[genderIdentity]; USCDI v3

attributes.name: hie_patient_number
attributes.description: The patient identifier assigned by the regional or national Health Information Exchange (HIE) network. Used for cross-organizational patient matching and care coordination. Supports CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule (CMS-9115-F); HL7 FHIR Patient.identifier; IHE PIX/PDQ; 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: identity_confidence_tier
attributes.description: A tiered classification of the overall identity confidence for this MPI golden record based on the number and quality of verified identity traits (e.g., government ID verified, biometric match, multi-source corroboration). 'high'=strong multi-source verification; 'low'=minimal corroboration; 'unverified'=no identity proofing completed.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63 Identity Assurance Levels; IHE PIX/PDQ; AHIMA MPI Best Practices

attributes.name: identity_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current identity resolution status of this MPI record. 'golden' = authoritative enterprise identity; 'candidate' = awaiting resolution; 'overlay' = erroneous merge detected; 'duplicate' = confirmed duplicate pending merge; 'merged' = non-surviving record post-merge; 'unmerged' = previously merged record that was separated; 'pending_review' = flagged for analyst review. Core MPI lifecycle field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: golden|candidate|overlay|duplicate|merged|unmerged|pending_review — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; HL7 FHIR Patient.link; AHIMA MPI Best Practices

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient requires a professional interpreter for clinical encounters. True = interpreter services must be arranged. Supports compliance with Section 1557 of the ACA (language access) and CMS CLAS Standards.
attributes.references: Section 1557 ACA; CMS CLAS Standards; HL7 FHIR Patient.communication.preferred; Title VI Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: is_duplicate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MPI record has been identified as a duplicate of another enterprise patient identity. True = confirmed or suspected duplicate. Used to trigger merge workflow in the MPI tool.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; AHIMA MPI Best Practices; HL7 FHIR Patient.link (type=replaced-by)

attributes.name: is_overlay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MPI record has been identified as an overlay — a patient safety event where two distinct patients' records were erroneously merged. Overlay detection is a critical patient safety and HIM compliance function. True = overlay detected.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Best Practices; The Joint Commission Patient Safety Goals; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this MPI golden record, including demographic changes, merge/unmerge events, or status changes. Used for change data capture, HIE synchronization, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Meta.lastUpdated; IHE PIX/PDQ; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the patient's identity was actively verified against a government-issued ID or biometric at a point of service. Used to assess identity confidence staleness and trigger re-verification workflows.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63; The Joint Commission Patient Identification Goals; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: The patient's legal given/first name as recorded in the MPI golden record. PHI under HIPAA. Used for identity verification and clinical documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR Patient.name.given; IHE PIX/PDQ

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: The patient's legal family/surname as recorded in the MPI golden record. Used for identity matching, clinical documentation, and regulatory reporting. PHI under HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR Patient.name.family; IHE PIX/PDQ

attributes.name: match_confidence_score
attributes.description: The probabilistic confidence score (0.0000–1.0000) produced by the identity matching algorithm indicating the likelihood that two records represent the same individual. Scores above the enterprise threshold trigger automatic merge; scores in the review band require analyst adjudication.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; AHIMA MPI Best Practices; NIST SP 800-188

attributes.name: medicaid_number
attributes.description: The state-assigned Medicaid recipient identifier for patients enrolled in Medicaid. Format varies by state. Used for Medicaid claims submission, eligibility verification, and CMS reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Program; 42 CFR §435; HIPAA 45 CFR §162; State Medicaid Agency Standards

attributes.name: medicare_beneficiary_number
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) for patients enrolled in Medicare. Replaced the Social Security Number-based Health Insurance Claim Number (HICN). Required for Medicare claims submission and CMS quality reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI) Standard; 42 CFR §424; HIPAA 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: merge_algorithm
attributes.description: The name or version of the probabilistic or deterministic matching algorithm used to identify this record as a merge candidate (e.g., 'Verato_v3.2', 'Epic_MPI_Deterministic', 'Rhapsody_Probabilistic_v2'). Supports algorithm governance and audit.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; AHIMA MPI Best Practices; NIST SP 800-188

attributes.name: merge_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason or trigger for the merge of this MPI record into a surviving golden record. Supports audit trail and quality improvement for identity resolution processes.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Best Practices; IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: merge_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MPI record was merged into a surviving golden record. Null if the record has never been merged. Part of the merge/unmerge audit trail required for HIM compliance.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Best Practices; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The patient's middle name or middle initial as recorded in the MPI golden record. Used to disambiguate patients with identical first and last names during identity resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR Patient.name.given; IHE PIX/PDQ

attributes.name: mpi_record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this MPI golden record. 'active'=current enterprise identity in use; 'inactive'=no recent activity; 'merged'=non-surviving record post-merge; 'deceased'=patient deceased; 'test'=test/training record; 'blocked'=access restricted pending review.
attributes.references: IHE PIX/PDQ Profile; HL7 FHIR Patient.active; AHIMA MPI Best Practices

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: The primary facility-level Medical Record Number (MRN) assigned to the patient at the enterprise anchor facility. Additional facility MRNs are tracked in the MRN crosswalk. Sourced from Epic EHR or Cerner Millennium ADT.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient.identifier; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: name_suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to the patient's legal name (e.g., Jr., Sr., III). Used in identity matching to reduce false-positive duplicate detection.

attributes.name: national_health_id_type
attributes.description: The type or issuing authority of the national health identifier stored in national_health_id (e.g., NHS_NUMBER=UK NHS Number, EHIC=European Health Insurance Card, MEDICARE_BENE_ID=CMS Medicare Beneficiary Identifier, MEDICAID_ID=State Medicaid ID).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient.identifier.system; IHE PIX/PDQ; CMS Medicare Beneficiary Identifier

attributes.name: national_health_number
attributes.description: National health identifier assigned by a government health authority (e.g., NHS Number for UK patients, EHIC number for EU patients, national health ID for international patients). Supports international patient identity standards and cross-border care coordination.
attributes.references: NHS Number Standard; EU EHIC Regulation; HL7 FHIR Patient.identifier; IHE PIX/PDQ

attributes.name: npi_crosswalk_count
attributes.description: The number of distinct facility-level MRN crosswalk entries linked to this MPI golden record. Indicates the breadth of the patient's care history across the enterprise. Used for MPI quality monitoring and duplicate detection analytics.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Best Practices; IHE PIX/PDQ Profile

attributes.name: patient_class
attributes.description: The primary classification of the patient based on their predominant care setting and service utilization pattern. Drives billing, regulatory reporting, and population health segmentation. Sourced from ADT systems (Epic/Cerner). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inpatient|outpatient|emergency|observation|recurring|newborn|deceased — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 v2 ADT PV1-2; HL7 FHIR Encounter.class; CMS Conditions of Participation; UB-04 FL 4

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the patient prefers to be called, which may differ from their legal name. Supports patient-centered care and CAHPS patient experience requirements.
attributes.references: CAHPS Survey Standards; HL7 FHIR Patient.name (use=nickname); CMS Patient Engagement

attributes.name: primary_language_code
attributes.description: The ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the patient's primary spoken language (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, 'zh' for Chinese). Used to trigger interpreter services, translated materials, and CLAS Standards compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1/639-2; HL7 FHIR Patient.communication; CMS CLAS Standards; Section 1557 ACA; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: race_code
attributes.description: The patient's self-reported race using OMB/CDC race category codes. Collected per CMS health equity and USCDI requirements. Used for HEDIS disparity reporting, population health stratification, and health equity analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1002-5|2028-9|2054-5|2076-8|2106-3|2131-1|UNK — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OMB Race and Ethnicity Standards (1997); CDC Race/Ethnicity Codes; CMS Health Equity Framework; USCDI v3; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: restricted_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether access to this patient's MPI record and associated PHI is restricted beyond standard role-based access controls. True = restricted access enforced. Applies to sensitive populations (e.g., behavioral health, HIV, substance abuse) per 42 CFR Part 2 and state law.
attributes.references: 42 CFR Part 2 (Substance Abuse Confidentiality); HIPAA 45 CFR §164.524; State Mental Health Privacy Laws

attributes.name: sex_at_birth
attributes.description: The patient's biological sex recorded at birth (M=Male, F=Female, X=Intersex/Other, U=Unknown). Used for clinical decision support, lab reference ranges, and CMS/HEDIS quality reporting. Distinct from gender identity.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Patient.gender; CMS Quality Reporting; NCQA HEDIS; IHE PIX/PDQ

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The originating EHR or operational system that contributed the identity record that seeded this MPI golden record (e.g., EPIC=Epic EHR, CERNER=Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH=MEDITECH Expanse, HIE=Health Information Exchange). Supports data lineage and source system reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPIC|CERNER|MEDITECH|MANUAL|HIE|SALESFORCE_HC|EXTERNAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR MessageHeader.source; IHE PIX/PDQ; HL7 v2 ADT

attributes.name: ssn_last4
attributes.description: The last four digits of the patient's Social Security Number (SSN). Stored in truncated form to support identity matching while minimizing PHI/PII exposure. Full SSN must not be stored in the silver layer per HIPAA minimum necessary standard.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; NIST SP 800-122; IRS Publication 1075

attributes.name: unmerge_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason for reversing a prior merge action on this MPI record. Supports patient safety investigation and HIM quality improvement workflows.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Best Practices; The Joint Commission; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: unmerge_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a previously merged MPI record was separated (unmerged) due to an overlay correction or erroneous merge reversal. Null if the record has never been unmerged. Critical patient safety audit field.
attributes.references: AHIMA MPI Best Practices; The Joint Commission Patient Safety Goals; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has been designated as a VIP (e.g., celebrity, executive, employee, or high-profile individual) requiring enhanced privacy protections and restricted access controls. True = VIP designation active. Triggers break-the-glass audit logging.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; The Joint Commission; AHIMA Privacy Best Practices

products.name: demographics
products.description: Core patient demographic profile — legal name, date of birth, gender identity, sex assigned at birth, race, ethnicity, preferred language, marital status, religion, addresses (home, mailing, temporary, work with geocoding and SDOH census tract linkage), phone numbers, email, emergency contacts with authorization levels and healthcare proxy designations, deceased status (date, cause, manner of death, death certificate reference), and PHI-protected identity attributes. SSOT for patient identity attributes downstream of MPI, multi-address management, and emergency contact records. Supports population health outreach, EMTALA-compliant emergency contact access, vital statistics reporting, and population health stratification. Compliant with HIPAA PHI classification, CMS demographic data requirements, and aligned with HL7 FHIR Patient resource demographics elements. Sourced from EHR registration modules, ADT systems, and state vital records.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR Patient Resource — CMS Demographic Data Standards

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the patient demographics record. Primary key for the demographics data product within the patient domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: death_cause_icd_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Death Cause Icd Code Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Death cause coding uses ICD-10 per death certificate standards (NCHS/CDC vital statistics reporting). Linking demographics to the authoritative ICD code reference enables mortality analytics, populati

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master patient record. Links demographics to the canonical patient identity in the Master Patient Index (MPI).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: advance_directive_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has an advance directive (e.g., living will, healthcare proxy, POLST) on file with the health system. Supports EMTALA-compliant emergency care and Joint Commission patient rights standards.
attributes.references: EMTALA; Joint Commission RI.01.05.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13(b); Patient Self-Determination Act

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Patient's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Core PHI element used for age calculation, eligibility verification, clinical decision support, and identity matching. Required by CMS and HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.birthDate; CMS Conditions of Participation; ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines

attributes.name: birth_time
attributes.description: Exact timestamp of the patient's birth. Clinically significant for neonatal records, multiple births, and vital statistics reporting to state health departments.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.birthDate (time extension); State Vital Statistics Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: US Census Bureau census tract code derived from the patient's home address via geocoding. Enables Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) stratification, Area Deprivation Index (ADI) linkage, and population health analytics.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line; AHRQ SDOH Data; CMS Health Equity Reporting; USCDI v3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the patient demographics record was first created in the source EHR registration system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and HIPAA access logging requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; HL7 FHIR R4 Meta.lastUpdated

attributes.name: death_certificate_number
attributes.description: State-issued death certificate reference number. Used to cross-reference vital statistics records and support legal and administrative processes following patient death.
attributes.references: State Vital Statistics Reporting Requirements; NCHS; HHS

attributes.name: death_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was pronounced deceased (yyyy-MM-dd). Required for vital statistics reporting, care plan closure, and population health mortality analytics. Sourced from Epic ADT or state vital records.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.deceasedDateTime; State Vital Statistics Reporting; CMS Conditions of Participation; ICD-10 Mortality Coding

attributes.name: deceased_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is deceased. Triggers suppression of outreach communications, updates to active care plans, and vital statistics reporting workflows.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.deceased[x]; CMS Conditions of Participation; State Vital Statistics Reporting

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Patient's primary email address for electronic communications including appointment reminders, patient portal access, and health education materials. PHI per HIPAA when combined with health information.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.telecom (system=email); CAN-SPAM Act; USCDI v3

attributes.name: enterprise_mrn
attributes.description: Cross-facility enterprise-level MRN assigned by the Master Patient Index (MPI) to uniquely identify the patient across all facilities and care sites within the health system.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.identifier; IHE PIX/PDQ Profile

attributes.name: ethnicity_code
attributes.description: Patient's self-reported ethnicity using OMB/CDC ethnicity codes. Values: 2135-2=Hispanic or Latino, 2186-5=Not Hispanic or Latino, UNK=Unknown. Required for CMS demographic reporting and health equity analytics.
attributes.references: OMB Race and Ethnicity Standards (1997); CMS Interoperability Rule; USCDI v3; NCQA HEDIS; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.extension (us-core-ethnicity)

attributes.name: gender_identity
attributes.description: Patient's self-identified gender, which may differ from sex assigned at birth. Supports inclusive care, patient experience, and CMS demographic data collection requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: male|female|transgender_male|transgender_female|nonbinary|genderqueer|other|unknown|prefer_not_to_disclose — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.extension (individual-genderIdentity); USCDI v3; CMS Interoperability Rule; Joint Commission LGBTQ+ Standards

attributes.name: home_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the patient's home residence. Used for correspondence, population health outreach, SDOH census tract linkage, and vital statistics reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.address; USPS Addressing Standards; USCDI v3

attributes.name: home_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the patient's home residence (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements home_address_line1 for complete address resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.address; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: home_city
attributes.description: City of the patient's home residence address. Used for geographic analysis, population health stratification, and service area reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.address.city; USCDI v3

attributes.name: home_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the patient's home residence (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Supports international patient management and cross-border care coordination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.address.country; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: home_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the patient's home residence. Used for geographic analysis, SDOH census tract linkage, population health outreach, and payer eligibility verification.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient.address.postalCode; USPS ZIP Code Standards; USCDI v3

attributes.name: home_state

products.name: address

attributes.name: address_type

attributes.name: area_deprivation_index

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the patient address. Used for population health outreach, care gap closure, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) stratification.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Supports international patient populations and cross-border care coordination.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name associated with the patient address. Used for SDOH stratification, public health reporting, and county-level population health analytics.

attributes.name: deductible_met_amount
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount the patient has applied toward their annual deductible. Sourced from real-time eligibility verification (X12 271) responses. Used in patient financial counseling and point-of-service collection.
attributes.references: X12 271 BEN segment; HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; CMS Transparency in Coverage Rule

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insurance coverage becomes effective and claims may be submitted. Used in eligibility verification and coordination of benefits (COB) sequencing. Aligns with X12 271 DTP*356 segment.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 DTP*356; HL7 FHIR Coverage.period.start; CMS-1500 Box 11c

attributes.name: eligibility_response_code
attributes.description: The X12 271 AAA or EB segment response code returned by the payer during eligibility verification, indicating the specific eligibility status or rejection reason (e.g., '1' = Active Coverage, 'AAA' = Rejection). Supports denial prevention and RCM analytics.
attributes.references: X12 271 EB/AAA segments; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityResponse.error; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1301

attributes.name: eligibility_transaction_number
attributes.description: The unique transaction control number (TCN) or trace number assigned to the X12 270/271 eligibility verification transaction or FHIR CoverageEligibilityRequest. Enables end-to-end audit trail and transaction reconciliation.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 BHT*0022 segment; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityRequest.identifier; HIPAA 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform the most recent eligibility verification for this coverage. Supports audit trail requirements and verification workflow analytics. EDI_270_271 = X12 batch or real-time transaction; portal = payer web portal; phone = verbal verification; real_time_API = FHIR-based real-time check.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 EDI; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityRequest R4; HIPAA 45 CFR §162.1301

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_status
attributes.description: The current status of the most recent eligibility verification transaction for this coverage record. Reflects the outcome of X12 270/271 EDI, portal, or phone-based verification. Drives front-end Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows and claim denial prevention.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 EDI; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityResponse; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_by
attributes.description: The name or system identifier of the staff member, automated process, or clearinghouse that performed the most recent eligibility verification. Supports audit trail and accountability for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 (Audit Controls); CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the most recent eligibility verification was completed. Used in the eligibility verification audit trail and to determine whether re-verification is required based on payer-specific or organizational SLA policies.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 EDI; HL7 FHIR CoverageEligibilityResponse; HIPAA 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The employer or group plan number assigned by the payer that identifies the specific group policy under which the member is covered. Required for claims submission and eligibility verification.

attributes.name: insurance_card_back_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or document reference to the scanned or photographed back of the patient's insurance card. Stored in a HIPAA-compliant document management system. Contains payer contact information and claims submission instructions.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.502; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: insurance_card_front_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or document reference to the scanned or photographed front of the patient's insurance card. Stored in a HIPAA-compliant document management system. Used for manual verification and patient registration workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR §164.502; Joint Commission RC.02.01.01

attributes.name: medicaid_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state Medicaid program under which the patient is enrolled. Null for non-Medicaid plans. Required for Medicaid claim submission and state-specific billing rules.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid State Plan; 42 CFR §430; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: medicare_part
attributes.description: For Medicare coverage, identifies the specific Medicare part: A (Hospital Insurance), B (Medical Insurance), C (Medicare Advantage/HMO), or D (Prescription Drug Coverage). Null for non-Medicare plans. Drives CMS billing rules and claim form selection.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Benefit Policy Manual; 42 CFR §410; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_max
attributes.description: The maximum annual amount the patient is required to pay out-of-pocket for covered services, after which the plan covers 100% of costs. Used in patient financial counseling and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflows.
attributes.references: ACA §1302(c); HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; X12 271 BEN segment

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_met_amount
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount the patient has applied toward their annual out-of-pocket maximum. Sourced from real-time eligibility verification (X12 271) responses. Informs point-of-service collection decisions.
attributes.references: X12 271 BEN segment; HL7 FHIR Coverage.costToBeneficiary; ACA §1302(c)

attributes.name: payer_electronic_number
attributes.description: The electronic payer identification number used for submitting X12 EDI transactions (270/271 eligibility, 837 claims). Also known as the EDI payer ID or clearinghouse payer ID. Distinct from the NPI.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 NM1*PR NM109; CMS EDI Companion Guide; HIPAA 45 CFR §162

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance plan requires prior authorization (pre-authorization) before certain services, procedures, or medications are covered. Drives pre-authorization workflows in Order Management and Surgical/Procedural Scheduling.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage; CMS Prior Authorization Rule (CMS-0057-F); AMA CPT Prior Auth Guidelines

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance plan requires a referral from a Primary Care Physician (PCP) before the patient can see a specialist. Applicable primarily to Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) and Point of Service (POS) plans.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Coverage; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR §438; NCQA HMO Standards

attributes.name: rx_bin
attributes.description: The 6-digit Bank Identification Number (BIN) used to route pharmacy claims to the correct Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM). Printed on the insurance card and required for real-time pharmacy eligibility and adjudication via NCPDP SCRIPT standard.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; ANSI X12 278; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: rx_group
attributes.description: The pharmacy benefit group number used to identify the specific pharmacy benefit plan within the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) system. Printed on the insurance card alongside RxBIN and PCN.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: rx_pcn
attributes.description: The Processor Control Number (PCN) used in conjunction with the RxBIN to route pharmacy claims to the correct sub-processor within the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM). Required for pharmacy eligibility verification.
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; HL7 FHIR Coverage

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this insurance coverage record was sourced (e.g., Epic Resolute HB/PB, Cerner Revenue Cycle, MEDITECH Expanse). Supports data lineage, ETL audit, and multi-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier for this coverage record in the originating operational system (e.g., Epic coverage record ID, Cerner insurance record ID). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: subscriber_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the patient (beneficiary) to the primary insurance subscriber. Determines coordination of benefits (COB) rules and claim filing requirements. 'Self' indicates the patient is the primary subscriber.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 INS segment; HL7 FHIR Coverage.relationship; CMS-1500 Box 6

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insurance coverage ends or is terminated. Null indicates open-ended active coverage. Used to prevent claim submission for services rendered outside the coverage period. Aligns with X12 271 DTP*357 segment.
attributes.references: X12 270/271 DTP*357; HL7 FHIR Coverage.period.end; CMS-1500 Box 11c

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this insurance coverage record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312(b) Audit Controls; Joint Commission IM Standards; ISO 27001

products.name: guarantor
products.description: Financial guarantor record identifying the individual or entity responsible for patient account balances. Captures guarantor name, relationship to patient, address, phone, employer information, SSN (masked), and account responsibility percentage. Supports RCM billing workflows, patient financial counseling, and self-pay collection processes. Sourced from EHR revenue cycle and patient accounting modules.
products.reference: UB-04 / CMS-1500 Guarantor Fields — Epic Guarantor Record

attributes.name: guarantor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the financial guarantor record within the patient accounting system. Primary key for the guarantor entity; referenced by patient account and billing records across the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB / Cerner Revenue Cycle — Guarantor Master

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient record for whom this guarantor is financially responsible. Links the guarantor to the Master Patient Index (MPI) and enables RCM workflows to associate account balances with the correct patient.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB / Cerner Revenue Cycle — Patient-Guarantor Link; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

attributes.name: account_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance owed by the guarantor on the patient account in USD. Represents the net self-pay balance after insurance adjudication, contractual adjustments, and payments applied. Core metric for RCM self-pay collection and patient financial counseling.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Balance; CMS Revenue Cycle Guidelines; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known patient accounting number assigned to the guarantor account in the EHR revenue cycle or patient accounting system (e.g., Epic Resolute HB guarantor account number). Used by billing staff, financial counselors, and self-pay collection teams to identify and reference the account.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Account; MEDITECH Expanse Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the guarantor account within the Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) workflow. Drives billing, collection, and write-off processes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|collections|bad_debt|deceased|bankruptcy — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Account Status; CMS Revenue Cycle Guidelines

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the guarantor's mailing or billing address. Used for billing statement delivery, collection correspondence, and address verification in RCM workflows.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the guarantor (apartment, suite, unit, floor, PO Box). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address used in billing and collection correspondence.

attributes.name: annual_income
attributes.description: Self-reported or verified annual gross income of the guarantor in USD. Used for financial assistance (charity care) eligibility screening, sliding-scale fee determination, and payment plan structuring per CMS and ACA financial assistance requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: bad_debt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor account balance has been written off as bad debt in the patient accounting system. Supports financial reporting, bad debt reserve calculations, and RAC audit documentation per GAAP and CMS guidelines.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 954; CMS Bad Debt Reimbursement Guidelines; Epic Resolute HB — Bad Debt

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has filed for bankruptcy protection. When True, all collection activities must cease immediately per the automatic stay provisions of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code (11 U.S.C. §362) and the account is flagged for legal review.
attributes.references: U.S. Bankruptcy Code 11 U.S.C. §362; FDCPA; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Status

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the guarantor's billing or mailing address. Used in billing statement generation, collection correspondence, and geographic analytics for patient financial services.

attributes.name: collection_agency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor account has been referred to an external collection agency for bad debt recovery. When True, direct billing and collection activities by the healthcare organization are suspended per FDCPA requirements.
attributes.references: FDCPA 15 U.S.C. §1692; Epic Resolute HB — Collections; OIG Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Supports international patient billing and cross-border financial correspondence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantor record was first created in the patient accounting system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage, and HIPAA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the guarantor individual in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for identity verification, eligibility determination for financial assistance programs, and demographic analytics in patient financial services.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: deceased_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor is deceased. When True, billing and collection workflows are routed to estate billing processes and direct collection outreach is suspended per FDCPA and state probate law requirements.
attributes.references: FDCPA 15 U.S.C. §1692; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Status; State Probate Laws

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has requested cessation of all billing and collection contact. When True, all outreach activities are suppressed in compliance with FDCPA cease-and-desist provisions and HIPAA patient rights.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the guarantor used for electronic billing statements (e-statements), payment portal communications, and financial counseling correspondence. Consent for electronic communication must be documented per HIPAA and CAN-SPAM Act.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; CAN-SPAM Act; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the guarantor's current employer. Used in financial counseling, self-pay collection assessments, and financial assistance (charity care) eligibility screening to evaluate ability to pay.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; Cerner Revenue Cycle — Guarantor Employer

attributes.name: employer_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the guarantor's employer. Used in self-pay collection processes and financial counseling to verify employment status and facilitate payment arrangements.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA)

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment status of the guarantor. Used in financial assistance (charity care) eligibility determination, payment plan structuring, and self-pay collection risk stratification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employed_full_time|employed_part_time|self_employed|unemployed|retired|student|disabled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Employment; CMS Financial Assistance Policy Guidelines

attributes.name: estatement_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has consented to receive electronic billing statements (e-statements) via email or patient portal in lieu of paper statements. Supports paperless billing initiatives and reduces statement delivery costs in RCM.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522; Epic MyChart — Patient Portal; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: federal_poverty_level_pct
attributes.description: Calculated Federal Poverty Level (FPL) percentage for the guarantor's household based on annual income and household size. Determines eligibility tier for financial assistance programs, charity care, and sliding-scale discounts per ACA Section 501(r) and CMS guidelines.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); HHS Federal Poverty Guidelines; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: financial_assistance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the guarantor's financial assistance (charity care) application. Drives billing hold, discount application, and collection suspension workflows in the RCM system. Supports ACA Section 501(r) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; IRS Form 990 Schedule H

attributes.name: financial_assistance_type
attributes.description: Type of financial assistance program approved or applied for by the guarantor. Determines the discount percentage, payment schedule, and billing workflow applied to the account. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: charity_care|sliding_scale|payment_plan|hardship|medicaid_pending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); CMS Financial Assistance Policy; Epic Resolute HB — Financial Assistance

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first (given) name of the guarantor individual. Used in billing correspondence, patient financial counseling communications, and self-pay collection outreach. Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA when linked to patient account data.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: guarantor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the guarantor indicating whether the responsible party is the patient themselves, a family member, a legal guardian, an estate, or an organization. Determines billing workflow routing and financial counseling approach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|parent|spouse|legal_guardian|estate|organization — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Type; Cerner Revenue Cycle — Guarantor Classification

attributes.name: home_phone
attributes.description: Home telephone number of the guarantor. Primary contact channel for billing inquiries, financial counseling outreach, and self-pay collection calls. Stored in compliance with HIPAA and Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the guarantor's household. Used in conjunction with annual income to determine Federal Poverty Level (FPL) percentage for financial assistance (charity care) eligibility and sliding-scale fee calculations.
attributes.references: ACA Section 501(r); HHS Federal Poverty Guidelines; CMS Financial Assistance Policy

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last (family) name of the guarantor individual. Used in billing correspondence, collection letters, and identity verification for patient financial services.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the most recent payment received from the guarantor in USD. Used alongside last_payment_date for payment plan compliance monitoring, collection risk assessment, and RCM reporting.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment History; Cerner Revenue Cycle; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from the guarantor toward the outstanding account balance. Used in collection aging analysis, payment plan compliance monitoring, and bad debt risk stratification.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment History; Cerner Revenue Cycle; GAAP ASC 954

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent billing statement was generated and sent to the guarantor. Used to track billing cycle compliance, manage statement frequency, and support collection escalation timelines in RCM.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Statement Management; CMS Revenue Cycle Guidelines

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the guarantor individual. Supports identity verification and disambiguation in patient accounting and self-pay collection workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Demographics

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile/cell phone number of the guarantor. Supports SMS billing notifications, payment reminders, and collection outreach. Consent for text messaging must be captured separately per TCPA requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

attributes.name: organization_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the organization acting as guarantor when the responsible party is a business entity, estate, or institution rather than an individual. Populated when guarantor_type is 'organization' or 'estate'.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Organization; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: payment_plan_amount
attributes.description: Agreed monthly payment amount under the guarantor's active payment plan arrangement in USD. Used by RCM billing staff to monitor payment plan compliance and trigger collection escalation if payments are missed.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment Plans; Cerner Revenue Cycle; FDCPA

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has an active payment plan arrangement for the outstanding account balance. When True, collection activities are suspended and the account follows the payment plan schedule in the RCM system.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Payment Plans; Cerner Revenue Cycle; FDCPA

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address. Used for billing statement delivery, collection correspondence, and geographic segmentation in patient financial analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS ZIP Code Standards

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Guarantor's preferred method of contact for billing statements, payment reminders, and financial counseling communications. Drives outreach channel selection in RCM workflows and patient financial services.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Preferences; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522

attributes.name: relationship_to_patient
attributes.description: Describes the guarantor's relationship to the patient as defined in the EHR patient accounting module. Used for financial counseling, billing correspondence, and HIPAA-compliant disclosure of account information. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|parent|child|sibling|grandparent|legal_guardian|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Relationship; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.502; HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson

attributes.name: responsibility_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total patient account balance for which this guarantor is financially responsible. Supports scenarios where multiple guarantors share responsibility for a single patient account (e.g., divorced parents of a minor patient). Value range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Responsibility; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: since_date
attributes.description: Date on which the individual or organization was first established as the financial guarantor for the patient account. Marks the effective start of financial responsibility and is used in RCM aging analysis and financial counseling workflows.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Account; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: sms_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantor has provided explicit written consent to receive SMS/text message billing notifications and payment reminders. Required for TCPA compliance before sending automated text messages to the guarantor's mobile phone.
attributes.references: TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; FCC TCPA Regulations; Epic Resolute HB — Communication Preferences

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which the guarantor record was sourced (e.g., Epic Resolute HB, Cerner Revenue Cycle, MEDITECH Expanse). Supports data lineage tracking, ETL reconciliation, and audit trail requirements in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Epic Resolute HB; Cerner Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: ssn_masked
attributes.description: Masked Social Security Number (SSN) of the guarantor, displaying only the last four digits (format: XXX-XX-NNNN). Used for identity verification in self-pay collections, financial assistance screening, and credit bureau reporting. Full SSN must never be stored in the Silver layer per HIPAA and PCI DSS data minimization requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; IRS Publication 1075

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the guarantor's billing or mailing address (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Used for billing correspondence, state-specific financial assistance program eligibility, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS State Abbreviations; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the guarantor record was most recently modified in the patient accounting system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trail requirements, and Silver layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Work telephone number of the guarantor. Used as an alternate contact channel for billing and collection communications when home phone is unavailable. Stored in compliance with HIPAA and TCPA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; TCPA 47 U.S.C. §227; Epic Resolute HB — Guarantor Contact

products.name: emergency_contact
products.description: Patient emergency contact records capturing contact name, relationship type, priority order, phone numbers (home, mobile, work), address, and authorization level (e.g., authorized to receive PHI, healthcare proxy, legal guardian). Supports EMTALA compliance, care coordination, and discharge planning workflows. Sourced from Epic and Cerner registration modules.
products.reference: HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson Resource — EMTALA Contact Requirements

attributes.name: emergency_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the emergency contact record in the Master Patient Index (MPI) system. Primary key for the emergency_contact data product.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient for whom this emergency contact is registered. Links to the patient master record in the Master Patient Index (MPI).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.patient; Epic Registration Module

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the emergency contact's residence. Used for written correspondence, legal notifications, and discharge planning documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the emergency contact (e.g., apartment number, suite, unit). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address resolution.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Epic Registration

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of residence for the emergency contact. Used in conjunction with state and postal code for complete address resolution and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; USPS Addressing Standards; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the patient provided consent to designate this individual as an emergency contact and/or authorized recipient of PHI. Required for HIPAA audit trails and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510(b); OCR HIPAA Guidance; TJC RI.01.03.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: consent_obtained_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the staff member (e.g., registration clerk, nurse) who obtained the patient's consent to designate this emergency contact. Supports HIPAA audit trail requirements and accountability in the registration workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); OCR HIPAA Guidance; TJC RI.01.03.01; Epic Registration

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the emergency contact record. Active = currently valid and reachable; Inactive = no longer applicable (e.g., relationship ended); Deceased = contact has died; Unverified = contact information has not been confirmed with the patient.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.active; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact's role relative to the patient. Determines the scope of authority and notification priority. Values include emergency_contact (general notification), healthcare_proxy (authorized to make medical decisions), legal_guardian (legal authority over patient), authorized_representative (authorized to receive PHI per HIPAA), next_of_kin (biological/legal family), guarantor (financial responsibility). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emergency_contact|healthcare_proxy|legal_guardian|authorized_representative|next_of_kin|guarantor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.relationship; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.510; Epic Registration

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the emergency contact's address. Supports international patients and contacts residing outside the United States.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; HL7 FHIR R4 Address.country

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this emergency contact record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements, HIPAA compliance, and data lineage tracking. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.530(j); HITRUST CSF Control 09.ab; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Epic Registration

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this emergency contact designation is no longer valid (e.g., divorce, death of contact, revocation by patient). Null indicates the contact is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.period.end; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this emergency contact designation is considered valid and active. Supports temporal validity tracking for contact records, particularly when contacts change over time (e.g., new spouse, new guardian).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.period.start; Epic Registration; Cerner Millennium Registration

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the emergency contact. Used for non-urgent communications, appointment notifications, and electronic delivery of care summaries or discharge instructions where PHI authorization permits.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HITECH Act; Epic MyChart Registration

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given (first) name of the emergency contact individual. Used for identification and communication during care coordination and emergency notification workflows.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 HumanName.given; Epic Registration

Business justification: PCP attribution for value-based care and network adequacy reporting requires knowing which provider network the attributed PCP belongs to. CMS network adequacy standards and ACO reporting depend on th

attributes.name: aco_contract_number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract number for the Accountable Care Organization (ACO) governing this attribution. Required for CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) reporting, shared savings reconciliation, and regulatory submissions to CMS.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) Final Rule 42 CFR Part 425

attributes.name: attribution_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the statistical confidence level of the attribution assignment. Higher scores indicate stronger evidence of the patient-PCP relationship based on visit frequency, claims history, or enrollment data. Used to prioritize manual review of low-confidence attributions and to weight population health analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Population Health Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to assign the patient to the PCP or care team. Claims-based attribution uses historical utilization patterns; enrollment-based uses payer plan enrollment data; manual is provider-assigned; algorithm-based uses predictive models; hybrid combines multiple methods; empanelment is practice-panel assignment. Drives HEDIS, MIPS, and ACO reporting logic.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA MIPS Attribution Rules

attributes.name: attribution_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason when an attribution assignment has been manually overridden from the algorithm-generated or payer-assigned attribution. Documents the clinical or administrative justification for the override, supporting audit trails and compliance with CMS and NCQA attribution integrity requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal rank (1 = primary) when a patient has multiple concurrent attribution records across different payers or plans. Rank 1 designates the primary PCP attribution used for population health management and HEDIS reporting. Higher ranks indicate secondary or supplemental attributions.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: attribution_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or completed date for the next periodic review of this attribution record. Attribution records are reviewed quarterly or annually per payer contract requirements to ensure accuracy of panel rosters and compliance with HEDIS and MIPS reporting periods.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: attribution_segment
attributes.description: Insurance coverage segment of the attributed patient. Determines applicable attribution methodology, quality measure set, and regulatory reporting requirements. Dual eligible patients (Medicare and Medicaid) require special attribution handling per CMS duals coordination rules.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare-Medicaid Coordination Office; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this attribution record was sourced. Identifies whether the attribution originated from Epic Healthy Planet, Cerner Millennium, a payer attribution feed, manual entry, HL7 FHIR interface, or a population health management platform. Critical for data lineage and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Provenance Resource; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: attribution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PCP attribution record. Active indicates a current, valid attribution; pending indicates awaiting confirmation; disputed indicates a payer or provider challenge; terminated indicates the attribution period has ended; under_review indicates compliance or audit review in progress.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: care_management_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attributed patient is currently enrolled in a care management or disease management program under the attributed PCP or ACO. True = enrolled in care management. Used for population health program tracking and HEDIS care management measure reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Chronic Care Management (CCM) Billing Guidelines; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Quality Measures

attributes.name: consent_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has provided documented consent for their health information to be shared with the attributed PCP, care team, and ACO for care coordination and population health management purposes. Required for HIPAA-compliant data sharing under ACO and HIE participation agreements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.506; CMS ACO Beneficiary Notification Requirements; HL7 FHIR Consent Resource

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PCP attribution record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and compliance with HIPAA audit control standards. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: data_sharing_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has exercised their right to opt out of data sharing with the ACO or population health program under CMS beneficiary notification and opt-out requirements. True = patient has opted out. Patients who opt out must be excluded from ACO attribution and shared data feeds.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Beneficiary Notification and Opt-Out Requirements 42 CFR Part 425; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.522

attributes.name: disenrollment_reason
attributes.description: Coded reason for the termination of the PCP attribution. Used for panel management analytics, provider turnover reporting, and population health program evaluation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: provider_change|plan_disenrollment|patient_request|provider_termination|death|moved_out_of_area|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the PCP attribution becomes effective and the patient is considered part of the attributed provider's panel. Used as the start boundary for HEDIS measurement periods, MIPS performance calculations, and ACO shared savings attribution windows.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA Final Rule

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the PCP attribution terminates. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active attribution. Used to calculate attribution duration, panel turnover, and to exclude patients from measurement periods after disenrollment or provider change.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or service area associated with this attribution record, typically aligned with CMS Hospital Referral Regions (HRR) or payer-defined service areas. Used for population health geographic analysis, regional quality benchmarking, and ACO regional benchmark calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Referral Region (HRR) Definitions; CMS MSSP Regional Benchmark Methodology

attributes.name: hcc_risk_score
attributes.description: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment score for the attributed patient at the time of attribution. Used in Medicare Advantage and ACO shared savings calculations to adjust expected expenditures for patient complexity. Sourced from CMS risk adjustment data or population health platform.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model; CMS Medicare Advantage Final Rule; CMS MSSP Shared Savings Program

attributes.name: hedis_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribution record qualifies the patient for inclusion in HEDIS (Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set) measure calculations for the current measurement year. Eligibility is determined by continuous enrollment criteria, plan type, and attribution method per NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Star Ratings Program

attributes.name: is_primary_attribution
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribution record is the patient's primary PCP attribution used as the single source of truth (SSOT) for population health management, HEDIS measurement, and MIPS performance reporting. True = primary attribution; False = secondary or supplemental attribution.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; MACRA MIPS Attribution Rules

attributes.name: last_visit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent qualifying primary care visit between the patient and the attributed PCP within the attribution lookback period. Used to assess recency of the patient-provider relationship and to support attribution validation and panel management.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; Epic Healthy Planet

attributes.name: lookback_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months in the historical claims lookback window used to determine claims-based attribution. Standard values are 12 or 24 months per CMS and NCQA attribution methodologies. Stored to support audit and reproducibility of attribution assignments.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: measurement_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this attribution record is applicable for quality measurement reporting (HEDIS, MIPS, ACO quality measures). Attribution records are typically finalized at the start of each measurement year and used throughout the performance period.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS MIPS Performance Period; CMS MSSP Measurement Year

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attributed provider qualifies for Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) performance measurement under MACRA for this attribution record. Eligibility is based on provider NPI, patient volume thresholds, and billing thresholds per CMS MIPS eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: MACRA Final Rule 42 CFR Part 414; CMS MIPS Eligibility Criteria; CMS QPP

attributes.name: override_authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the clinical or administrative staff member who authorized a manual attribution override. Required for audit trail integrity and compliance with CMS and NCQA attribution override documentation requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; OIG Compliance Guidance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls

attributes.name: override_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manual attribution override was authorized and applied. Used in conjunction with override_authorized_by and attribution_override_reason to maintain a complete audit trail of attribution changes.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; OIG Compliance Guidance; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls

attributes.name: panel_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was formally added to the attributed PCP's patient panel in the practice management or population health system (e.g., Epic Healthy Planet empanelment). May differ from the attribution effective date when payer attribution and practice empanelment are managed separately.
attributes.references: Epic Healthy Planet Panel Management; CMS ACO Attribution Methodology; NCQA PCMH Standards

attributes.name: payer_attribution_number
attributes.description: The external attribution identifier assigned by the payer or managed care organization in their attribution feed. Used to reconcile internal attribution records with payer-issued attribution rosters and to resolve attribution disputes with payers.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; ERA/EDI 835 Transaction

attributes.name: risk_stratification_tier
attributes.description: Patient risk stratification tier assigned at the time of attribution, based on clinical complexity, chronic condition burden, and Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) factors. Used by the attributed PCP and care team to prioritize outreach, care management intensity, and resource allocation in population health programs.
attributes.references: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Model; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; AHRQ Population Health Guidance

attributes.name: sdoh_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has documented Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) risk factors (e.g., food insecurity, housing instability, transportation barriers) that require care coordination support from the attributed PCP or care team. True = SDOH risk factors present.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Framework; NCQA HEDIS SDOH Measures; HL7 FHIR Gravity Project SDOH Clinical Care

attributes.name: source_feed_date
attributes.description: Date of the payer attribution feed or population health system extract from which this attribution record was loaded. Used for data currency validation, ETL reconciliation, and to identify stale attribution records that require refresh from the source system.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Provenance Resource; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001 Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PCP attribution record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used to detect and process incremental changes during ETL pipeline runs and to support audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312 Audit Controls; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: visit_count_lookback
attributes.description: Number of qualifying primary care visits with the attributed provider during the claims-based attribution lookback period (typically 24 months). Used to validate and support claims-based attribution assignments and to calculate attribution confidence scores per CMS and NCQA methodologies.
attributes.references: CMS Attribution Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

products.name: eligibility_check
products.description: Real-time and batch insurance eligibility verification transaction records capturing verification date and time, payer queried, verification method (270/271 EDI, portal, phone), eligibility status returned, coverage details confirmed, copay/deductible amounts verified, prior authorization requirements, and verification source system. Supports front-end RCM workflows and reduces claim denials. Sourced from Epic Resolute and Cerner Revenue Cycle eligibility modules.
products.reference: HIPAA 270/271 Eligibility Inquiry and Response — X12 EDI Standard

attributes.name: eligibility_check_id

Currently eligibility_check links to payer and subscriber separately, but the authoritative coverage record is insurance_coverage. Adding
