attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Master Patient Index Standards

attributes.name: ordering_clinician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.clinician. Business justification: Eligibility verifications are often triggered by specific provider orders or referrals. Tracking the ordering clinician supports prior authorization workflows, audit trails for medical necessity, and

attributes.name: prior_auth_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.prior_auth_rule. Business justification: Eligibility checks identify applicable prior authorization rules for ordered services. The prior_auth_required flag on eligibility_check must reference the specific rule that triggered the requirement

attributes.name: registration_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.registration_event. Business justification: Eligibility checks are frequently triggered by registration events (new registration, pre-registration, admit). Linking eligibility_check to the triggering registration_event enables traceability of t

attributes.name: rendering_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.group. Business justification: HIPAA 270/271 eligibility transactions and prior authorization submissions require the rendering group/practice NPI. Group-level eligibility verification is standard in payer-provider EDI transactions

attributes.name: rendering_org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: HIPAA 270/271 eligibility transactions require the rendering organization NPI/TIN. Payer eligibility verification and prior authorization workflows depend on knowing which org_provider is rendering th

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Specialty-specific benefit verification is a standard payer operation — mental health carve-outs, specialist copay tiers, and prior auth requirements vary by specialty. Linking eligibility_check to sp

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter or scheduled appointment that triggered this eligibility verification. Nullable when verification is performed outside of a specific encounter context (e.g., batch eligibility runs).
attributes.references: Epic Resolute Revenue Cycle; Cerner Millennium Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: clearinghouse_name
attributes.description: The name of the EDI clearinghouse (e.g., Change Healthcare, Availity, Waystar) used to route the 270/271 eligibility transaction between the provider and the payer. Null for direct payer connections.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271; CMS EDI Clearinghouse Standards

attributes.name: coinsurance_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of covered service costs the patient is responsible for after the deductible is met, as confirmed in the eligibility response (e.g., 20.00 for a 20% patient coinsurance obligation).
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has multiple insurance coverages requiring Coordination of Benefits (COB) processing. True = secondary or tertiary payer exists and COB rules must be applied during claims adjudication.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS COB Rules; NCQA COB Standards

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed copayment amount the patient is required to pay at the time of service for the applicable service type (e.g., office visit, specialist, ED), as confirmed in the eligibility response.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Indicates the order of coverage for this payer relative to other payers the patient may have. 'primary' = first-pay payer; 'secondary' = pays after primary; 'tertiary' = pays after secondary.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS COB Rules; CMS-1500 Claim Form Instructions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this eligibility check record was first created in the source system and ingested into the Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: family_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual family deductible amount for the patient's insurance plan as confirmed in the eligibility response. Applicable when the patient is covered under a family plan.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: The insurance group number associated with the patient's coverage plan, as returned in the payer's eligibility response. Identifies the employer group or plan sponsor.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Coverage Verification Standards

attributes.name: individual_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The annual individual deductible amount for the patient's insurance plan as confirmed in the eligibility response. Represents the amount the patient must pay out-of-pocket before insurance begins covering costs.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards; ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: individual_deductible_met_amount
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount of the individual deductible that the patient has already satisfied as of the verification date. Used to calculate remaining patient financial responsibility.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Benefit Verification Standards

attributes.name: individual_out_of_pocket_max
attributes.description: The annual individual out-of-pocket maximum (OOPM) for the patient's plan as confirmed in the eligibility response. Once met, the insurer covers 100% of covered services for the remainder of the benefit year.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; ACA 45 CFR 156.130; CMS Benefit Verification Standards

attributes.name: individual_out_of_pocket_met
attributes.description: The year-to-date amount applied toward the patient's individual out-of-pocket maximum as of the verification date. Used to determine remaining patient financial liability.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; ACA 45 CFR 156.130; CMS Benefit Verification Standards

attributes.name: is_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether the eligibility verification result was manually overridden by a staff member, superseding the automated payer response. True = result was overridden; False = result reflects the original payer response.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Revenue Cycle Compliance; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: The Medical Record Number (MRN) of the patient as used in the eligibility inquiry submitted to the payer. Captured here as it appeared in the transaction for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Master Patient Index; Joint Commission Record Standards

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rendering provider or facility is in-network or out-of-network with the patient's insurance plan, as confirmed in the eligibility response. Affects patient cost-sharing obligations.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text reason documented when a staff member manually overrides the eligibility verification result (e.g., patient confirmed coverage verbally, payer system outage). Supports audit trail for compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; CMS Revenue Cycle Compliance; OIG Compliance Program Guidance

attributes.name: prior_auth_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer requires prior authorization (PA) for the service type being verified. True = prior authorization must be obtained before rendering service to avoid claim denial.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Prior Authorization Rules; AMA Prior Authorization Standards

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient's plan requires a referral from a Primary Care Physician (PCP) before the patient can receive specialist or ancillary services. Common for HMO and POS plan types.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS HMO Referral Requirements; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: The ASC X12 AAA reject reason code returned by the payer when the eligibility inquiry could not be processed (e.g., '15' = Required information missing, '72' = Invalid/missing subscriber/insured ID). Null when verification is successful.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 AAA Segment Reject Reason Codes; CMS EDI Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the rejection reason returned by the payer or clearinghouse when the eligibility inquiry failed. Supports staff workflow resolution and denial prevention.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 AAA Segment; CMS Revenue Cycle Management Standards

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the payer returned the eligibility response (271 transaction or portal/phone response). Used to calculate verification turnaround time for SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271; CMS Revenue Cycle Management Standards

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: The date of service for which eligibility is being verified. May be the date of an upcoming appointment or the date of a completed encounter. Used to confirm coverage was active on the specific date of care.
attributes.references: CMS Revenue Cycle Management; HIPAA ASC X12 270/271

attributes.name: service_type_code
attributes.description: The ASC X12 service type code indicating the category of healthcare service for which eligibility was verified (e.g., '30' = Health Benefit Plan Coverage, '98' = Professional Physician Visit, '48' = Hospital Inpatient). Aligns with the 271 EB01 element.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 EB01 Service Type Codes; CMS Coverage Verification Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this eligibility check was originated or processed. Supports data lineage and source reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute PB; Cerner Millennium Revenue Cycle; MEDITECH Expanse

attributes.name: transaction_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control number assigned to the 270/271 EDI eligibility inquiry and response transaction set. Used for end-to-end transaction tracing and reconciliation with payer acknowledgments.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271 Transaction Set; CMS EDI Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this eligibility check record was last modified, such as when a manual override or correction was applied post-verification.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to perform the eligibility verification. 'edi_270_271' = HIPAA-compliant EDI transaction; 'portal' = payer web portal; 'phone' = telephone inquiry; 'fax' = fax-based verification; 'real_time_api' = real-time API call (e.g., FHIR-based); 'batch' = overnight batch eligibility run.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271; CMS EDI Standards; HL7 FHIR R4

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the eligibility verification transaction as returned by the payer. 'active' = patient is currently covered; 'inactive' = coverage lapsed; 'pending' = awaiting payer response; 'error' = transaction failed; 'partial' = incomplete response received; 'not_found' = member not found in payer system.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 271 AAA Reject Reason Codes; CMS Revenue Cycle Standards

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the eligibility verification request was initiated and submitted to the payer. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 270/271; Epic Resolute PB Eligibility Module

attributes.name: verification_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the eligibility check was performed in real-time at point of service, as part of a scheduled batch run (e.g., night-before appointment verification), or manually initiated by a staff member.
attributes.references: Epic Resolute PB Eligibility Module; Cerner Millennium Revenue Cycle

attributes.name: verified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or staff identifier of the person who performed or confirmed the eligibility verification, applicable for manual or portal-based verifications. Null for fully automated EDI or batch verifications.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 Audit Controls; Joint Commission Documentation Standards

products.name: registration_event

Provides the audit trail for patient identity creation and maintenance events within the MPI lifecycle. Distinct from encounter-level ADT events — this product tracks identity/registration events, not clinical visit movements. Sourced from EHR ADT and registration modules.

attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; The Joint Commission; HL7 FHIR R4 Location Resource

Linking registration_event to eligibility_span enables tracking which span was confirmed at registra

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: ADT registration events capture plan-specific enrollment context at point of service for billing and eligibility. Business process: admit/transfer/discharge messages include plan details for claims su

attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §162; CMS Conditions of Participation; Epic Resolute HB

attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(a)(2)(iii); CMS Promoting Interoperability; Epic MyChart Account Administration

attributes.name: digital_health_app_linked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has linked one or more third-party digital health applications (e.g., Apple Health, Google Fit, wearable device apps) to their portal account via FHIR API. Supports CMS Interoperability Final Rule compliance and patient-generated health data ingestion.
attributes.references: CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule (CMS-9115-F); 21st Century Cures Act; HL7 FHIR R4 SMART App Launch

attributes.name: identity_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the patient's identity during portal account setup. Supports NIST identity assurance level classification and HIPAA security rule compliance for user authentication.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63A; HIPAA §164.312(d); Epic MyChart Identity Verification

attributes.name: identity_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient's identity was formally verified. Supports audit trail requirements and periodic re-verification workflows per NIST identity assurance standards.

attributes.name: identity_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient's identity has been formally verified during portal account setup (e.g., via in-person verification, identity proofing service, or government ID check). Supports NIST identity assurance level requirements and HIPAA access control.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63A Identity Proofing; HIPAA §164.312(d); HITRUST CSF Control 01.a

attributes.name: last_login_date
attributes.description: Most recent calendar date on which the patient successfully authenticated and logged into the portal. Used for patient engagement analytics, dormant account identification, and MIPS Promoting Interoperability active patient measures.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Promoting Interoperability; HIPAA §164.312(b) Audit Controls; Epic MyChart Usage Analytics

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time of the most recent successful patient authentication to the portal. Provides granular session tracking for security auditing and HIPAA access log compliance beyond the date-level last_login_date.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(b) Audit Controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework PR.AC-1; ISO 27001 A.9.4.2

attributes.name: login_failure_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive failed authentication attempts since the last successful login. Used to trigger account lockout policies per HIPAA security rule requirements and NIST password management guidelines.

attributes.name: messaging_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has opted in to receive secure portal messages from care team members. Supports patient engagement workflows, care coordination, and MIPS Promoting Interoperability secure messaging measures.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Promoting Interoperability PI_EP_2; HIPAA §164.312(e)(2)(ii) Encryption; Epic MyChart Messaging

attributes.name: notification_email
attributes.description: Email address used for portal notification delivery. May differ from the patient's primary contact email on file. Used for account activation links, secure message alerts, appointment reminders, and test result notifications.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(e)(2)(ii); CAN-SPAM Act; Epic MyChart Account Settings

attributes.name: notification_mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile phone number used for SMS-based portal notifications and two-factor authentication. May differ from the patient's primary contact phone on file. Subject to TCPA consent requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(d); TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); Epic MyChart Account Settings

attributes.name: notification_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred channel for receiving portal notifications (e.g., new messages, appointment reminders, test results). Drives outbound communication workflows and patient engagement strategy.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Promoting Interoperability; Epic MyChart Notification Settings; HIPAA §164.522(b) Confidential Communications

attributes.name: portal_account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the portal account by the portal platform (e.g., Epic MyChart account number, Cerner HealtheLife account ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and patient-facing reference. Satisfies MASTER_AGREEMENT BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Account Management; HL7 FHIR R4 Person.identifier; HIPAA §164.312(a)(2)(i)

attributes.name: portal_platform
attributes.description: Name of the patient portal platform hosting this account (e.g., Epic MyChart, Cerner HealtheLife). Identifies the source system for digital engagement and determines applicable integration patterns for FHIR-based data exchange.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart; Cerner HealtheLife; HL7 FHIR R4 Device.deviceName; CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Final Rule (CMS-9115-F)

attributes.name: proxy_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this portal account has been granted proxy access to another patient's health record (e.g., parent accessing a minor child's record, adult caregiver accessing an elderly patient's record). When true, proxy-specific fields are populated.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson; HIPAA §164.502(g) Personal Representatives; Epic MyChart Proxy Access

attributes.name: proxy_access_level
attributes.description: Scope of access granted to the proxy account holder. 'full' allows all portal functions including messaging and scheduling; 'limited' restricts to specific record sections; 'view_only' allows read-only access to designated information. Enforces HIPAA minimum necessary standard.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(b) Minimum Necessary; HL7 FHIR R4 Consent.provision; Epic MyChart Proxy Access Levels

attributes.name: proxy_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which proxy access was formally authorized and granted. Establishes the start of the proxy access period for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g); HL7 FHIR R4 Consent.dateTime; Epic MyChart Proxy Authorization

attributes.name: proxy_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the proxy account holder. Used for identity verification during proxy access setup and to confirm the proxy is a legal adult where required (e.g., adult caregiver, healthcare POA).
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g); HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.birthDate; Epic MyChart Proxy Identity Verification

attributes.name: proxy_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proxy access authorization expires. Null for indefinite authorizations. System should automatically revoke access on this date. Critical for HIPAA compliance and time-limited proxy arrangements (e.g., temporary caregiver).
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g); HL7 FHIR R4 Consent.period; Epic MyChart Proxy Expiration Management

attributes.name: proxy_first_name
attributes.description: First (given) name of the proxy account holder who has been granted access to the patient's portal record. Required for identity verification and HIPAA-compliant proxy access management.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g) Personal Representatives; HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.name; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: proxy_last_name
attributes.description: Last (family) name of the proxy account holder who has been granted access to the patient's portal record. Required for identity verification and HIPAA-compliant proxy access management.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g) Personal Representatives; HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.name; Epic MyChart Proxy Management

attributes.name: proxy_legal_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the supporting legal documentation (e.g., court order number, POA document ID, scanned document storage path) that authorizes the proxy access. Supports HIPAA audit and legal compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g); HITRUST CSF; Epic MyChart Proxy Documentation

attributes.name: proxy_legal_document_type
attributes.description: Type of legal documentation supporting the proxy access authorization. Required for healthcare POA and legal guardian proxy relationships. Supports HIPAA compliance and legal defensibility of proxy access grants.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g); State Departments of Health — Guardianship; HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson

attributes.name: proxy_relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of relationship between the proxy account holder and the patient whose record is being accessed. Determines applicable HIPAA authorization requirements and access scope. Aligned with HL7 FHIR RelatedPerson.relationship value set.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson.relationship; HIPAA §164.502(g); CMS Promoting Interoperability

attributes.name: proxy_revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which proxy access was explicitly revoked before its natural expiration. Null if access was not revoked early. Supports HIPAA audit trail requirements for access termination events.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g); HL7 FHIR R4 Consent.status; Epic MyChart Proxy Revocation

attributes.name: proxy_revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early revocation of proxy access. Supports compliance auditing and legal documentation requirements. 'age_of_majority' applies when a minor patient reaches adulthood and proxy parental access is automatically terminated.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.502(g); HL7 FHIR R4 Consent.status; State Departments of Health — Minor Patient Rights

attributes.name: rx_renewal_request_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient is enabled to submit prescription renewal requests through the portal. Supports pharmacy engagement workflows and MIPS Promoting Interoperability measures for patient-generated health data.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS Promoting Interoperability; Epic MyChart Rx Renewal; Epic Willow Ambulatory

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this portal account record was sourced (e.g., Epic MyChart, Cerner HealtheLife). Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and multi-system integration governance.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 MessageHeader.source; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001 A.12.4.1

attributes.name: source_system_account_code
attributes.description: Native account identifier from the originating portal system (e.g., Epic MyChart internal account ID, Cerner HealtheLife user GUID). Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Epic MyChart Account Management; Cerner HealtheLife; HL7 FHIR R4 Person.identifier

attributes.name: terms_accepted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the patient accepted the portal terms of use and privacy notice. Supports HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices compliance documentation and legal audit trail.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.520; OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Terms Acceptance Tracking

attributes.name: terms_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has accepted the portal terms of use and privacy notice. Required for account activation. Supports HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices acknowledgment tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.520 Notice of Privacy Practices; OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Terms of Use

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the portal terms of use and privacy notice that the patient accepted. Enables tracking of re-consent requirements when terms are updated, supporting HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.520; OCR HIPAA Enforcement; Epic MyChart Terms Version Management

attributes.name: test_result_notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has enabled portal notifications for new laboratory or radiology test results. Supports patient engagement, timely result delivery, and 21st Century Cures Act information blocking compliance.
attributes.references: 21st Century Cures Act §4004 Information Blocking; CMS Interoperability Final Rule; Epic MyChart Results Notification

attributes.name: two_factor_auth_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has enrolled in two-factor authentication (2FA) for portal access. Supports HIPAA security rule compliance, NIST identity assurance level requirements, and organizational security policy enforcement.
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(d) Person Authentication; NIST SP 800-63B AAL2; ISO 27001 A.9.4.2; HITRUST CSF Control 01.d

attributes.name: two_factor_auth_method
attributes.description: The specific method used for two-factor authentication when enrolled. Supports security posture analysis and patient experience optimization for authentication workflows.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-63B; HIPAA §164.312(d); HITRUST CSF Control 01.d

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this portal account record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 A.12.4.1; HIPAA §164.312(b) Audit Controls; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: mpi_record_id

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_policy. Linking consent_reference to compliance_policy supports policy-ver

Linking consent_reference to the registration_eve

attributes.name: superseded_consent_reference_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on consent_reference (superseded_consent_reference_id)

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the encounter during which the consent was obtained. Null if consent was obtained outside of a specific encounter context.

attributes.name: audit_trail_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a detailed audit trail exists for this consent reference in the consent domain SSOT. True if audit trail is available, False otherwise.

attributes.name: consent_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the consent becomes effective and enforceable. Denormalized from consent master for quick filtering and reporting.

attributes.name: consent_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the consent expires and is no longer valid. Null if the consent has no expiration. Denormalized from consent master for quick filtering.

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which the consent was obtained from the patient (e.g., written signature, verbal acknowledgment, electronic signature via patient portal, implied consent).

attributes.name: consent_obtained_date
attributes.description: The date when the consent was originally obtained from the patient or their authorized representative.

attributes.name: consent_revocation_date
attributes.description: The date when the patient revoked their consent. Null if the consent has not been revoked.

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Textual description of the scope or boundaries of the consent. Describes what specific activities, data types, or purposes are covered by this consent.

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent reference. Indicates whether the consent is currently active, has been revoked by the patient, has expired, is pending approval, or has been superseded by a newer consent.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The category of consent being referenced. Indicates the purpose or scope of the consent (e.g., treatment, research participation, marketing communications, PHI disclosure, HIE participation, telehealth services).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent reference record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the physical or electronic consent document stored in the document management system. Enables retrieval of the original signed consent form.

attributes.name: enterprise_mrn
attributes.description: The enterprise-wide Medical Record Number for the patient across all facilities. Denormalized for quick reference.

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: Full name of the legal guardian or authorized representative who provided consent on behalf of the patient. Null if patient provided consent directly.

attributes.name: guardian_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the guardian or authorized representative to the patient (e.g., parent, spouse, healthcare proxy, power of attorney).

attributes.name: hie_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has consented to participate in Health Information Exchange networks for sharing their medical records across organizations. True if HIE participation is authorized, False otherwise.
attributes.references: State HIE Consent Laws, 42 CFR Part 2

attributes.name: interpreter_used_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical interpreter was used during the consent process. True if an interpreter was present, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Title VI of the Civil Rights Act, HHS Language Access Standards

attributes.name: language_of_consent
attributes.description: The language in which the consent was presented to and obtained from the patient. Important for compliance with language access requirements.
attributes.references: Title VI of the Civil Rights Act, HHS Language Access Standards

attributes.name: legal_guardian_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent was provided by a legal guardian or authorized representative rather than the patient directly. True if guardian provided consent, False if patient provided consent.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has opted in to receive marketing communications. True if patient opted in, False otherwise.

attributes.name: mrn
attributes.description: The facility-specific Medical Record Number for the patient. Denormalized for quick reference and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: phi_disclosure_authorized_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protected Health Information (PHI) Disclosure Authorized Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent authorizes disclosure of Protected Health Information to third parties. True if PHI disclosure is authorized, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reference_priority
attributes.description: Priority order of this consent reference when multiple consents of the same type exist for a patient. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for determining which consent applies in conflict scenarios.

attributes.name: research_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent includes authorization for the patient to participate in research studies. True if research participation is authorized, False otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or code of the source system from which this consent reference record originated (e.g., Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH, patient portal).

attributes.name: source_system_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this consent reference record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent reference record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent reference has been verified for accuracy and completeness by authorized staff. Used for quality assurance and compliance auditing.

attributes.name: verified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this consent reference record was verified. Null if not yet verified.

attributes.name: witness_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness signature was required for this consent based on regulatory or organizational policy. True if witness was required, False otherwise.

domains.name: encounter
domains.description: Core operational record of every patient-provider interaction. Owns ADT (Admit, Discharge, Transfer) events, visit types (inpatient, outpatient, ED, observation, telehealth), admission source and disposition, attending and consulting providers, LOS (Length of Stay), DRG assignment, discharge status, and care setting transitions. Central hub linking patient, provider, clinical, and billing domains.
domains.references: HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource, HL7 ADT Messages, UB-04, CMS-1500

products.name: visit
products.description: Core master record for every patient-provider interaction across all care settings (inpatient, outpatient, ED, observation, telehealth, ambulatory). Central hub of the encounter domain and primary linkage point to patient, provider, clinical, and billing domains. Captures visit type, care setting, facility, attending provider, financial class, and visit status. Owns the full admission-through-discharge lifecycle: admission type (elective, urgent, emergent, newborn, trauma), admission source (ED, direct, transfer, referral, birth), admitting diagnosis, admitting provider, insurance verification at admission, admission and discharge timestamps, discharge disposition (home, SNF, rehab, AMA, expired, hospice, transfer), discharging provider, discharge instructions issued, discharge diagnosis summary, LOS (Length of Stay), readmission risk score, follow-up scheduling, and care transition plan. For observation encounters: two-midnight rule compliance assessment, MOON (Medicare Outpatient Observation Notice) delivery timestamp, total observation hours, conversion-to-inpatient flag and timestamp, and financial impact assessment. For telehealth encounters: platform, connection quality, and session metadata. Includes EMTALA compliance flags, consent status at admission, DRG assignment reference, CMI contribution, and financial class. SSOT for all encounter-level identity, classification, lifecycle state, admission, discharge, observation management, and care setting attributes.

attributes.name: coded_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ICD-10-CM code was assigned to this diagnosis by the HIM coding team. Used for coding productivity tracking, CDI program metrics, and revenue cycle timeliness reporting. Sourced from 3M HIS and Epic Resolute coding workflows.
attributes.references: AHIMA Coding Productivity Standards; 3M HIS; CMS Timely Filing Requirements

attributes.name: coding_provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the clinician or coder who assigned or attested this diagnosis code. Used for audit trails, CDI accountability, RAC audit defense, and provider-level coding quality reporting. Sourced from 3M HIS and Epic ClinDoc coding workflows.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; HIPAA Administrative Simplification; OIG Compliance; 3M HIS

attributes.name: coding_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this diagnosis record within the HIM/CDI coding lifecycle. 'pending' indicates awaiting coder review; 'coded' indicates initial code assignment; 'validated' indicates coder-confirmed; 'queried' indicates a CDI query has been issued; 'amended' indicates a post-bill correction; 'final' indicates billing-ready. Drives revenue cycle workflow and CDI query management in 3M HIS and Epic Resolute.
attributes.references: AHIMA Coding Guidelines; 3M HIS CDI Workflow; CMS RAC Audit Requirements; OIG Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this visit diagnosis record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category requirement.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312(b); HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: diagnosis_rank
attributes.description: Clinical ranking of this diagnosis by severity or clinical significance within the encounter, as assigned by the coding team or clinical documentation system. Distinct from diagnosis_seq_num (billing sequence); this rank reflects clinical priority for care management and quality reporting purposes.
attributes.references: AHIMA Clinical Documentation Improvement; 3M HIS CDI; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: diagnosis_seq_num
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this diagnosis within the encounter's diagnosis list. Sequence 1 typically denotes the principal diagnosis. Used for claim form ordering (UB-04 diagnosis fields), DRG grouping logic, and quality measure attribution. Aligns with LINE_SEQUENCE canonical category.
attributes.references: CMS UHDDS; UB-04 Claim Form FL 67; CMS-1500 Box 21; 3M HIS Grouper

attributes.name: diagnosis_source
attributes.description: Identifies who or what originated this diagnosis record. 'physician' = entered by the treating clinician; 'coder' = assigned by HIM coding staff; 'cdi_specialist' = added via CDI query resolution; 'system' = auto-populated by clinical decision support; 'imported' = received via HIE or external system. Supports audit trail and coding accountability.
attributes.references: AHIMA CDI Practice Standards; OIG Compliance; HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.recorder; Epic ClinDoc

attributes.name: diagnosis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the diagnosis role within the encounter. 'admitting' is the reason for admission; 'principal' is the condition chiefly responsible for the stay after study; 'secondary' are comorbidities and complications; 'discharge' is the final coded diagnosis at discharge; 'working' is a provisional diagnosis during the encounter; 'final' is the confirmed diagnosis post-workup. Drives DRG assignment and UB-04/CMS-1500 claim form population.
attributes.references: CMS Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS); UB-04 Claim Form; CMS-1500; UHDDS Principal Diagnosis Definition

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: The MS-DRG or APR-DRG code assigned to the encounter as influenced by this diagnosis. Populated after DRG grouping by 3M HIS or CMS grouper. Central to inpatient reimbursement under IPPS and case mix index (CMI) calculation.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual; 3M APR-DRG Grouper; CMS IPPS; UB-04 FL 71

attributes.name: drg_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code contributes to the DRG assignment for this encounter. True = this diagnosis is a complication/comorbidity (CC) or major complication/comorbidity (MCC) that affects DRG grouping and reimbursement. Critical for revenue cycle optimization and CDI program targeting.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper; 3M APR-DRG; CMS IPPS; UHDDS CC/MCC Definitions

attributes.name: drg_type
attributes.description: Specifies the DRG classification system used: MS-DRG (Medicare Severity DRG, CMS), APR-DRG (All Patient Refined DRG, 3M), or IR-DRG (International Refined DRG). Determines the reimbursement methodology and payer applicability.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG; 3M APR-DRG; WHO IR-DRG; CMS IPPS

attributes.name: encounter_diagnosis_comment
attributes.description: Free-text clinical comment or qualifier associated with this diagnosis record, as entered by the coding team or clinician. May include specificity notes, CDI query resolution rationale, or coding clarifications. Classified as restricted PHI per HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; AHIMA CDI; Epic ClinDoc; 3M HIS

attributes.name: encounter_diagnosis_source_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this diagnosis record in the source operational system (e.g., Epic ClinDoc diagnosis ID or Cerner PowerChart diagnosis ID). Supports ETL lineage, data reconciliation, and source system audit trails in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Epic ClinDoc; Cerner Millennium PowerChart; HL7 FHIR R4; HITRUST CSF Data Lineage

attributes.name: external_cause_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-CM external cause code (V, W, X, Y codes) documenting the cause, place of occurrence, activity, and status for injury and poisoning diagnoses. Required for trauma registries, injury surveillance, workers' compensation claims, and public health reporting.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM External Cause Codes (V00-Y99); CMS Coding Guidelines; AHRQ Injury Surveillance; State Trauma Registry Requirements

attributes.name: hai_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a healthcare-associated infection (HAI) such as CLABSI, CAUTI, or SSI. True = HAI diagnosis. Triggers HAI surveillance workflows, CMS HAC Reduction Program payment adjustments, and TJC infection control reporting.
attributes.references: CMS HAC Reduction Program; The Joint Commission Infection Control Standards; CDC NHSN HAI Definitions; AHRQ

attributes.name: hcc_category_code
attributes.description: The specific CMS HCC category code to which this ICD-10-CM diagnosis maps. Populated only when hcc_flag is True. Used for risk score calculation in Medicare Advantage, ACO, and MIPS/APM programs. Sourced from CMS HCC mapping crosswalk tables.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model V28; CMS-HCC Crosswalk; MACRA; CMS Medicare Advantage

attributes.name: hcc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICD-10-CM diagnosis code maps to a CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) used for risk adjustment in Medicare Advantage and ACO programs. True = this diagnosis contributes to the patient's HCC risk score. Critical for population health management, value-based care contracting, and capitation payment accuracy.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model; CMS-HCC V28; MACRA APM Framework; NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: icd10_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Code
attributes.description: The ICD-10-CM diagnosis code assigned to this visit. Drives DRG grouping, quality measure attribution, risk adjustment (HCC mapping), and medical billing. Sourced from Epic ClinDoc and validated through 3M HIS coding workflows. Conforms to WHO ICD-10-CM code format.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-CM; CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; 3M HIS Grouping; AMA

attributes.name: icd10_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Classification of Diseases 10th Revision (ICD-10) Diagnosis Description
attributes.description: Full clinical description of the ICD-10-CM diagnosis code as defined by the WHO/CMS code set. Provides human-readable context for the coded diagnosis. Used in clinical documentation, reporting, and CDI workflows.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-CM; CMS ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines; 3M HIS

attributes.name: icd10_version
attributes.description: The fiscal year version of the ICD-10-CM code set used to assign this diagnosis code (e.g., FY2024). ICD-10-CM is updated annually by CMS/CDC. Ensures accurate code interpretation across fiscal year transitions and supports historical data analysis.
attributes.references: CMS ICD-10-CM Annual Updates; CDC ICD-10-CM Tabular List; WHO ICD-10

attributes.name: mental_health_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is classified as a mental health or behavioral health condition per ICD-10-CM Chapter 5 (F-codes). True = mental/behavioral health diagnosis. Supports behavioral health program management, parity compliance reporting, and population health segmentation.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM Chapter 5 Mental and Behavioral Disorders; Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act (MHPAEA); CMS Behavioral Health Strategy

attributes.name: onset_date
attributes.description: The date on which the diagnosed condition first manifested or was first identified, as documented in the clinical record. Supports longitudinal disease tracking, chronic condition management, POA determination, and population health analytics. Aligns with BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP canonical category.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.onset; Epic ClinDoc; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: poa_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the diagnosis condition was present at the time of inpatient admission. Values: Y=Yes (present on admission), N=No (not present on admission), U=Unknown, W=Clinically undetermined, 1=Exempt from POA reporting. Required by CMS for inpatient claims on UB-04. Impacts HAI reporting, VBP penalties, and hospital-acquired condition (HAC) payment adjustments.
attributes.references: CMS POA Reporting Guidelines; UB-04 FL 67 POA Indicator; IPPS HAC Reduction Program; The Joint Commission HAI Standards

attributes.name: primary_diagnosis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is designated as the primary/principal diagnosis for the encounter. True = primary diagnosis. Provides a quick boolean filter for analytics and reporting without requiring sequence number logic. Complements diagnosis_seq_num and diagnosis_type.
attributes.references: CMS UHDDS Principal Diagnosis Definition; UB-04 FL 67; AHIMA Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: quality_measure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis contributes to one or more quality measure denominators or numerators (e.g., HEDIS, MIPS, VBP, TJC core measures). True = this diagnosis is relevant to at least one active quality measure. Supports quality reporting, MIPS scoring, and VBP program management.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS; CMS MIPS; CMS VBP Program; The Joint Commission Core Measures; MACRA

attributes.name: reportable_condition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis is a notifiable/reportable condition requiring mandatory reporting to public health authorities (e.g., state health departments, CDC). True = reportable. Supports public health surveillance, regulatory compliance, and HIE reporting obligations.
attributes.references: State Departments of Health Reportable Disease Lists; CDC National Notifiable Diseases; HIPAA Public Health Disclosure Exception 45 CFR §164.512(b)

attributes.name: resolved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the diagnosed condition was resolved, abated, or no longer active, as documented in the clinical record. Null if the condition is ongoing. Used for chronic disease management, care plan updates, and longitudinal patient health tracking.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.abatement; Epic ClinDoc; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514

attributes.name: sdoh_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis code represents a Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) factor (e.g., Z-codes for housing instability, food insecurity, transportation barriers). True = SDOH-related diagnosis. Supports population health management, care coordination, and CMS SDOH reporting initiatives.
attributes.references: CMS SDOH Strategy; ICD-10-CM Z-Codes for SDOH; AHRQ SDOH Framework; Healthy People 2030

attributes.name: snomed_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT) Code
attributes.description: The SNOMED CT concept identifier mapped to this ICD-10-CM diagnosis code. Supports clinical interoperability, HL7 FHIR-based HIE data exchange, and clinical decision support. Populated via ICD-10 to SNOMED CT crosswalk. Used in FHIR Condition resources for interoperability.
attributes.references: SNOMED International; HL7 FHIR R4 Condition.code; NLM SNOMED CT US Edition; HHS Interoperability Rule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this visit diagnosis record was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL audit, and multi-system reconciliation in the Silver lakehouse layer.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Epic ClinDoc; Cerner Millennium; 3M HIS

attributes.name: substance_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this diagnosis represents a substance use disorder (SUD) per ICD-10-CM codes. True = substance use disorder diagnosis. Supports SUD program management, 42 CFR Part 2 confidentiality compliance, and population health analytics.
attributes.references: ICD-10-CM SUD Codes; 42 CFR Part 2 (Confidentiality of SUD Records); SAMHSA; CMS Opioid Strategy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this visit diagnosis record was last modified in the source system or Silver layer. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category requirement.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312(b); HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

products.name: visit_procedure
products.description: Encounter-level procedure record capturing all procedures performed during a visit. Includes CPT/HCPCS procedure code, ICD-10-PCS code (for inpatient), procedure description, procedure date and time, performing provider NPI, procedure sequence number, principal procedure flag, laterality, anesthesia type, and OR/procedure room reference. Supports charge capture, DRG grouping, quality measurement, and surgical case tracking. Sourced from Epic OpTime, ClinDoc, and Cerner SurgiNet.
products.reference: CPT / HCPCS / ICD-10-PCS

attributes.name: visit_procedure_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each procedure record performed during a patient visit. Primary key for the visit_procedure data product in the encounter domain.

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Essential procedure coding workflow—every CPT code on a visit procedure must validate against the official CPT reference for claims submission, reimbursement calculation, RVU assignment, and NCCI edit

attributes.name: equipment_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.equipment_asset. Business justification: FDA UDI compliance, equipment utilization tracking, and device recall management require linking procedures to specific equipment assets. udi is a denormalized device identifier. Biomedical engineerin

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.hcpcs_code. Business justification: Required for HCPCS procedure coding—DME, supplies, drugs, and non-physician services must reference official HCPCS codes for billing, coverage determination, and reimbursement. Critical for outpatient

attributes.name: icd_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Inpatient procedure coding workflow—ICD-10-PCS codes must validate against the official ICD-10 code set for inpatient claims submission, DRG grouping, and quality measure reporting. Required for hospi

attributes.name: imaging_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to radiology.imaging_order. Business justification: Charge reconciliation and CPT coding audits require matching the billed visit_procedure record to the imaging_order that triggered it. Revenue cycle teams and coding auditors depend on this link to ve

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Procedures consume specific supplies, devices, and implants that must be documented for billing (CDM charge codes), regulatory compliance (UDI tracking for implantables), and procedure cost analysis.

attributes.name: mpi_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient on whom the procedure was performed. Supports patient-level procedure history, quality measurement, and population health analytics.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; HL7 FHIR R4 Patient Resource; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: or_suite_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating room or procedure room where the procedure was performed. Supports OR utilization reporting, room turnover analysis, and facility capacity planning.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: originating_clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Charge capture and surgical case management require linking each documented procedure back to the originating clinical order. Revenue cycle teams reconcile visit_procedure records against clinical_ord

attributes.name: primary_visit_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinician who performed the procedure. Used for provider-level quality reporting, credentialing validation, and RVU attribution.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HL7 FHIR R4 Practitioner Resource; MIPS/MACRA Reporting

attributes.name: privileging_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.privileging. Business justification: Enables retrospective verification that performing clinician held valid privileges for the specific procedure at the facility on the procedure date. Required for peer review, quality assurance audits,

attributes.name: procedure_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to clinical.procedure_event. Business justification: Charge capture reconciliation and perioperative quality reporting (PSI measures, surgical case review) require linking the billing-level visit_procedure to the clinical procedure_event execution recor

attributes.name: snomed_concept_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.snomed_concept. Business justification: Procedure terminology mapping—SNOMED codes on procedures must reference official SNOMED CT for clinical documentation, interoperability, and data exchange with external systems. Required for USCDI com

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.unit. Business justification: Unit-level procedure volume reporting and resource planning for non-OR procedures (bedside procedures, procedure rooms) require linking procedures to the performing unit. Service line directors and OR

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent encounter/visit during which this procedure was performed. Links the procedure to the ADT event, visit type, and associated clinical and billing context.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter Resource; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: anesthesia_type
attributes.description: Type of anesthesia administered during the procedure. Drives anesthesia CPT code selection, anesthesia time unit billing, ASA physical status documentation, and OR case complexity classification.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Anesthesia Guidelines; ASA Physical Status Classification; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: asa_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) Physical Status Classification
attributes.description: ASA physical status classification assigned by the anesthesiologist prior to the procedure, reflecting the patient's overall health status. Used for anesthesia risk stratification, surgical case complexity scoring, and outcomes risk adjustment.
attributes.references: ASA Physical Status Classification System; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; AHRQ Risk Adjustment

attributes.name: body_site
attributes.description: Anatomical location or body site where the procedure was performed, coded using SNOMED CT body structure concepts. Supports surgical safety documentation, quality measure stratification, and clinical analytics.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT Body Structure Hierarchy; HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.bodySite; The Joint Commission Universal Protocol

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why a scheduled procedure was cancelled (e.g., patient not ready, equipment unavailable, surgeon unavailable, insurance denial). Populated only when is_cancelled is true. Supports root cause analysis and OR efficiency improvement.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission OR Performance Metrics

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: Gross charge amount posted to the patient account for this procedure based on the CDM. Represents the billed amount before contractual adjustments, payer discounts, or patient responsibility. Used in revenue cycle management and financial reporting.
attributes.references: CMS CDM; Epic Resolute HB/PB; Cerner Revenue Cycle; GAAP/FASB Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: charge_code
attributes.description: Internal charge code from the Charge Description Master (CDM) mapped to this procedure. Links the clinical procedure to the revenue cycle for charge capture, pricing, and claim generation in Epic Resolute or Cerner Revenue Cycle.
attributes.references: CMS CDM Requirements; Epic Resolute HB/PB; Cerner Revenue Cycle; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: complication_description
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the complication that occurred during or after the procedure. Populated only when complication_flag is true. Used for clinical documentation, quality review, and risk management reporting.
attributes.references: AHRQ PSI; CMS VBP; CDC NHSN; HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.complication

attributes.name: complication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complication was documented as occurring during or immediately following the procedure. Triggers CDI query workflow, quality event review, and HAI/PSI surveillance reporting.
attributes.references: AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators (PSI); CMS VBP; CDC NHSN; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent was documented as obtained from the patient or legal guardian prior to the procedure. Required for regulatory compliance, malpractice risk management, and The Joint Commission accreditation standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission RC.02.01.01; CMS Conditions of Participation §482.13; EMTALA

attributes.name: cpt_code
attributes.description: AMA CPT code identifying the procedure for professional billing, charge capture, and payer adjudication. Required on CMS-1500 claims. Drives RVU calculation and reimbursement.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Coding Standards; CMS-1500; CMS Physician Fee Schedule

attributes.name: cpt_modifier_1
attributes.description: Primary CPT modifier appended to the procedure code to indicate special circumstances (e.g., 50=bilateral, LT=left side, RT=right side, 22=increased procedural services, 59=distinct procedural service). Required for accurate claim adjudication.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Modifier Guidelines; CMS-1500; CMS Correct Coding Initiative (CCI)

attributes.name: cpt_modifier_2
attributes.description: Secondary CPT modifier providing additional claim specificity when a single modifier is insufficient. Used in conjunction with cpt_modifier_1 for complex billing scenarios per CMS Correct Coding Initiative.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Modifier Guidelines; CMS-1500; CMS Correct Coding Initiative (CCI)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this procedure record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance documentation per HIPAA and The Joint Commission medical record requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; The Joint Commission MR.01.01.01; ISO 27001

attributes.name: drg_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure influences the DRG assignment for the inpatient encounter. Flagged by the 3M grouper or equivalent DRG grouping engine. Critical for inpatient revenue integrity and CDI prioritization.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS DRG Grouping; 3M Health Information Systems Grouping; CMS MS-DRG Definitions Manual

attributes.name: hcpcs_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Code
attributes.description: HCPCS Level II code used when a CPT code is not applicable, primarily for supplies, durable medical equipment, and non-physician services billed to Medicare/Medicaid. Complements CPT on UB-04 and CMS-1500 claims.
attributes.references: CMS HCPCS Coding; UB-04; CMS-1500; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: icd10_pcs_code
attributes.description: ICD-10-PCS code assigned for inpatient procedures. Required for inpatient DRG grouping, UB-04 institutional claims, and CMS inpatient prospective payment system (IPPS) reimbursement. Not applicable for outpatient encounters.
attributes.references: WHO ICD-10-PCS; CMS IPPS; UB-04; 3M Health Information Systems Grouping

attributes.name: implant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical device or implant was used during the procedure. Triggers UDI (Unique Device Identifier) documentation requirements per FDA regulations and supply chain charge capture workflows.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule 21 CFR Part 830; The Joint Commission; CMS Conditions of Participation; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: is_cancelled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a scheduled procedure was cancelled before execution. Used for OR cancellation rate reporting, scheduling efficiency analysis, and revenue impact assessment.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission OR Performance Metrics

attributes.name: is_elective
attributes.description: Indicates whether the procedure was scheduled as elective (non-urgent) versus emergent or urgent. Supports surgical scheduling analytics, OR block time management, and payer prior authorization workflows.
attributes.references: CMS Elective Surgery Definitions; Epic Cadence; Cerner SurgiNet Scheduling

attributes.name: is_principal_procedure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the principal procedure performed for the encounter, as defined by the Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS). The principal procedure is the one most closely related to the principal diagnosis and drives DRG assignment for inpatient cases.
attributes.references: CMS UHDDS; CMS IPPS; UB-04 FL 74; 3M Health Information Systems Grouping

attributes.name: laterality
attributes.description: Body side on which the procedure was performed. Required for correct CPT modifier assignment (RT/LT/50), surgical safety checklists, and wrong-site surgery prevention per The Joint Commission Universal Protocol.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Modifiers RT/LT/50; The Joint Commission Universal Protocol; CMS-1500; UB-04

attributes.name: performing_provider_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit NPI of the performing provider as required on CMS-1500 and UB-04 claims. Stored denormalized here for claim generation and audit purposes, as the NPI is a regulatory billing requirement independent of the provider master record.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; CMS-1500 Box 24J; UB-04 FL 56; HIPAA

attributes.name: procedure_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the procedure was performed. Used for charge capture date-of-service, quality measure denominator identification, and surgical case scheduling analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation; HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.performed[x]; AMA CPT

attributes.name: procedure_description
attributes.description: Full clinical description of the procedure as documented in the source system (Epic ClinDoc, OpTime, or Cerner SurgiNet). Provides human-readable context for the CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10-PCS code.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.code.text

attributes.name: procedure_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the procedure was completed (closure for surgical cases, or final clinical action for non-surgical). Combined with start timestamp to derive procedure duration for OR utilization and case costing.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission OR Metrics

attributes.name: procedure_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to this procedure record within the source system (e.g., Epic OpTime case number or Cerner SurgiNet procedure order number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.identifier

attributes.name: procedure_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the procedure began (knife-to-skin for surgical cases, or first clinical action for non-surgical). Used for OR utilization analysis, case duration calculation, and scheduling efficiency reporting.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission OR Metrics

attributes.name: procedure_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the procedure record per HL7 FHIR Procedure.status value set. Drives charge capture eligibility, quality measure inclusion/exclusion, and CDI workflow routing.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.status; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: procedure_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the procedure category. Supports operational reporting, OR scheduling, charge master (CDM) mapping, and departmental cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: surgical|diagnostic|therapeutic|anesthesia|radiology|laboratory|nursing|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; CMS CDM; HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.category

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of times this procedure was performed or units billed within the encounter. Used for charge capture accuracy, claim line quantity reporting, and utilization analysis.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Billing Guidelines; CMS-1500 Box 24G; UB-04 FL 46

attributes.name: rvu_total
attributes.description: Total RVU for the procedure, comprising work RVU, practice expense RVU, and malpractice RVU components per the CMS Physician Fee Schedule. Used for overall provider productivity benchmarking and reimbursement modeling.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule; MACRA/MIPS; AMA RVU Update Committee (RUC)

attributes.name: rvu_work
attributes.description: Physician work RVU assigned to this procedure per the CMS Physician Fee Schedule. Represents the time, skill, and intensity of the physician's work. Used for provider productivity measurement, compensation modeling, and MIPS performance reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule; MACRA/MIPS; AMA RVU Update Committee (RUC)

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this procedure within the encounter, used to distinguish principal from secondary procedures on claims. Sequence 1 typically denotes the principal procedure for DRG grouping and IPPS reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS DRG Grouping; UB-04 FL 74; 3M Health Information Systems Grouping

attributes.name: snomed_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT) Procedure Code
attributes.description: SNOMED CT concept identifier for the procedure, providing a clinically precise, interoperable representation beyond CPT/ICD-10-PCS. Supports HIE data exchange, FHIR-based interoperability, and clinical decision support.
attributes.references: SNOMED International; HL7 FHIR R4 Procedure.code; ONC Interoperability Rule

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this procedure record was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and audit traceability across Epic OpTime, Epic ClinDoc, Cerner SurgiNet, and other source systems.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; HL7 FHIR R4 Provenance Resource

attributes.name: source_system_procedure_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this procedure record in the originating source system (e.g., Epic OpTime case ID, Cerner SurgiNet order ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational EHR system.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; HL7 FHIR R4 Provenance Resource; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: surgical_approach
attributes.description: Method or technique used to access the operative site. Drives ICD-10-PCS character 5 (approach) coding, surgical case complexity classification, and outcomes benchmarking.
attributes.references: ICD-10-PCS Approach Character; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; AHRQ Quality Indicators

attributes.name: timeout_performed_flag

products.name: authorization
products.description: Prior authorization and concurrent review record for services rendered during a visit. Captures authorization number, authorizing payer, authorized service type, authorized units/days, authorization start and end dates, requesting provider, clinical indication, authorization status (approved, denied, pending, appealed, retro-authorized), denial reason code, and peer-to-peer review flag. Critical for revenue cycle integrity, denial management, utilization management, and payer contract compliance. Sourced from Epic Resolute HB and payer portal integrations.
products.reference: Prior Authorization / Utilization Management

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.service. Business justification: Authorization management by clinical service line and payer contract compliance reporting require linking authorizations to the specific service. service_type is denormalized. Utilization management t
