Used for data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Silver layer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nucc|cms|epic|cerner|symplr|meditech|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 Audit Controls

attributes.name: specialty_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping category for the specialty used for network management, referral routing, and provider directory segmentation. Classifies specialties into broad functional areas for operational and analytical purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|surgical|behavioral_health|allied_health|nursing|dental|pharmacy|ancillary|administrative|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: Enterprise Provider Directory Standards; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the specialty within the enterprise provider directory and credentialing systems. Used as the business key for specialty lookups across Epic, Cerner, and Symplr integrations.
attributes.references: Enterprise Provider Directory Standards; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: specialty_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specialty including scope of practice, patient population served, and types of conditions or procedures managed. Used in provider directory publishing, patient-facing portals, and referral routing guidance.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; AMA Specialty Definitions; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: specialty_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the medical or clinical specialty (e.g., 'Internal Medicine', 'Orthopedic Surgery', 'Pediatric Cardiology'). Used in provider directories, credentialing workflows, and payer enrollment forms.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; AMA Specialty Definitions

attributes.name: specialty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the specialty record in the enterprise reference catalog. Active records are available for provider credentialing, enrollment, and claims submission. Deprecated records are retained for historical reference only.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set Versioning

attributes.name: specialty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specialty as primary care, specialist, subspecialist, hospitalist, advanced practice, or ancillary. Used for referral routing logic, network adequacy analysis, and PCP designation in HMO and ACO network management.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS ACO Program Requirements; NCQA Provider Directory Requirements

attributes.name: surgical_specialty
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specialty is classified as a surgical specialty, requiring operating room (OR) scheduling, surgical credentialing, and OpTime/SurgiNet integration for case scheduling and documentation.
attributes.references: AMA Specialty Definitions; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; The Joint Commission Surgical Standards

attributes.name: telehealth_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this specialty are eligible to deliver services via telehealth modalities under applicable CMS and state regulations. Used for network directory publishing, referral routing, and telehealth program management.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Services; 42 CFR Part 410.78; State Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this specialty record was last modified in the enterprise reference catalog. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312(b) Audit Controls; ISO 27001 A.12.4; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set version number in which this specialty code was introduced or last updated (e.g., '23.1', '22.0'). Enables version-specific taxonomy lookups for historical claims reprocessing and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set Versioning; CMS NPI Registry

products.name: credential
products.description: Master record of all professional credentials, licenses, certifications, registrations, and continuing education held by individual clinicians. Encompasses: (1) State medical licenses (MD, DO, RN, NP, PA) with license number, issuing state board, issue/expiration dates, status, and renewal history; (2) DEA controlled substance registrations with DEA number, schedule authorizations (II-V), state of registration, registration status, business activity type, and expiration date; (3) Specialty board certifications (ABMS, AOA, ABNS, and other recognized boards) with certifying board, specialty certified, certification number, initial certification date, expiration date, MOC (Maintenance of Certification) status, and recertification history; (4) CME (Continuing Medical Education) activity tracking with activity title, accrediting organization (AMA PRA, ACCME), activity type (live, enduring, performance improvement), credit hours, completion date, specialty relevance, and CME category (Category 1, Category 2). Tracks credential type, issuing authority, verification source, and primary source verification status for all credential types. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all provider credentialing artifacts — no other product in this domain stores license, certification, DEA registration, board certification, or CME data. Supports HIPAA-compliant credentialing workflows, state licensure verification, board certification verification, DEA compliance, CME compliance for licensure renewal, and pharmacy order validation for controlled substances.
products.reference: State Medical Board, NURSYS, DEA Registration

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each credential record in the provider credentialing master. Primary key for the credential data product.

attributes.name: authorized_cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Procedure-specific credentials (surgical certifications, interventional licenses) authorize performance of specific CPT codes. Healthcare operations use this for privilege delineation, peer review cas

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual clinician or healthcare professional who holds this credential. Links to the provider master record.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: DEA credentials authorize controlled substance prescribing by schedule (II-V). Material_master tracks controlled substances with dea_schedule. Link enables regulatory compliance verification that clin

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Credentials are specialty-specific (e.g., board certifications, specialty licenses). credential.specialty_name should be normalized to specialty table. FK will be populated at credential creation.

attributes.name: training_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training. Business justification: Credentials like DEA X-waiver require documented training completion. Credentialing systems verify training prerequisites before credential issuance/renewal per regulatory requirements (e.g., 8-hour b

attributes.name: board_action_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent disciplinary action or adverse action was taken by the issuing authority against this credential. Null if no board action exists. Used in conjunction with board_action_flag for credentialing compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; State Medical Practice Acts; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: board_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a disciplinary action, sanction, reprimand, or adverse action has been taken by the issuing authority against this credential. True = board action exists; False = no board action. Triggers mandatory review in credentialing and privileging workflows.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; State Medical Practice Acts; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; OIG LEIE

attributes.name: caqh_submitted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare (CAQH) ProView Submitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential has been submitted to the CAQH ProView universal credentialing database. CAQH ProView is the industry-standard repository used by most commercial payers for provider credentialing and enrollment verification.
attributes.references: CAQH ProView Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment 42 CFR Part 424

attributes.name: certifying_board_name
attributes.description: Full name of the specialty board that issued the board certification (e.g., 'American Board of Internal Medicine', 'American Board of Surgery', 'American Osteopathic Board of Internal Medicine'). Applicable only to board certification credential types.
attributes.references: ABMS Board Certification Standards; AOA Specialty Board Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: cme_accrediting_organization
attributes.description: The organization that accredited the CME activity (e.g., 'AMA PRA', 'ACCME', 'ANCC', 'ACPE'). Determines whether the CME credits are recognized for state licensure renewal and board recertification purposes.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards; ANCC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: cme_activity_title
attributes.description: The official title of the CME (Continuing Medical Education) activity as designated by the accrediting organization. Applicable only to CME activity credential types. Used for CME compliance tracking and licensure renewal documentation.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards

attributes.name: cme_activity_type
attributes.description: The format or delivery modality of the CME activity as classified by the accrediting organization (e.g., live conference, enduring material, performance improvement activity). Applicable only to CME activity credential types.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards for Commercial Support; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards

attributes.name: cme_category
attributes.description: The AMA PRA CME category designation for this activity. Category 1 credits are formally accredited and required for most state licensure renewals; Category 2 credits are self-designated and have more limited acceptance.
attributes.references: AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards; State Medical Board CME Requirements

attributes.name: cme_credit_hours
attributes.description: The number of CME credit hours awarded upon completion of this CME activity. Used to track cumulative CME hours for state licensure renewal requirements and board recertification MOC compliance.
attributes.references: ACCME Standards; AMA PRA Category 1 Credit Standards; State Medical Board CME Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements under HIPAA, HITRUST, and ISO 27001 for credentialing data governance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: credential_number
attributes.description: The externally-issued identifier for this credential as assigned by the issuing authority (e.g., state license number, DEA registration number, board certification number, CME activity ID). This is the official reference number used in regulatory and payer verification workflows.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; State Medical Practice Acts; ABMS Board Certification Standards; ACCME Standards for Commercial Support

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credential as reported by the issuing authority or verified through primary source verification. Active credentials authorize clinical practice; expired or revoked credentials trigger immediate workflow alerts in credentialing and pharmacy order validation systems.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: credential_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the credential record. Distinguishes among state medical/nursing licenses, DEA controlled substance registrations, specialty board certifications, and CME (Continuing Medical Education) activity completions. Drives downstream workflow routing in credentialing and privileging systems such as Symplr.
attributes.references: Symplr Credentialing; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: days_to_expiration
attributes.description: The number of days remaining until this credential expires, calculated from the current date to the expiration_date. Used for proactive renewal alerting and credentialing dashboard KPIs. Negative values indicate the credential is already expired.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: dea_business_activity_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) Business Activity Type
attributes.description: The DEA-designated business activity type associated with the DEA registration. Defines the authorized scope of controlled substance handling (e.g., practitioner prescribing vs. hospital dispensing vs. research). Applicable only to DEA registration credential types.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; DEA Registration Application Form 224

attributes.name: dea_schedule_authorizations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of controlled substance schedule authorizations granted under this DEA registration (e.g., 'II,III,IV,V'). Applicable only to DEA registration credential types. Used by pharmacy order validation systems (Epic Willow, Cerner PharmNet) to authorize controlled substance prescribing.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; Controlled Substances Act; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this credential record is considered effective and authorizes clinical practice or activity. For state licenses and DEA registrations, this aligns with the issue_date. For board certifications, this is the initial certification effective date. Supports temporal validity queries.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; FHIR Practitioner Resource

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this credential record is considered effective. Aligns with expiration_date for most credential types. Null for open-ended or lifetime credentials. Supports SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) and temporal validity queries in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; FHIR Practitioner Resource

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credential expires and must be renewed or recertified to remain valid. Null for credentials with no expiration (e.g., certain lifetime board certifications). Drives automated renewal alerts in Symplr and Epic credentialing workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credential was originally issued or first conferred by the issuing authority. For board certifications, this is the initial certification date. For CME activities, this is the activity completion date.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; ABMS Board Certification Standards; ACCME Standards

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the organization or governmental body that issued or confers this credential (e.g., 'Texas Medical Board', 'U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration', 'American Board of Internal Medicine', 'American Medical Association — PRA'). Used for primary source verification routing.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory abbreviation where the credential was issued. Applicable to state medical licenses and DEA state-specific registrations. Null for federal DEA registrations, board certifications, and CME activities that are not state-specific.
attributes.references: State Medical Practice Acts; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; FSMB Interstate Medical Licensure Compact

attributes.name: moc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's compliance with the Maintenance of Certification (MOC) program requirements for this board certification. MOC compliance is required by many hospitals for privileging and by payers for network participation. Applicable only to board certification credential types.
attributes.references: ABMS MOC Program Requirements; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing staff to document relevant context, exceptions, or special circumstances associated with this credential record (e.g., pending renewal documentation, board action history, conditional license restrictions). Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: npdb_queried
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Queried Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) was queried as part of the credentialing verification process for this provider. NPDB queries are required by CMS and The Joint Commission for initial credentialing and re-credentialing.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: npdb_query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Query Date
attributes.description: The date on which the NPDB was queried for this provider's credentialing record. Required documentation for CMS and Joint Commission credentialing compliance audits.
attributes.references: NPDB Regulations 45 CFR Part 60; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_check_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the OIG LEIE (List of Excluded Individuals/Entities) was checked for this provider. CMS recommends monthly screening; documents compliance for RAC audits and OIG investigations.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Advisory Opinion 98-14

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion List Checked Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OIG (Office of Inspector General) List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE) was checked for this provider as part of credentialing. OIG exclusion screening is required by CMS; employing an excluded provider can result in significant civil monetary penalties.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG Advisory Opinion 98-14

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is required for or submitted as part of payer enrollment and network participation applications. True = credential is submitted to payers (e.g., state license, DEA, board certification); False = not required for payer enrollment.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment 42 CFR Part 424; CAQH ProView Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: primary_source_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential has been verified directly with the issuing authority (primary source verification). True = verified with issuing authority; False = not yet primary source verified. Required for NCQA and Joint Commission credentialing accreditation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

attributes.name: privileging_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is directly relevant to the provider's hospital privileging determination. True = this credential is required or considered in the privileging decision; False = informational only (e.g., a CME activity not tied to a specific privilege).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482.12

attributes.name: psv_date
attributes.description: The date on which primary source verification was completed for this credential. NCQA and The Joint Commission require re-verification at defined intervals (typically every 3 years). Drives re-verification scheduling in Symplr.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; URAC Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: psv_method
attributes.description: The method used to conduct primary source verification of this credential (e.g., online query to state medical board database, written confirmation from issuing authority, electronic query via NPDB or OIG). Documents the verification audit trail for accreditation surveys.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; NPDB Data Bank Regulations

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider must complete recredentialing for this credential to maintain active status. NCQA and The Joint Commission require recredentialing at least every 3 years. Drives workflow queues in Symplr and credentialing management systems.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credential was most recently renewed or recertified by the issuing authority. Tracks the renewal history cycle for compliance reporting and credentialing re-verification workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; State Medical Practice Acts; ABMS MOC Program

attributes.name: restriction_description
attributes.description: Description of any restrictions, conditions, or limitations placed on this credential by the issuing authority (e.g., 'Supervised practice only', 'No DEA Schedule II prescribing', 'Probationary license'). Null if no restrictions apply.
attributes.references: State Medical Practice Acts; DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: sam_exclusion_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Award Management (SAM) Exclusion Checked Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SAM.gov federal exclusions database was checked for this provider. SAM exclusion screening is required for providers participating in federal healthcare programs (Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP).
attributes.references: SAM.gov Federal Exclusions; CMS Conditions of Participation; FAR 52.209-6

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this credential record was sourced or last updated (e.g., Symplr Credentialing, Epic, Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH Expanse, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and ETL audit trails in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this credential record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Symplr credential record ID, Epic provider record ID). Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the source system for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the credential type. For state licenses: MD, DO, RN, NP, PA, CRNA, PharmD, etc. For DEA registrations: Schedule II, III, IV, V authorization. For board certifications: ABMS, AOA, ABNS, or other recognized board specialty. For CME: Category 1 or Category 2. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MD|DO|RN|NP|PA|CRNA|PharmD|Schedule_II|Schedule_III|Schedule_IV|Schedule_V|ABMS|AOA|ABNS|CME_Cat1|CME_Cat2 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT; DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; ABMS Board Certification Standards; AMA PRA Category 1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential record was most recently modified. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer ETL pipeline and audit trail requirements under HIPAA and HITRUST.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; SOC 2

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: Indicates the source used to verify this credential. Primary source verification (PSV) is required by NCQA, The Joint Commission, and CMS for credentialing. Secondary source verification uses intermediary databases. Self-reported credentials have not been independently verified.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR Part 482

products.name: privileging
products.description: Tracks clinical privileges granted to individual clinicians at specific facilities, authorizing them to perform defined procedures and services. Captures privilege category, procedure list, granting facility, privilege status (active, provisional, suspended, revoked), effective and expiration dates, and approving medical staff committee. Core to EMTALA compliance and Joint Commission accreditation.
products.reference: The Joint Commission MS.06.01.03, EMTALA

attributes.name: privileging_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each clinical privileging record granted to a clinician at a specific facility. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03 — Medical Staff Privileging Standards

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Clinical privileges are audited for compliance with credentialing standards (TJC MS.06.01.05, CMS 482.12). Compliance teams audit privilege files for documentation of training, case volume, FPPE/OPPE,

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific hospital, clinic, or healthcare facility at which the clinical privileges are granted and exercised. Privileges are facility-specific per Joint Commission standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Joint Commission and CMS require hospitals to delineate specific CPT-coded procedures each clinician is privileged to perform. Privileging committees use CPT codes to define procedure-level authorizat

attributes.name: icd_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.icd_code. Business justification: Surgical and procedural privileges reference ICD-10-PCS procedure codes for delineation of clinical privileges. Medical staff offices use these codes to define procedure-specific authorization scope a

attributes.name: modality_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to radiology.modality. Business justification: Clinical privileges in radiology are modality-specific — a clinician may be privileged for MRI-guided procedures but not fluoroscopy. Linking privileging to modality supports credentialing committees,

attributes.name: privileging_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed clinician or healthcare professional to whom clinical privileges are granted. Links to the provider master record.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: privileging_proctor_provider_clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervising or proctoring physician assigned to observe and evaluate the clinician during the provisional privilege period. Required when is_provisional is True.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.service. Business justification: Joint Commission Delineation of Clinical Privileges requires privileges to be tied to specific clinical service lines (e.g., cardiac surgery service). Medical Staff Offices track privilege grants by s

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Clinical privileges are granted for specific specialties. privileging.specialty_code and specialty_name should reference specialty table as authoritative source.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the approving medical staff committee formally voted to grant or renew the clinical privileges. Distinct from the effective date, which may be retroactive or future-dated.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: board_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether board certification in the relevant specialty is a prerequisite for granting this privilege per the facility's medical staff bylaws. True when board certification is required.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: completed_case_volume
attributes.description: Actual number of cases or procedures performed by the clinician under this privilege during the current privilege period. Used for ongoing competency assessment and reappointment decisions.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; ACGME Competency Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this privileging record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA Security Rule audit control requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: delineation_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privilege delineation form used to define the scope of this privilege grant. Tracks which version of the approved privilege form was in effect at the time of granting, supporting audit and accreditation review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege grant becomes active and the clinician is authorized to perform the privileged procedures at the facility. Binding start date per medical staff bylaws.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: emtala_covered
attributes.business_glossary_term: Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act (EMTALA) Coverage Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this privilege covers emergency on-call obligations under EMTALA (Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act). True when the clinician is authorized and obligated to respond to emergency department on-call requests under this privilege.
attributes.references: EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24; CMS Conditions of Participation; OIG EMTALA Compliance

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege grant expires and must be renewed through the reappointment process. Typically aligned with the medical staff reappointment cycle (commonly every 2 years per TJC standards).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: fppe_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) Completion Date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) was completed and findings were submitted to the medical staff committee. Null when FPPE is not required or not yet completed.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.03 — Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE)

attributes.name: fppe_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) is required for this privilege grant. FPPE is mandatory for all new privileges and triggered by performance concerns per TJC standards. True when FPPE is required.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.03 — Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE)

attributes.name: is_provisional
attributes.description: Indicates whether the privilege is granted on a provisional basis, requiring supervision or proctoring during an initial evaluation period before full privileges are confirmed. True when provisional; False when full privileges are granted.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: malpractice_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician's malpractice/professional liability insurance coverage has been verified as current and meeting the facility's minimum coverage requirements at the time of privilege grant. True when verified.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; State Departments of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: npdb_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the adverse action was reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB). Must occur within 15 days of the adverse action per HCQIA requirements. Null when no NPDB report is required.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook

attributes.name: npdb_report_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) Report Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse action report to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) is required for this privilege action (e.g., suspension >30 days, revocation). True triggers mandatory NPDB reporting workflow.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; HHS OIG

attributes.name: oppe_last_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) Last Review Date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recent Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) review for this privilege. OPPE must occur at regular intervals (at least every 12 months) per TJC standards to support reappointment.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01 — Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE)

attributes.name: peer_review_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or rating assigned during the most recent peer review or focused professional practice evaluation (FPPE) or ongoing professional practice evaluation (OPPE) for this privilege. Used to support reappointment decisions. Sensitive business-confidential data.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.08.01.01 (OPPE); MS.08.01.03 (FPPE); NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: privilege_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the privilege type granted. Clinical covers general patient care; surgical covers operative procedures; procedural covers invasive non-surgical acts; diagnostic covers imaging/interpretation; prescriptive covers medication authority; administrative covers leadership roles.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: privilege_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scope and limitations of the clinical privilege, including any conditions, supervision requirements, or volume thresholds specified by the medical staff committee.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: privilege_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the clinical privilege granted (e.g., 'Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy', 'Cardiac Catheterization', 'Endotracheal Intubation'). Sourced from the facility's approved privilege delineation form.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; AMA CPT Coding Standards

attributes.name: privilege_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the medical staff office to uniquely reference this privileging grant. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and credentialing system lookups (e.g., Symplr privilege record number).
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: privilege_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the clinical privilege grant. Active indicates full authorization; provisional indicates supervised practice during initial period; suspended indicates temporary removal pending investigation; revoked indicates permanent removal; expired indicates lapsed without renewal; pending indicates awaiting committee approval.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22; EMTALA 42 CFR §489.24

attributes.name: privilege_type
attributes.description: Specific classification of the privilege grant. Core privileges are standard for the specialty; special privileges require additional training; temporary privileges are time-limited; telemedicine covers remote care delivery; locum tenens covers temporary coverage providers; disaster privileges are emergency-activated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|special|temporary|telemedicine|locum_tenens|disaster|provisional — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: provisional_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the provisional privilege period ends and the clinician transitions to full privileges, contingent on satisfactory proctoring evaluation. Null when privilege is not provisional.

attributes.name: reappointment_cycle_years
attributes.description: Number of years in the medical staff reappointment cycle for this privilege (typically 2 years per TJC standards). Determines the frequency of privilege renewal and competency review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.22

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinician submitted the privilege request or reappointment application to the medical staff office. Used to track processing turnaround time and compliance with credentialing timelines.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1

attributes.name: required_case_volume
attributes.description: Minimum number of cases or procedures the clinician must perform within the privilege period to demonstrate competency and maintain the privilege. Set by the medical staff committee based on specialty standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; ACGME Competency Framework

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was permanently revoked, if applicable. Null when privilege has not been revoked. Triggers mandatory NPDB adverse action report within 15 days.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for permanent privilege revocation, such as gross negligence, criminal conviction, license revocation, or sustained peer review findings. Sensitive business-confidential information required for NPDB adverse action reporting.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; OIG Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this privileging record in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr privilege record ID, Epic credentialing record ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this privileging record originated (e.g., SYMPLR for Symplr Credentialing, EPIC for Epic OpTime/Cadence, CERNER for Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH for MEDITECH Expanse, MANUAL for paper-based entry).
attributes.references: ISO 27001 Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was suspended, if applicable. Null when privilege has never been suspended. Required for adverse action reporting to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB).
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for privilege suspension, such as patient safety concern, peer review finding, license lapse, or investigation pending. Sensitive business-confidential information used for adverse action documentation and NPDB reporting.
attributes.references: Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) 42 USC §11101; NPDB Guidebook; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; OIG Fraud and Abuse

attributes.name: telemedicine_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this privilege extends to telemedicine or telehealth delivery of the authorized services. True when the clinician is authorized to perform the privileged activity via remote/virtual care modalities.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; CMS Telemedicine Conditions of Participation 42 CFR §482.12(a)(8); State Telehealth Laws

attributes.name: training_requirement_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinician has satisfied all required training, education, or competency documentation prerequisites for this privilege as defined on the privilege delineation form. True when all training requirements are verified.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; ACGME Competency Framework; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this privileging record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing for the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR §164.312(b); ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

products.name: network_affiliation
products.description: Association record linking clinicians and organizational providers to payer networks, ACOs, HMOs, PPOs, and integrated care networks. Captures network name, network tier, participation type, effective and termination dates, panel status (open/closed), and geographic service area. Supports provider directory accuracy and network adequacy reporting required by CMS.
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA

attributes.name: network_affiliation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each provider network affiliation record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific facility or practice location at which the provider participates in this network. A provider may have multiple network affiliations at different facility locations.
attributes.references: CMS Facility Enrollment; CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 45 CFR 156.230

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual clinician or organizational provider associated with this network affiliation record. Links to the provider master entity.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.fee_schedule. Business justification: Each network affiliation has an associated fee schedule governing reimbursement rates for that provider-payer-network combination. Replacing the denormalized reimbursement_model text with a proper FK

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the medical group or group practice through which the individual provider participates in this network. Many payer contracts are held at the group level, with individual providers enrolled under the group.
attributes.references: CMS Group Practice Enrollment; NPI Type 2 (Organizational NPI); CAQH ProView

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.health_plan. Business justification: Network affiliations are health-plan-specific: a provider may be in-network for a payer's HMO but not their PPO. Member-facing directory accuracy, claims adjudication, and CMS network adequacy filings

attributes.name: org_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: Organizational providers have network affiliations in addition to individual clinicians. FK will be NULL for clinician-only affiliations. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: payer_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider contract or participation agreement governing the terms of this network affiliation, including reimbursement rates and obligations. Links to the contract management system.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Contracting; OIG Compliance; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health insurance payer or managed care organization that owns or administers the network to which the provider is affiliated.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific payer network or care network (ACO, HMO, PPO, POS) to which the provider is affiliated.

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Network participation is specialty-specific. network_affiliation.specialty_code and specialty_description should reference specialty table.

attributes.name: accepts_new_patients
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients within this network. Distinct from panel_status in that it reflects the provider's current operational availability rather than the formal panel designation.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy; CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 45 CFR 156.230

attributes.name: aco_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is a participating member of an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) under this network affiliation. ACO participation drives shared savings calculations and quality reporting under CMS MSSP and Next Gen ACO programs.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP); 42 CFR 425; CMS ACO Regulations

attributes.name: affiliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider's network affiliation. 'active' indicates the provider is currently participating and eligible to see network patients. 'pending' indicates enrollment is in process. 'suspended' indicates temporary hold pending investigation or credentialing review.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; Symplr Credentialing; CAQH ProView

attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum patient age (in years) that the provider accepts within this network affiliation. Null indicates no upper age limit. Used for provider directory filtering and patient-to-provider matching.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum patient age (in years) that the provider accepts within this network affiliation. Used for provider directory filtering and patient-to-provider matching in managed care systems.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider's credentialing with this network expires and re-credentialing must be completed. Typically occurs every two years per NCQA standards. Used to trigger re-credentialing workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the provider with the payer or network organization. Credentialing must be completed before a provider can be listed as in-network. Tracked via Symplr or CAQH ProView.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission MS.06; Symplr Credentialing; CAQH ProView

attributes.name: directory_published_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider network affiliation record has been published in the payer's public-facing provider directory. CMS requires accurate and up-to-date provider directories for all Medicare Advantage and Marketplace plans.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 42 CFR 422.111; 45 CFR 156.230

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's participation in the network becomes effective and the provider is eligible to see in-network patients. Used for claims adjudication and provider directory accuracy.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; 42 CFR 422.204; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: gender_served
attributes.description: Indicates the patient gender population served by the provider within this network (e.g., all genders, male only, female only, pediatric). Used for provider directory accuracy and patient matching.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; ACA Section 1557; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: geographic_service_area
attributes.description: Description of the geographic region or service area covered by this network affiliation (e.g., state name, county, metropolitan statistical area, or CMS-defined service area). Used for network adequacy geographic analysis and CMS service area filings.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Geographic Standards; 42 CFR 422.112; 45 CFR 156.230

attributes.name: handicap_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider's practice location associated with this network affiliation is handicap accessible per ADA requirements. Required for CMS provider directory accuracy and ADA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA); CMS Provider Directory Requirements; Section 504 Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network affiliation record pertains to a hospital or facility provider (as opposed to an individual clinician). Used to distinguish facility-level from practitioner-level network participation in directory and adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: languages_spoken
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages spoken by the provider at this network location, using ISO 639-1 language codes. Required for provider directory accuracy and CMS language access compliance under Section 1557 of the ACA.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1557; CMS Provider Directory Requirements; ISO 639-1

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the network affiliation information was last verified against the payer's provider directory or credentialing source. CMS requires provider directories to be updated at least every 90 days.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements; 42 CFR 422.111; 45 CFR 156.230; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is eligible for Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) reporting under this network affiliation. MIPS eligibility affects payment adjustments under MACRA and is tracked at the provider-payer level.
attributes.references: CMS MIPS; MACRA 42 CFR 414 Subpart O; CMS Quality Payment Program

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: Provider category used for CMS and state network adequacy analysis. Classifies the provider's role in meeting time-and-distance and appointment availability standards required for network certification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary_care|specialist|behavioral_health|hospital|ancillary|pharmacy — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; 45 CFR 156.230; 42 CFR 422.112; NCQA Standards

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Tiered network designation indicating the provider's cost and quality tier within the payer's network structure. Tier 1 typically represents highest-value providers with lowest patient cost-sharing; higher tiers carry greater patient out-of-pocket costs.
attributes.references: CMS Tiered Network Standards; NCQA Network Adequacy; 45 CFR 156.230

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes or comments related to this network affiliation record, such as special contract terms, exceptions, or credentialing remarks entered by network management staff.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the provider participating in this network affiliation. Used for claims routing and provider directory publication.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA Administrative Simplification 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: panel_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of patients the provider is willing to accept within this network. Used for network adequacy analysis and patient assignment in managed care models such as HMO and ACO.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy; NCQA Standards; ACO Participation Requirements

attributes.name: panel_current_count
attributes.description: Current number of attributed or assigned patients on the provider's panel within this network. Used alongside panel_capacity to determine panel availability and support network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy; NCQA Standards; ACO Attribution Models

attributes.name: panel_status

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: service_area_state

attributes.name: service_area_zip_code

attributes.name: source_record_reference

products.name: group

attributes.name: org_provider_id

attributes.name: accepts_new_patients
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider group is currently accepting new patients. Used in patient-facing provider directories, referral management workflows in Salesforce Health Cloud, and network access reporting.

attributes.name: aco_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider group is a participating entity in a CMS Accountable Care Organization (ACO) program such as the Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP). Drives value-based care reporting and shared savings calculations.

attributes.name: admin_contact_email

attributes.name: billing_entity_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the billing entity through which the provider group submits professional claims (CMS-1500 / 837P). May differ from the group name when a management services organization (MSO) or billing company handles claims on behalf of the group.

attributes.name: billing_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit NPI of the billing entity used on professional claims (CMS-1500 / 837P) when the billing entity differs from the group NPI. Supports accurate remittance reconciliation and ERA (Electronic Remittance Advice) matching.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider group's primary payer or health system contract became effective. Used for billing eligibility validation, retroactive claim adjudication, and contract lifecycle management.

attributes.name: contract_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider group's primary contract was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null if the contract is open-ended or currently active. Used for claims eligibility cutoff and network directory updates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the provider group record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and SCD Type 2 history management. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider group's current credentialing cycle expires and recredentialing must be completed. NCQA requires recredentialing at least every three years. Used to trigger recredentialing workflows in Symplr.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the provider group as maintained by the health system's medical staff office or delegated credentialing entity. Drives authorization to treat patients and submit claims. Aligned with NCQA credentialing standards and Symplr credentialing workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.03; Symplr Credentialing

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: The trade name or doing-business-as (DBA) name under which the provider group operates publicly, if different from the legal name. Used in patient-facing directories and marketing materials.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider group record became operationally effective within the health system's provider master. Used for temporal validity tracking and SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) management in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: fqhc_designation

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: The official legal name of the medical group practice or physician organization as registered with state authorities and CMS NPPES. Used on contracts, claims, and payer directories.
attributes.references: CMS NPPES; State Department of Health — Facility Licensing

attributes.name: group_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider group record. Active indicates the group is operational and credentialed; pending indicates enrollment or credentialing in progress; suspended indicates temporary hold; terminated indicates the group is no longer operational or contracted.
attributes.references: Symplr — Credentialing and Provider Enrollment; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the provider group's organizational model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_specialty|multi_specialty|fqhc|rhc|independent_practice_association|accountable_care_organization|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS — FQHC/RHC Program Requirements; MACRA/APM Framework; NCQA ACO Standards

attributes.name: hl7_fhir_organization_reference
attributes.description: The FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) Organization resource ID for this provider group, used in HL7 FHIR R4 API exchanges with payers, HIEs (Health Information Exchanges), and external systems. Supports interoperability under the CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule.
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR R4 — Organization Resource; CMS Interoperability and Patient Access Rule — 45 CFR § 170.315; ONC 21st Century Cures Act

attributes.name: languages_supported
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of languages (ISO 639-1 codes) spoken by clinical staff within the provider group. Used for patient-provider matching, CLAS (Culturally and Linguistically Appropriate Services) compliance, and SDOH-informed care access reporting.
attributes.references: HHS National CLAS Standards; NCQA Multicultural Health Care Standards; ISO 639-1 Language Codes

attributes.name: last_credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent credentialing or recredentialing review was completed and approved for the provider group. Used for audit trails and NCQA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards CR 1; The Joint Commission (TJC) MS.06.01.05

attributes.name: medicaid_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Enrollment status of the provider group with the state Medicaid program. Determines eligibility to bill Medicaid for covered services. Managed at the state level through state Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS).
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Provider Enrollment Requirements; State Departments of Health — Medicaid MMIS; 42 CFR § 455

attributes.name: medicare_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Enrollment status of the provider group with the Medicare program as reported in PECOS (Provider Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System). Determines eligibility to bill Medicare Part B for professional services.
attributes.references: CMS PECOS — Provider Enrollment, Chain, and Ownership System; CMS 855B Enrollment Application; 42 CFR § 424.500

attributes.name: mips_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider group meets CMS eligibility thresholds for participation in MIPS (Merit-based Incentive Payment System) under MACRA. Drives quality reporting obligations and payment adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: mips_group_reporting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider group has elected to report MIPS quality measures at the group level (using the group NPI/TIN) rather than at the individual clinician level. Affects CMS payment adjustment calculations.

attributes.name: network_participation_status
attributes.description: Current network participation status of the provider group within the health system's contracted payer networks. Drives patient cost-sharing calculations, referral eligibility, and network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards; CMS Network Adequacy Requirements; ACA § 1311(c)(1)(B)

attributes.name: payer_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Aggregate enrollment status of the provider group with payers. Indicates whether the group is actively enrolled to submit claims with its contracted payers. Detailed per-payer enrollment is tracked in the provider_payer_enrollment product.

attributes.name: primary_fax

attributes.name: primary_phone

attributes.name: primary_service_address_line1

attributes.name: primary_service_city
attributes.description: City of the provider group's primary service location. Used for geographic network analysis, payer directory accuracy, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: primary_service_state

attributes.name: primary_service_zip
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the provider group's primary service location. Used for geographic network adequacy analysis, HEDIS reporting, and SDOH (Social Determinants of Health) stratification.

attributes.name: rhc_designation

attributes.name: size

attributes.name: source_system

products.name: group_membership
products.description: Association record capturing the complete current and historical membership, affiliations, and employment relationships of individual clinicians within provider groups, hospitals, health systems, academic medical centers, and other organizational entities. Provides complete affiliation history for credentialing primary source verification (work history verification is mandatory per NCQA and Joint Commission), NPDB adverse action reporting context, billing attribution, and workforce planning. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all clinician-to-organization affiliation and employment history records — no other product in this domain stores affiliation history or organizational membership data.
