attributes.description: Current outstanding balance on the payment plan after all payments to date have been applied. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative sum of all payments received and applied to this payment plan to date, including down payment and all installments. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: total_plan_amount
attributes.description: Total amount to be paid under the payment plan, including any interest, fees, or finance charges. May equal original balance for interest-free plans. Expressed in USD.

domains.name: claim
domains.description: Insurance claims processing and payer adjudication. Owns claim submission, claim status tracking, payer adjudication, remittance advice (ERA - Electronic Remittance Advice), EOB (Explanation of Benefits), denial management, appeals, prior authorization, eligibility verification, payer contract management, RAC audit responses, and coordination of benefits across HMO, PPO, POS, Medicare, and Medicaid payers.
domains.references: X12 EDI 837/835/270/271, HIPAA Transaction Standards, CMS Claims Processing Manual

products.name: claim
products.description: Core master record for every insurance claim submitted to a payer. SSOT for claim identity, type (professional CMS-1500, facility UB-04, dental), status lifecycle (submitted, accepted, adjudicated, denied, appealed, paid), financial totals (billed, allowed, paid amounts), payer-assigned and internal claim numbers, place of service, bill type, admission/discharge details. Includes DRG assignment attributes (DRG code, weight, MDC, grouper version, base payment rate, outlier amounts) for inpatient facility claims. Includes diagnosis code associations (up to 25 ICD-10-CM codes per claim with sequence, POA indicator, and DRG grouper input flag per UB-04/CMS-1500 specifications). Captures principal diagnosis (ICD-10) and procedure (CPT/HCPCS), and submission channel (EDI 837P/837I, paper). Sourced from Epic Resolute PB/HB and Cerner Revenue Cycle.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code

attributes.name: denial_reason_description

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: Date the patient was discharged from the facility. Required for institutional claims to calculate length of stay.

attributes.name: paid_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the payer issued payment to the provider for this claim. Corresponds to the remittance advice date.

attributes.name: patient_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: Total amount the patient is responsible for paying, including deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance as determined by the payer.

attributes.name: payer_claim_number
attributes.description: Unique claim identifier assigned by the payer organization upon receipt or adjudication. Also known as payer control number (PCN).

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the location where services were rendered (e.g., 11 for office, 21 for inpatient hospital, 23 for emergency department).

attributes.name: primary_payer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim was submitted to the primary insurance payer. True for primary claims, false for secondary or tertiary claims.

attributes.name: rac_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim has been selected for or is under review by a Recovery Audit Contractor for potential overpayment recovery.

attributes.name: service_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period covered by this claim. For professional claims, this is the date services began.

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period covered by this claim. For single-day services, this equals service_from_date.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this claim record originated (e.g., Epic Resolute PB, Epic Resolute HB, Cerner Revenue Cycle).

attributes.name: source_system_claim_code
attributes.description: Original unique identifier for this claim in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Channel or method used to submit the claim to the payer. EDI 837P for professional claims, EDI 837I for institutional claims.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the claim was submitted to the payer for adjudication. Critical for tracking timely filing requirements.

attributes.name: total_allowed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount the payer has determined is allowable for the services rendered, based on contracted rates or fee schedules. May be less than billed amount.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: Total charges submitted to the payer for all services on this claim, before any adjustments or payments. Represents the provider's full charge master pricing.

attributes.name: total_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the payer to the provider for this claim, after applying deductibles, coinsurance, and other patient responsibility amounts.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this claim record was last modified in the revenue cycle management system.

attributes.name: service_description

attributes.name: service_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the service period for this line item. For single-day services, this matches the service from date.

attributes.name: units_of_service

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Supports up to 25 diagnosis codes per claim per UB-04 and CMS-1500 specifications. Critical for DRG assignment, quality reporting, and RAC audit defense.

attributes.name: laterality

attributes.name: poa_indicator

Captures status code, status description, status category (payer-defined vs. internal), effective timestamp, source system, user or automated process that triggered the transition, and associated payer response codes. Supports real-time claim tracking per ANSI X12 276/277 transaction sets and enables SLA monitoring for timely filing compliance.
products.reference: ANSI X12 276/277 Claim Status

attributes.name: claim_status_history_id
attributes.description: Primary key for status_history

attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim for which this status transition was recorded. Links to the claim master record.

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status transition is associated with an appeal or reconsideration request. True if the status change is part of an appeal workflow; False otherwise. Supports denial management and appeals tracking.

attributes.name: check_or_eft_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Check or Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Number
attributes.description: The check number or Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) trace number associated with the payment that triggered this status transition to a paid state. Null if no payment was issued. Used for payment reconciliation and cash application.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_trace_number
attributes.description: The unique trace or reference number assigned by the clearinghouse for this status update transaction. Used for troubleshooting and reconciliation with clearinghouse reports.

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_sequence
attributes.description: The payer sequence number in coordination of benefits (COB) scenarios (1 for primary, 2 for secondary, 3 for tertiary). Indicates which payer this status applies to when multiple payers are involved.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 - Healthcare Claim, CMS Coordination of Benefits Guidelines

attributes.name: corrected_claim_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status transition is associated with a corrected or resubmitted claim (frequency type code 7 in ANSI X12 837). True if this is a corrected claim status; False for original claim submissions.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 837 - Healthcare Claim, CMS Claims Processing Manual

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation time, which may differ slightly from the effective_timestamp if there is processing lag.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF - Audit Logging, SOC 2 - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the claim remained in the prior status before this transition. Calculated metric used for aging analysis, bottleneck identification, and workflow optimization in Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this status became effective for the claim. Represents the real-world business event time of the status transition, critical for Service Level Agreement (SLA) monitoring and timely filing compliance tracking.

attributes.name: is_final_status
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status represents a terminal state in the claim lifecycle (e.g., fully paid, denied and closed, written off). True if no further status transitions are expected; False if the claim remains in an active workflow state.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was last modified. Typically immutable for status history records, but may be updated if corrections or annotations are applied.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF - Audit Logging, SOC 2 - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by revenue cycle staff or system processes to provide additional context for this status transition. May include follow-up actions, payer correspondence details, or resolution steps.

attributes.name: payer_claim_control_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by the payer to this claim, as reported in the 277 or 835 transaction. Critical for payer correspondence, appeals, and coordination of benefits (COB) across Health Maintenance Organization (HMO), Preferred Provider Organization (PPO), Point of Service (POS), Medicare, and Medicaid payers.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 - Healthcare Claim Payment/Advice, CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual

attributes.name: payer_response_code
attributes.description: The standardized response code provided by the payer in the Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) or 277 transaction, indicating the reason for the status (e.g., claim adjustment reason codes, remark codes). Aligns with CARC and RARC code sets.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 - Healthcare Claim Payment/Advice, CMS CARC/RARC Code Lists

attributes.name: payer_response_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of the payer response code, providing additional context for denial management, appeals, and clinical documentation improvement (CDI) efforts.

attributes.name: prior_status_code
attributes.description: The status code that was in effect immediately before this transition. Enables tracking of status progression and identification of status reversals or loops.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this status transition occurred within the defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) timeframe for the claim type and payer contract. True if compliant; False if SLA was breached. Supports operational performance monitoring and payer contract compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Timely Filing Requirements, Payer Contract Terms

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system or module that originated this status transition (e.g., 'Epic Resolute PB', 'Cerner Revenue Cycle', 'Payer Portal', 'Clearinghouse', 'Manual Entry'). Enables traceability and audit of status change origins.

attributes.name: status_category
attributes.description: Classification of the status origin: whether it is a payer-defined status received via Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) or 277 response, an internal workflow state, a system-generated transition, or a manual override by revenue cycle staff.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 835 - Healthcare Claim Payment/Advice, ANSI X12 277 - Claim Status Notification

attributes.name: status_code
attributes.description: The standardized code representing the claim status at this point in time. Aligns with ANSI X12 277 Claim Status Category Codes and internal workflow states.

attributes.name: status_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the claim status, providing context for the status code (e.g., 'Submitted to Payer', 'Pending Additional Information', 'Adjudicated - Paid', 'Denied - Medical Necessity').

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Internal reason or note explaining why this status transition occurred, particularly for manual overrides, appeals, or corrected claims. Supports denial management and Recovery Audit Contractor (RAC) audit responses.

attributes.name: transaction_set_identifier
attributes.description: The ANSI X12 transaction set control number or identifier associated with the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transaction that triggered this status change (e.g., 277 response, 835 ERA). Enables correlation with source EDI files for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 Standards - Transaction Set Control

attributes.name: triggered_by_process
attributes.description: The name of the automated process, batch job, or workflow engine that triggered this status transition (e.g., 'Nightly Clearinghouse Sync', 'ERA Import Job', 'Auto-Denial Workflow'). Null if manually triggered.

attributes.name: void_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this status transition represents a voided or cancelled claim submission (frequency type code 8 in ANSI X12 837). True if the claim was voided; False otherwise.

attributes.name: work_queue_assignment
attributes.description: The name of the revenue cycle work queue or team to which this claim was assigned following this status transition (e.g., 'Denials Management', 'Prior Auth Follow-Up', 'Payment Posting', 'Appeals'). Supports workflow routing and workload balancing.

products.name: remittance

Represents the 835 transaction set containing payer name, payer ID, check/EFT number, payment date, payment amount, payee NPI, and aggregate payment details. SSOT for all ERA transactions received from Medicare, Medicaid, HMO, PPO, and commercial payers. Enables automated payment posting, contractual adjustment calculation, and reconciliation against expected reimbursement per payer contracts.
products.reference: ANSI X12 835 ERA

attributes.name: check_eft_number

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount. Typically USD for U.S. healthcare transactions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_date

attributes.name: group_control_number

attributes.name: provider_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Provider-level adjustment amount applied across all claims in this remittance advice. Represents aggregate adjustments not tied to specific claims (e.g., prior period adjustments, recoupments).

attributes.name: provider_adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for provider-level adjustments. Examples include prior overpayment recovery, interest payment, or administrative adjustments.

attributes.name: received_timestamp

attributes.name: receiver_identification

attributes.name: reconciliation_status

attributes.name: remittance_status

attributes.name: sender_identification

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount

attributes.name: total_allowed_amount

attributes.name: total_billed_amount

attributes.name: total_claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims included in this remittance advice. Represents the aggregate count of all claims adjudicated in this payment batch.

attributes.name: total_patient_responsibility_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for which the patient is responsible across all claims in this remittance advice. Includes deductibles, copayments, and coinsurance.
attributes.references: ANSI ASC X12 835 - CLP05 Segment Aggregation

attributes.name: transaction_set_control_number
attributes.description: Unique control number assigned to the 835 transaction set by the payer. Used for tracking and reconciliation of the Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) transmission.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this remittance advice record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule - 45 CFR 164.312(b) - Audit Controls

products.name: remittance_line

Includes all post-adjudication adjustments: contractual adjustments, write-offs, recoupments, balance transfers, credit balances, manual adjustments, and RAC recoupment entries with adjustment type, reason code, amount, date, source (ERA posting, manual, RAC recoupment, COB), GL account code, and approving user. Enables granular payment reconciliation, underpayment identification, net revenue calculation, and contractual variance analysis per payer contract terms.

attributes.name: balance_transfer_amount

attributes.description: The original amount charged by the provider for the service as submitted on the claim. Represents the gross charge before payer adjudication.

attributes.name: coinsurance_amount
attributes.description: The percentage-based patient responsibility amount after the deductible has been met. Typically expressed as a percentage of the allowed amount.

attributes.name: contractual_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the billed amount and the allowed amount per the payer contract. Represents the write-off amount that the provider has agreed to accept per contractual terms.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed dollar amount the patient is required to pay for the service as defined by their insurance plan. Collected at the time of service or billed to the patient.

attributes.description: The date and time when this remittance line record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: credit_balance_amount
attributes.description: Amount representing an overpayment or credit on the patient or claim account. May require refund processing or application to future services.

attributes.name: deductible_amount

attributes.name: denial_reason_code

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount

attributes.name: patient_responsibility_amount

attributes.description: Current status of the insurance coverage indicating whether it is active, inactive, terminated, suspended, or pending activation.

attributes.name: coverage_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance coverage terminated or will terminate. Null if coverage is ongoing without a known end date.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare coverage being verified: medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, behavioral health, or durable medical equipment (DME).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this eligibility verification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Total annual deductible amount the patient must pay out-of-pocket before insurance coverage begins paying for covered services.

attributes.name: deductible_met_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the annual deductible that has already been met by the patient as of the verification date.

attributes.name: deductible_remaining_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the annual deductible that remains to be met by the patient before insurance coverage begins.

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Insurance group number identifying the employer or organization plan under which the patient is covered.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider or facility for which eligibility is being verified is in-network, out-of-network, or unknown under the patients insurance plan.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum amount the patient is required to pay out-of-pocket for covered services in a plan year, after which the insurance pays 100% of covered expenses.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_met_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the out-of-pocket maximum that has already been met by the patient as of the verification date.

attributes.name: pcp_name
attributes.description: Name of the Primary Care Physician assigned to the patient under this insurance plan, if applicable.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether prior authorization from the payer is required before services can be rendered and covered under this plan.

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a referral from a Primary Care Physician (PCP) is required for specialist visits or certain services under this plan.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the payer or clearinghouse if the eligibility verification request was rejected or could not be processed.

attributes.name: response_code
attributes.description: Standardized code returned by the payer indicating the result of the eligibility verification request (e.g., eligible, not eligible, invalid subscriber).

attributes.name: response_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the eligibility verification response, providing additional context or explanation for the response code.

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date of service for which eligibility is being verified. Used to check coverage status as of a specific date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this eligibility verification record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the eligibility verification was performed, used for reporting and analytics purposes.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the eligibility verification was performed: real-time electronic transaction, batch file submission, manual entry, payer web portal, or phone call.

attributes.name: verification_request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eligibility verification request was submitted to the payer or clearinghouse. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: verification_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eligibility verification response was received from the payer or clearinghouse.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the eligibility verification request indicating whether the transaction has been submitted, is pending payer response, completed successfully, failed, timed out, or was rejected.

attributes.name: verification_transaction_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the eligibility verification transaction, typically the X12 270 transaction control number or system-generated verification request number used for tracking and reconciliation.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Healthcare supply chain and materials management. Owns medical-surgical supplies, implantable device tracking (UDI), prosthetics, procurement, inventory management, requisitions, par-level replenishment, expiration tracking, recall management, vendor management, BOM (Bill of Materials) for surgical procedures, and sterile processing. Integrates with Infor Lawson and SAP MM.
domains.references: FDA UDI (21 CFR Part 830), GS1 Healthcare Standards, ISO 15223

products.name: material_master
products.description: Central master record for all medical-surgical supplies, implantable devices, prosthetics, and consumables in the healthcare supply chain. Stores item identification (UDI, NDC, HCPCS), classification hierarchy, unit of measure, storage requirements, sterility indicators, hazardous material flags, reorder parameters, regulatory attributes (FDA device class), formulary status, preferred vendor, UNSPSC code, GL account mapping, and catalog pricing. SSOT for supply item identity and formulary approval.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Master / Infor Lawson Item Master

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each material master record in the healthcare supply chain. Primary key for the material_master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Item Master

attributes.name: cpt_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.cpt_code. Business justification: Charge Description Master (CDM) management requires linking supply items (implantables, surgical supplies, DME) to CPT codes for charge capture, cost-per-procedure analysis, and reimbursement benchmar

attributes.name: hcpcs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.hcpcs_code. Business justification: Supply items, especially DME and billable medical supplies, require HCPCS codes for reimbursement and formulary management. Enables automated charge capture, contract pricing validation, and payer-spe

attributes.name: ndc_drug_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.ndc_drug. Business justification: Medical supplies and implantables with NDC codes must reference the NDC drug master for accurate product identification, FDA tracking, and recall management. Currently has ndc_code as text. Links supp

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: DEA Schedule II-V materials, FDA Class III devices, and REMS-program drugs carry specific regulatory handling obligations. Linking material_master to the governing obligation enables compliance report

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: Healthcare supply items have payer-specific coverage policies and reimbursement codes. Real business process: determining if a supply item (especially implants, DME) is covered by a specific payer bef

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Medical devices and controlled substances must comply with specific regulatory programs (FDA device tracking, DEA controlled substance programs). Healthcare organizations track which compliance progra

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Healthcare supplies are specialty-specific (orthopedic implants, cardiac catheters). Linking material_master to specialty enables specialty-based formulary management, specialty supply budgeting, and

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supply item was approved for addition to the organization's supply formulary by the Value Analysis Committee (VAC) or equivalent governance body. Marks the start of authorized procurement and use.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission; CMS; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: catalog_price
attributes.description: Standard catalog or list price per stocking unit of measure as published in the item catalog or charge description master (CDM). Used as the baseline for charge capture, contract price comparison, and cost accounting. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS CDM Requirements; SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; GAAP

attributes.name: cdm_charge_code
attributes.description: Charge Description Master (CDM) code linking the supply item to the organization's revenue cycle charge capture system. Used for patient billing, revenue cycle management (RCM), and CMS cost reporting.
attributes.references: CMS CDM Requirements; CMS-1500; UB-04; HFMA

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code representing the organizational unit responsible for the supply item's default cost allocation. Used for departmental budget tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the material master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA and organizational data governance policies.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule (CI through CV) for pharmaceutical items. Determines storage security requirements, dispensing controls, and DEA reporting obligations. Null for non-controlled items.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the supply item was or is scheduled to be discontinued from the formulary and removed from active procurement. Null if the item is currently active. Used for transition planning and inventory rundown management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: fda_device_class
attributes.description: FDA regulatory classification for medical devices: Class I (low risk, general controls), Class II (moderate risk, special controls), or Class III (high risk, premarket approval required). Drives regulatory compliance requirements, approval workflows, and recall risk stratification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Parts 862-892; FDA Device Classification Database; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: fda_product_code
attributes.description: Three-letter FDA product code identifying the specific device type within the FDA's device classification system. Used for regulatory submissions, 510(k) clearance tracking, and adverse event reporting to MedWatch.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; FDA Device Classification Database; MedWatch

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: Indicates the item's approval status on the organization's supply formulary or pharmacy formulary. Controls whether the item can be ordered through standard requisition workflows or requires special approval. Managed by the Value Analysis Committee (VAC).
attributes.references: CMS; NCQA; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; Epic Willow Formulary

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code to which supply item costs are posted upon consumption or purchase. Enables cost center allocation, financial reporting, and budget variance analysis per GAAP and FASB standards.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-assigned Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) used for barcode scanning, automated receiving, and supply chain interoperability. Supports 2D barcode scanning at point of care and integration with GS1 healthcare standards.
attributes.references: GS1 Healthcare; FDA UDI Rule; ISO/IEC 15459

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item is a DEA-scheduled controlled substance requiring enhanced security, chain-of-custody documentation, and DEA reporting. Triggers Willow pharmacy and Pyxis dispensing controls.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; Controlled Substances Act; HIPAA

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, labeling, and disposal per OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom) and EPA regulations. Triggers safety data sheet (SDS) requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; EPA; DOT 49 CFR; NFPA

attributes.name: is_implantable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item is an implantable device requiring UDI tracking, patient implant card issuance, and post-market surveillance per FDA regulations. Triggers mandatory lot/serial tracking and patient-level implant documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; EU MDR 2017/745; The Joint Commission NPSG

attributes.name: is_latex_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item is certified latex-free. Critical for patient safety in latex-allergic patients and required for allergy-safe supply chain management per Joint Commission patient safety standards.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission NPSG; FDA; AORN Guidelines

attributes.name: is_sterile
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item is supplied in a sterile state and requires sterile handling, storage, and processing. Drives sterile processing department (SPD) workflows, storage segregation, and expiration monitoring.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission; AAMI ST79; ISO 11135; OSHA

attributes.name: item_category_code
attributes.description: Internal classification code representing the supply item's position within the organization's commodity hierarchy (e.g., cardiovascular implants, orthopedic prosthetics, wound care). Used for spend analytics, formulary management, and par-level grouping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: item_category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the supply item's commodity category corresponding to item_category_code. Supports reporting, catalog browsing, and clinical staff communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the supply item as it appears in the item catalog and on purchase orders, requisitions, and charge description master (CDM). Provides human-readable identification for clinical and supply chain staff.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; CDM Standards

attributes.name: item_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the supply item within the organization's item catalog (e.g., Infor Lawson item number or SAP material number). Used across procurement, inventory, and clinical systems as the primary business key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Procurement

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material master record indicating whether the item is available for procurement and use. Controls ordering eligibility and inventory replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the supply item by its functional category within the healthcare supply chain. Drives regulatory handling, storage requirements, and charge capture rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical_surgical|implantable_device|prosthetic|pharmaceutical|consumable|capital_equipment|reagent|sterile_supply — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Device Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the material master record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization across integrated systems (Epic, Infor Lawson, SAP), and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order placement to receipt of the supply item from the preferred vendor. Used for reorder point calculation, safety stock determination, and supply chain risk management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Procurement

attributes.name: lot_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether lot/batch number tracking is required for this supply item. Mandatory for implantable devices, biologics, and items subject to FDA recall management. Enables traceability from receipt to patient use.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; FDA UDI Rule; The Joint Commission; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: manufacturer_item_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's own catalog or part number for the supply item. Used for cross-referencing with vendor catalogs, purchase orders, and recall notices. Distinct from the internal item number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Procurement

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the company that manufactures the supply item. Used for vendor management, recall notifications, FDA adverse event reporting, and GPO contract compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Device Registration; SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code (NDC) for pharmaceutical and drug-related supply items. Structured as labeler-product-package segments. Required for pharmacy formulary management, drug charge capture, and CMS billing compliance.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Directory; CMS; 21 CFR Part 207

attributes.name: order_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure used when placing purchase orders with vendors (e.g., CS=case, PK=pack). May differ from the stocking unit of measure. The conversion factor between order UOM and stock UOM is used for receiving and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Procurement

attributes.name: par_level
attributes.description: Periodic Automatic Replenishment (PAR) level representing the target on-hand quantity for this item at a stocking location. Used by supply chain technicians during PAR cart rounds to determine replenishment needs.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The preferred vendor's own catalog or part number for this supply item. Used on purchase orders and for EDI transactions with the vendor. Supports automated order matching and invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; EDI X12 850

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current FDA recall status for the supply item. Class I recalls indicate serious health hazard; Class II indicate temporary adverse health consequences; Class III indicate unlikely health hazard. Triggers quarantine and removal workflows.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA Recall Database; The Joint Commission; OIG

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory quantity level at which a replenishment order is automatically triggered for this supply item. Expressed in the stocking unit of measure. Core parameter for par-level replenishment and stockout prevention.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity to be ordered when the reorder point is reached. Expressed in the order unit of measure. Optimized based on usage patterns, lead time, and storage capacity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory

attributes.name: serial_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual serial number tracking is required for this supply item. Applies to high-value implantable devices and capital equipment requiring unique unit-level traceability for patient safety and recall management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; FDA UDI Rule; The Joint Commission NPSG

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the supply item can be stored from manufacture or receipt before expiration. Drives FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, expiration date tracking, and waste reduction programs.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; The Joint Commission; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: storage_location_type
attributes.description: Required storage environment type for the supply item. Determines physical storage assignment within the warehouse or storeroom and drives compliance with safety and regulatory storage requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; FDA 21 CFR; USP; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this supply item. Used in conjunction with minimum storage temperature to define the acceptable temperature range for storage compliance and cold chain management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; USP <1079>; The Joint Commission; OSHA

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this supply item. Critical for temperature-sensitive biologics, vaccines, and reagents. Used to assign items to appropriate storage locations (refrigerator, freezer, ambient).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; USP <1079>; The Joint Commission; OSHA

attributes.name: udi
attributes.description: FDA-mandated Unique Device Identifier for implantable devices and medical equipment. Composed of a Device Identifier (DI) and Production Identifier (PI). Required for device tracking, recall management, and adverse event reporting under FDA 21 CFR Part 830.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; FDA UDI Rule; HIPAA; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure in which the supply item is stocked, issued, and consumed (e.g., EA=each, BX=box, CS=case, PK=pack, ML=milliliter, GM=gram). Governs inventory counting, par-level management, and charge capture.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; GS1 UOM Standards

attributes.name: unspsc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC)
attributes.description: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC) providing a globally standardized commodity classification for the supply item. Used for spend analytics, group purchasing organization (GPO) benchmarking, and procurement reporting.
attributes.references: UNSPSC Standard; GS1; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: uom_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric conversion factor between the order unit of measure and the stocking unit of measure (e.g., 1 case = 24 each → factor = 24). Used for accurate receiving, inventory valuation, and par-level calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all suppliers, distributors, and manufacturers providing medical supplies, devices, and pharmaceuticals to the healthcare organization. Captures vendor identity, NPI (if applicable), DEA registration, GPO (Group Purchasing Organization) affiliation, contract tier, diversity classification, preferred vendor status, and performance rating. Integrates with SAP MM Vendor Master and Infor Lawson Vendor file.
products.reference: SAP MM Vendor Master / Infor Lawson Vendor

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the vendor record in the healthcare supply chain master. Primary key for the vendor entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Vendor File

attributes.name: npi_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.npi_registry. Business justification: Healthcare vendor credentialing and OIG exclusion screening requires linking vendors to the NPI registry for identity verification, taxonomy validation, and regulatory compliance. Vendor has a plain n

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Vendors must meet compliance program requirements (diversity certification programs, OIG exclusion screening programs, quality assurance programs). Supply chain tracks which compliance programs each v

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the vendor's primary business address (street number and name). Used for purchase order mailing, contract correspondence, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.STRAS); Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the vendor's primary business address (suite, floor, building). Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing address.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor was formally approved by the healthcare organization's value analysis committee or supply chain governance process for use in procurement.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Vendor Credentialing; AHRMM Value Analysis Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for ACH/EFT payment remittance to the vendor. Classified as restricted financial data. Stored in encrypted form per PCI DSS and SOC 2 requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Bank Details (LFBK); NACHA; PCI DSS; SOC 2; ISO 27001

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number for the vendor's bank. Required for ACH and wire transfer payment processing. Classified as restricted financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Bank Details (LFBK); NACHA; ABA Routing Number Standard; PCI DSS

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the vendor's primary business address. Used for geographic analysis, tax jurisdiction determination, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.ORT01); Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current active contract or master purchasing agreement with the vendor. Supply chain teams use this for contract renewal planning and sourcing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; AHRMM Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current active contract or master purchasing agreement with the vendor. Used for contract compliance monitoring and spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; AHRMM Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for the vendor's GPO or direct contract. Tier 1 vendors receive the most favorable pricing. Sole source vendors are the only approved supplier for a specific item.
attributes.references: AHRMM Supply Chain Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the vendor's primary business address. Used for import/export compliance, customs documentation, and international procurement.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.LAND1); FDA Import Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA and SOC 2 record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; HITRUST CSF; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the vendor's invoicing currency (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Used for multi-currency procurement and foreign exchange management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFM1.WAERS); GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: dea_registration_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number for vendors authorized to distribute controlled substances (Schedule I–V). Required for pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty pharmacy distributors. Nullable for non-pharmaceutical vendors.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; Controlled Substances Act; FDA Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA)

attributes.name: diversity_certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor's diversity certification expires. Supply chain teams must track this to ensure continued compliance with diversity spend reporting requirements.
attributes.references: NMSDC; WBENC; SBA 8(a) Program; HHS Supplier Diversity Policy

attributes.name: diversity_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification number issued by the relevant diversity certifying body (e.g., NMSDC, WBENC, SBA). Used to validate diversity status during supplier diversity reporting.
attributes.references: NMSDC; WBENC; SBA 8(a) Program; HHS Supplier Diversity Policy

attributes.name: diversity_classification
attributes.description: Diversity certification classification for the vendor per federal and state supplier diversity programs. Used for regulatory reporting on diverse spend and compliance with CMS and HHS supplier diversity initiatives.
attributes.references: HHS Supplier Diversity Policy; SBA Small Business Standards; NMSDC; WBENC; NVBDC

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the vendor operates, if different from the legal name. Commonly used in vendor communications and catalog references.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supports Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) for purchase order transmission (EDI 850), invoice processing (EDI 810), and advance ship notices (EDI 856).
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards; GS1 Healthcare; Infor Lawson Supply Chain EDI; SAP S/4HANA MM EDI

attributes.name: fda_establishment_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Establishment Number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned establishment registration number for vendors who manufacture, repackage, or relabel medical devices or drugs. Required for device and pharmaceutical manufacturers per FDA 21 CFR Part 807.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 807; FDA Establishment Registration; Medical Device Amendments

attributes.name: fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered line items fulfilled completely by the vendor without backorder or substitution. Critical metric for supply continuity and par-level replenishment reliability.
attributes.references: AHRMM Supply Chain KPI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: gpo_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) through which this vendor holds a contract (e.g., Vizient, Premier, HealthTrust). GPO affiliation determines contract pricing tiers and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: AHRMM GPO Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management

attributes.name: gpo_contract_number
attributes.description: Contract number assigned by the GPO for the vendor's pricing agreement. Used to validate contract compliance during purchase order creation and invoice matching.
attributes.references: AHRMM GPO Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain Contract Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of insurance number evidencing the vendor's general liability, product liability, and workers' compensation coverage. Required for vendor credentialing and contract compliance.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Vendor Credentialing Standards; OSHA; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor's insurance certificate expires. Supply chain and compliance teams must track this to ensure continuous coverage and prevent lapsed vendor access.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) Vendor Credentialing Standards; OSHA; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected delivery for this vendor. Used in par-level replenishment calculations and inventory safety stock planning.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: minimum_order_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar value required per purchase order for this vendor. Orders below this threshold may incur handling fees or be rejected. Used in procurement workflow validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFM1); Infor Lawson Supply Chain; AHRMM Procurement Standards

attributes.name: oig_excluded_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Excluded Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is currently listed on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE) or SAM.gov exclusion list. Excluded vendors must not be used for federally-funded programs.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; SAM.gov; 42 CFR Part 1001; CMS Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_checked_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the vendor was verified against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE) and SAM.gov exclusion database. Required for CMS compliance and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; SAM.gov; CMS Compliance Guidelines; 42 CFR Part 1001; HIPAA

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the confirmed delivery date. Key performance indicator (KPI) for vendor scorecard and contract compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: AHRMM Supply Chain KPI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the healthcare organization remits payment to the vendor. ACH and EFT are preferred for efficiency. Drives accounts payable processing in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master (LFB1.ZWELS); NACHA ACH Standards; PCI DSS

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Drives accounts payable scheduling and early payment discount capture in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM Vendor Master (LFB1.ZTERM); GAAP; FASB ASC 210

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Composite performance score (0.00–5.00) assigned to the vendor based on on-time delivery, fill rate, quality, and responsiveness metrics. Used in vendor scorecards and sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: AHRMM Supply Chain Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation (ME61); Infor Lawson

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the vendor's primary business address. Used for geographic segmentation, freight zone determination, and tax jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.PSTLZ); USPS; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor has been designated as a preferred supplier by the healthcare organization's value analysis committee or supply chain leadership. Preferred vendors receive priority in sourcing decisions.
attributes.references: AHRMM Value Analysis Standards; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary vendor account representative. Used for purchase order transmission, invoice correspondence, and contract communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 (for PHI-related communications)

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary account representative or sales contact at the vendor organization. Used for procurement communications, contract negotiations, and issue escalation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1/KNVK); Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary vendor account representative. Used for order inquiries, delivery coordination, and urgent supply chain communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: punchout_catalog_url
attributes.description: URL for the vendor's cXML punchout catalog integration, enabling procurement staff to browse and order directly from the vendor's online catalog within the ERP system (SAP MM or Infor Lawson).
attributes.references: cXML Punchout Standard; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM Catalog Integration

attributes.name: recall_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is enrolled to receive FDA product recall notifications and safety alerts. Critical for medical device and pharmaceutical recall management per FDA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FDA MedWatch; Medical Device Safety Act; Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA)

attributes.name: remittance_email
attributes.description: Email address designated by the vendor for receipt of Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) and payment notifications. Used in accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master; ERA/EFT Standards; NACHA

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the vendor's primary business address. Used for tax jurisdiction, state licensing verification, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; USPS State Abbreviations; State Departments of Health

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the IRS. Required for 1099 reporting, contract execution, and financial compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; GAAP; FASB; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: udi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor supports Unique Device Identifier (UDI) data transmission on invoices and advance ship notices. Required for implantable device tracking per FDA UDI Rule.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Parts 801, 830); FDA GUDID; DSCSA; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor master record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization between SAP MM and Infor Lawson, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001; SOC 2; HITRUST CSF; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the vendor organization as registered with the state or federal government. Used for contract execution, purchase orders, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Infor Lawson Vendor File; IRS EIN Registration

attributes.name: vendor_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric vendor code assigned by the healthcare organization's procurement system (SAP MM or Infor Lawson). Used on purchase orders, invoices, and remittance documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.LIFNR); Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor record. Active vendors are approved for purchasing. Blocked vendors are temporarily restricted. Debarred vendors are excluded per OIG or SAM.gov exclusion lists.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1.SPERR); OIG Exclusion List; SAM.gov; Infor Lawson Vendor File

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor's role in the supply chain. Distinguishes manufacturers (produce devices/drugs), distributors (resell/warehouse), GPO prime vendors, pharmacy wholesalers, service providers, and consultants. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manufacturer|distributor|gpo_prime_vendor|pharmacy_wholesaler|service_provider|consultant|sole_source|specialty_distributor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Transactional record of all procurement purchase orders issued to vendors for medical-surgical supplies, devices, and equipment. Captures PO number, vendor reference, vendor contract reference, ordering facility, ship-to location, order date, requested delivery date, total value, approval status, PO type (standard, blanket, emergency, standing), GPO contract reference, freight terms, payment terms, and fulfillment status. Supports three-way match (PO → goods receipt → invoice) and contract compliance validation. Sourced from SAP MM Purchase Orders and Infor Lawson Procurement module.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchase Order / Infor Lawson PO

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the purchase order record in the healthcare supply chain data platform. Primary key for the purchase_order data product.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Orders; Infor Lawson Procurement

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) that issued this purchase order. Used for facility-level spend reporting and budget allocation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Plant/Purchasing Organization; Infor Lawson Facility

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Patient-specific implant POs (custom prosthetics, orthopedic hardware) directly linked to the clinical order awaiting the device. Real in joint replacement, spinal surgery. Enables order-to-receipt tr

attributes.name: inventory_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific delivery location (warehouse, storeroom, department, or clinical unit) where ordered goods are to be received. May differ from the ordering facility.
attributes.references: SAP MM Delivery Address; Infor Lawson Ship-To Location

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Healthcare POs for 340B drugs, DEA-scheduled substances, or GPO-governed items must reference the governing compliance program. Procurement compliance reporting and 340B eligibility audits require thi

attributes.name: reimbursement_payer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: When purchasing high-cost implantable devices or capital equipment, healthcare organizations track which payer will reimburse to ensure coverage compliance. Real business process: capital equipment pu

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor contract or Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) contract under which this purchase order is issued. Supports contract compliance validation and pricing verification.
attributes.references: SAP MM Contract (ME31K); Infor Lawson Contract Management

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) from whom goods or services are being procured. Links to the vendor master record for contract compliance and spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1); Infor Lawson Vendor Master

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods were physically received at the ship-to location. Used to calculate vendor on-time delivery rate and actual lead time versus requested lead time.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO); Infor Lawson Receiving; AHRMM Supply Chain KPIs

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the purchase order. Distinct from overall PO status — captures the authorization state within the procurement approval chain (e.g., department head, CFO, supply chain director).
attributes.references: SAP MM Release Strategy (ME28); Infor Lawson Approval Workflow; OIG Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order received final procurement approval. Used for approval cycle time analysis and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Release (EKKO-FRGDT); Infor Lawson Approval Log; OIG Compliance; SOC 2

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year against which this purchase order is budgeted and encumbered. Used for annual budget consumption tracking and year-end financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year (EKKO-GJAHR); Infor Lawson Fiscal Year; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for cancellation of the purchase order (e.g., duplicate order, vendor unable to fulfill, product recall, budget freeze). Populated only when po_status is 'cancelled'. Used for procurement analytics and process improvement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Cancellation Reason; Infor Lawson PO Cancellation; AHRMM Procurement Standards

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the vendor in response to the purchase order. Compared against requested_delivery_date to measure vendor on-time delivery performance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Order Acknowledgment; Infor Lawson Vendor Confirmation; AHRMM Vendor Performance Metrics

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which the purchase order expenditure is allocated. Used for departmental budget tracking, financial reporting, and cost accounting in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center (CSKS-KOSTL); Infor Lawson Cost Center; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was first created in the source procurement system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and procurement cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: SAP MM Creation Date (EKKO-AEDAT); Infor Lawson; ISO 27001; SOC 2; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this purchase order (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency procurement for international medical device vendors.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP MM Currency (EKKO-WAERS); GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the purchase order, including GPO contract discounts, volume rebates, and negotiated price reductions. Reduces gross amount to arrive at net order value.
attributes.references: SAP MM Conditions (KONV); Infor Lawson Discount; GAAP; GPO Contract Compliance

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Total freight and shipping charges associated with the purchase order. Captured separately to support freight cost analysis and vendor freight term compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Freight Conditions; Infor Lawson Freight; AHRMM Supply Chain Cost Benchmarks

attributes.name: freight_terms_code
attributes.description: Incoterms or freight terms code defining responsibility for shipping costs and risk of loss during transit (e.g., FOB Origin, FOB Destination). Impacts cost allocation and liability.
attributes.references: SAP MM Incoterms (EKKO-INCO1); Infor Lawson Freight Terms; ICC Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current goods receipt fulfillment status of the purchase order. Tracks whether ordered quantities have been partially or fully received at the ship-to location. Drives open order reporting and expediting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Delivery Completion (EKPO-ELIKZ); Infor Lawson Receiving Status; AHRMM Supply Chain KPIs

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code for financial posting of the purchase order. Determines how the procurement expense is classified in the chart of accounts (e.g., medical supplies, capital equipment).
attributes.references: SAP FI GL Account (SKA1-SAKNR); Infor Lawson GL Account; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: gpo_contract_number
attributes.description: The Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) contract number under which this purchase order is placed (e.g., Vizient, Premier, HealthTrust). Used to validate contract compliance and capture GPO-negotiated pricing.
attributes.references: AHRMM GPO Contract Management; CMS Supply Chain Transparency; OIG Anti-Kickback Statute

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value of the purchase order before discounts, taxes, and freight charges. Sum of all line item extended prices. Used for budget encumbrance and spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP MM Net Order Value (EKKO-NETWR); Infor Lawson PO Amount; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current invoicing status of the purchase order from the vendor. Tracks whether vendor invoices have been received and matched against the PO. Supports accounts payable aging and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Invoice Status (EKBE); Infor Lawson Invoice Matching; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order is classified as a capital expenditure (CapEx) for medical equipment or facility assets, as opposed to an operating expenditure (OpEx) for consumable supplies. Drives fixed asset creation workflow.
attributes.references: SAP MM Account Assignment Category (EKPO-KNTTP); GAAP; FASB ASC 360; CMS Capital Cost Reporting

attributes.name: is_contract_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order was placed in compliance with an active vendor contract or GPO agreement. Non-compliant orders (maverick spend) are flagged for supply chain compliance review.
attributes.references: AHRMM Contract Compliance; OIG Anti-Kickback Statute; CMS Supply Chain Transparency; GPO Contract Terms

attributes.name: is_emergency_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this purchase order was issued as an emergency procurement, bypassing standard approval workflows due to urgent patient care or operational need. Triggers post-hoc review and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Emergency PO; SAP MM Emergency Procurement; OIG Compliance; EMTALA Supply Requirements

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of line items (distinct products or services) included in this purchase order. Used for order complexity analysis and procurement workload metrics.
attributes.references: SAP MM PO Item Count (EKPO); Infor Lawson PO Lines

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total net value of the purchase order after discounts, plus taxes and freight. Represents the total financial obligation to the vendor. Used for three-way match invoice validation and budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Net Value (EKKO-NETWR); Infor Lawson PO Net Amount; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the purchase order, such as delivery instructions, handling requirements for sterile or temperature-sensitive medical supplies, or vendor communication notes.
attributes.references: SAP MM PO Header Text (EKKO-BSTXT); Infor Lawson PO Notes

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the purchase order was formally created and issued. Used as the principal business event date for procurement reporting, aging analysis, and contract compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM Document Date (EKKO-BEDAT); Infor Lawson PO Date; GAAP Procurement Standards

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Vendor payment terms code specifying the due date and early payment discount conditions (e.g., NET30, 2/10NET30). Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow management.
attributes.references: SAP MM Payment Terms (EKKO-ZTERM); Infor Lawson Payment Terms; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable purchase order number assigned by the procurement system (SAP MM or Infor Lawson). Used in three-way match (PO → goods receipt → invoice) and vendor communications.
attributes.references: SAP MM ME21N; Infor Lawson PO10; CMS Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order. Tracks progression from draft creation through approval, transmission to vendor, goods receipt, and final closure or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|sent|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM PO Status (EKKO-STATU); Infor Lawson PO Status; AHRMM Procurement Standards

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement strategy. Standard: one-time order; Blanket: pre-negotiated volume agreement; Emergency: urgent unplanned procurement; Standing: recurring scheduled order; Consignment: vendor-managed inventory at facility.
attributes.references: SAP MM Document Type (EKKO-BSART); Infor Lawson PO Type; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: purchasing_group_code
attributes.description: SAP MM purchasing group code identifying the buyer or procurement team responsible for this purchase order. Used for buyer workload analysis and accountability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchasing Group (EKKO-EKGRP); Infor Lawson Buyer Code

attributes.name: purchasing_org_code
attributes.description: SAP MM purchasing organization code representing the organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Defines the legal and contractual entity issuing the purchase order.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchasing Organization (EKKO-EKORG); Infor Lawson Purchasing Entity

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the ordering facility requires the goods to be delivered. Used for vendor performance measurement, lead time analysis, and par-level replenishment planning.
attributes.references: SAP MM Delivery Date (EKET-EINDT); Infor Lawson Requested Date; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this purchase order record was extracted (e.g., SAP MM, Infor Lawson). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: HITRUST CSF; ISO 27001; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_po_key
attributes.description: The native primary key or document number of this purchase order in the originating source system (SAP MM EKKO-EBELN or Infor Lawson PO number). Enables back-tracing to the system of record for reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP MM EKKO-EBELN; Infor Lawson PO Number; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to the purchase order (e.g., sales tax, use tax on taxable medical supplies). May be zero for tax-exempt healthcare organizations.
attributes.references: SAP MM Tax (EKKO-MWSKZ); Infor Lawson Tax; IRS Tax-Exempt Status; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match process validating alignment between the purchase order, goods receipt, and vendor invoice. Exceptions trigger accounts payable holds and supply chain investigation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Invoice Verification (MIRO); Infor Lawson Three-Way Match; GAAP; OIG Fraud Prevention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was last modified in the source procurement system. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SAP MM Change Document; Infor Lawson Audit Log; ISO 27001; SOC 2; HITRUST CSF

attributes.name: vendor_quote_number
attributes.description: The vendor-assigned quotation or bid reference number associated with this purchase order. Used to trace back to the original vendor quote for price verification and contract compliance.
attributes.references: SAP MM RFQ (ME41); Infor Lawson Vendor Quote; AHRMM Procurement Standards

products.name: purchase_order_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each purchase order, representing individual material items ordered from a vendor. Captures line number, material master reference, ordered quantity, unit of measure, unit price, extended amount, promised delivery date, received quantity, and line status. Enables granular tracking of item-level procurement activity and receipt matching.
products.reference: SAP MM PO Line Item / Infor Lawson PO Line

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each purchase order line item within the healthcare supply chain. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, outpatient center) that is the delivery destination and consuming entity for this line item. Supports multi-facility procurement analytics and facility-level spend reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Ship-To Location; SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.hcpcs_code. Business justification: DME and billable supply orders use HCPCS codes for reimbursement tracking and payer compliance. Critical for revenue cycle matching supply costs to billable codes and ensuring formulary compliance.

attributes.name: material_master_id

attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Procurement Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase requisition that generated this purchase order line. Enables traceability from clinical or departmental demand through procurement to fulfillment.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain — Requisition Module; SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Requisition
