attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (BUDAT); GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the supply item involved in the inventory movement. Positive values indicate goods receipt or return; negative values indicate goods issue or write-off, consistent with SAP MM sign convention. Supports supply utilization analysis and inventory accuracy measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement (MIGO); Infor Lawson Inventory Transactions

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason explaining why the inventory transaction occurred, particularly for adjustments, waste disposals, and returns. Examples include EXPIRED (expiration date reached), DAMAGED (item damaged), RECALLED (manufacturer recall), COUNT_VARIANCE (physical count discrepancy), PATIENT_USE (issued for patient care). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXPIRED|DAMAGED|RECALLED|COUNT_VARIANCE|PATIENT_USE|OVERSTOCK|WRONG_ITEM|THEFT|SPOILAGE|TRANSFER_REQUEST — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement Reason Code; Infor Lawson Inventory; FDA Recall Management

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the reason code, such as specific details about damage, recall notice number, or count discrepancy explanation. Supports audit trail and investigation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; The Joint Commission (TJC) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item involved in this transaction is subject to an active manufacturer or FDA recall notice. When True, triggers recall management workflows and patient safety notifications.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Management; The Joint Commission (TJC) Patient Safety; 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number of the original transaction that this reversal transaction cancels. Populated only when is_reversal is True. Enables full audit trail linking reversals to their originating documents.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement Reversal; SOC 2 Audit Controls; ISO 27001

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number for serialized items such as implantable devices, capital equipment components, or high-value prosthetics. Enables individual unit-level traceability for patient safety and recall management.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule; The Joint Commission (TJC); SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this inventory transaction was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; MEDITECH Expanse; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: sterile_processing_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supply item involved in this transaction is subject to sterile processing (reprocessing/sterilization) workflows. When True, the item is tracked through the sterile processing department (SPD) for reuse cycle management.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission (TJC) IC.02.02.01; AAMI ST79 Sterilization Standards; AHRQ

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory transaction. 'posted' indicates the goods movement has been successfully recorded; 'reversed' indicates a cancellation document has been posted; 'pending' indicates awaiting system confirmation; 'error' indicates a posting failure requiring resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Movement (MIGO); Infor Lawson Inventory Transactions

attributes.name: udi_code
attributes.description: The FDA-mandated Unique Device Identifier (UDI) for implantable devices and high-risk medical devices. Composed of the Device Identifier (DI) and Production Identifier (PI) components. Required for implant charge capture, recall management, and FDA UDI compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA UDI Rule (21 CFR Part 830); FDA GUDID Database; The Joint Commission (TJC) Implant Tracking

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the supply item at the time of the transaction, sourced from the material master valuation price or moving average price. Used for cost allocation to departments and cost center accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Valuation; GAAP and FASB — Financial Reporting Standards; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the transaction quantity is expressed, such as EA (each), BX (box), CS (case), PK (pack), or ML (milliliter). Corresponds to SAP MM base unit of measure (MEINS) or Infor Lawson unit of measure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Infor Lawson Supply Chain; ISO 80000 Units of Measurement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inventory transaction record was last modified, such as upon reversal, status change, or correction. Supports change data capture and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 — Information Security Management; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

products.name: requisition
products.description: Internal supply requisition submitted by clinical departments, nursing units, or OR teams requesting materials from the central storeroom or supply chain. Captures requisition number, requesting department, requested items with quantities and material master references, urgency level (routine, urgent, STAT), clinical justification, approval workflow status, fulfillment method (stock pull, direct purchase), linked purchase order (if non-stock), and fulfillment status. Supports par-level auto-replenishment triggers and manual ad-hoc requests. Sourced from Infor Lawson Requisitions module and SAP MM Purchase Requisitions.
products.reference: Infor Lawson Requisition / SAP MM Purchase Requisition

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the internal supply requisition record. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Purchase Requisitions

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hospital, clinic, or outpatient facility from which the requisition originates. Supports multi-facility health system reporting and inventory allocation.
attributes.references: CMS Facility Reporting; The Joint Commission; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: or_suite_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.or_suite. Business justification: OR suites submit case-specific supply requisitions for implants and preference card items. Direct OR suite linkage supports surgical supply management, case cost tracking, and implant traceability — a

attributes.name: pharmacy_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.inventory. Business justification: Par-level replenishment requisitions are triggered by pharmacy inventory falling below reorder point. Linking requisition to the specific pharmacy inventory record that triggered it (is_par_triggered=

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order generated from this requisition when the fulfillment method is direct purchase. Null for stock pull fulfillments. Links the requisition to the procurement and accounts payable workflow.
attributes.references: SAP MM EBELN (Purchase Order Number); Infor Lawson PO Module; GAAP

attributes.name: requesting_clinician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.clinician. Business justification: Clinician-initiated supply requisitions (surgeon preference items, procedure-specific supplies) are a core healthcare supply chain process. Linking enables clinician-level spend analytics, preference

attributes.name: triggering_clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: Supply requisitions often triggered BY clinical orders (e.g., surgical case order triggers OR supply pull, patient-specific implant order triggers procurement). Natural parent-child relationship for s

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.unit. Business justification: Requisitions are submitted by specific nursing units requesting supplies. Unit-level requisition tracking is essential for departmental budget management and supply utilization reporting. requesting_d

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active supply contract or group purchasing organization (GPO) agreement under which this requisition's items are procured. Ensures contract compliance and enables contract utilization reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM Contract (EKKO); Infor Lawson Contract Management; AHRMM GPO Standards

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred or contracted vendor for direct purchase fulfillments. Populated when fulfillment_method is 'direct_purchase' or 'consignment'. Links to the vendor master for contract pricing and performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1); Infor Lawson Vendor Master; OIG Excluded Parties List

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to encounter.visit. Business justification: Patient-specific supply requisitions (e.g., custom implants, patient-specific surgical trays) must be traceable to the originating patient visit for visit-level supply cost tracking, case costing, and

attributes.name: actual_total_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost of all fulfilled line items on the requisition, updated upon fulfillment. May differ from estimated_total_cost due to substitutions, partial fulfillments, or price changes. Used for budget variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM; Infor Lawson; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the requisition within the approval workflow. Distinct from requisition_status, which tracks overall fulfillment lifecycle. Approval status specifically tracks the authorization decision by supply chain management or department leadership.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions Approval Workflow; SAP MM Release Strategy; OIG Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition was approved (or rejected) by the authorized approver. Used for cycle time analysis, SLA compliance, and procurement audit trails.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; OIG Compliance Guidelines; ISO 27001

attributes.name: budget_period
attributes.description: Fiscal budget period (year and quarter or month) to which this requisition's costs are allocated (e.g., '2024-Q3' or '2024-07'). Used for departmental budget tracking and financial close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Infor Lawson GL; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: clinical_justification
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the requester explaining the clinical or operational reason for the supply request. Required for non-routine or high-cost requisitions. Supports CDI and compliance review.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission Supply Chain Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation; Infor Lawson Requisitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; Infor Lawson Requisitions

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this requisition (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency health systems and international procurement.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Specific physical delivery point within the facility where the requested supplies should be delivered (e.g., 'ICU 4N Med Room', 'OR Suite 3 Supply Closet', 'ED Trauma Bay'). More granular than department; used for last-mile storeroom delivery routing.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Delivery Address; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: estimated_total_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of all line items on the requisition at time of submission, based on material master standard costs or contract pricing. Used for budget pre-authorization and spend visibility. Not a calculated aggregate — sourced directly from the requisition system at submission time.
attributes.references: SAP MM; Infor Lawson; GAAP; FASB; CMS Cost Reporting

attributes.name: expiration_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether items on this requisition require lot/expiration date tracking at fulfillment. Applies to pharmaceuticals, biologics, sterile supplies, and reagents. Supports FIFO inventory management and recall readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (Pharmaceutical); The Joint Commission MM Standards; USP <797>; Infor Lawson Inventory

attributes.name: fulfilled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the requisition was fully fulfilled and materials were delivered to the requesting department. Used for cycle time measurement, SLA reporting, and supply chain performance analytics.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; AHRMM Supply Chain KPIs

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the requisition will be fulfilled. Stock pull draws from central storeroom inventory; direct purchase triggers a purchase order to a vendor; consignment pulls from vendor-managed inventory on-site; loaner is for temporary implant or device use; transfer moves stock between facilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock_pull|direct_purchase|consignment|loaner|transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; AHRMM Supply Chain Best Practices

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code used to classify the supply expense for financial reporting. Derived from the charge description master or material master. Supports revenue cycle and financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Infor Lawson GL; GAAP; FASB

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any items on this requisition are classified as hazardous materials (e.g., chemotherapy agents, radioactive materials, flammable chemicals). Triggers special handling, transport, and storage protocols per OSHA and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 (Hazard Communication); FDA; DOT Hazmat Regulations; The Joint Commission EC Standards

attributes.name: is_capital_expense
attributes.description: Indicates whether any items on this requisition are classified as capital expenditures (equipment or assets above the capitalization threshold) rather than operating supply expenses. Triggers different approval and financial coding workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; GAAP; FASB ASC 360; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: is_par_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition was automatically generated by a par-level replenishment trigger rather than manually submitted. True = system-generated par replenishment; False = manual ad hoc request. Supports par management analytics and storeroom automation reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions Par Management; SAP MM MRP; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: is_recall_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this requisition was generated in response to a product recall event, requiring replacement of recalled medical-surgical supplies or implantable devices. Supports FDA recall compliance tracking and patient safety reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 806 (Medical Device Recalls); The Joint Commission; Infor Lawson

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; Infor Lawson Requisitions

attributes.name: needed_by_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested materials must be available for clinical use. Drives fulfillment prioritization, vendor lead time calculations, and storeroom scheduling. Maps to SAP MM LFDAT (Delivery Date) and Lawson required date field.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM LFDAT; The Joint Commission Supply Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special handling requirements, or communication between the requester and supply chain staff. Examples include delivery location specifics, substitution preferences, or sterile processing instructions.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Text Fields; The Joint Commission

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the approver when a requisition is rejected. Supports process improvement, requester feedback, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; OIG Compliance

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable requisition identifier assigned by the source system (Infor Lawson or SAP MM). Used for cross-system tracking, communication with supply chain staff, and audit trail. Maps to Lawson RQ10 requisition number or SAP BANFN field.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions Module; SAP MM BANFN (Purchase Requisition Number)

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the requisition. Drives approval routing, fulfillment actions, and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|partially_fulfilled|fulfilled|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Purchase Requisition Status; The Joint Commission Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition by its origination method. Par replenishment is auto-triggered when stock falls below par level; ad hoc is a manual one-time request; surgical case is linked to an OR procedure BOM; direct purchase bypasses storeroom stock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: par_replenishment|ad_hoc|surgical_case|direct_purchase|emergency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Document Type; AHRMM Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this requisition record was sourced. Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing. Values: Infor Lawson Requisitions module, SAP MM Purchase Requisitions, Epic OpTime (surgical case supply), or manual entry.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; Epic OpTime; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: Natural key or internal identifier of this requisition record in the originating source system (e.g., Lawson RQ10 internal ID or SAP BANFN). Used for ETL reconciliation, deduplication, and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM BANFN; ISO 27001; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312

attributes.name: sterile_processing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether items on this requisition require sterile processing or reprocessing before delivery to the requesting department. Triggers coordination with the sterile processing department (SPD) and tracks instrument tray readiness.
attributes.references: The Joint Commission IC Standards; AAMI ST79 Sterilization Standards; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the requisition was formally submitted by the requesting department or unit. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for cycle time measurement and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM; ISO 8601

attributes.name: total_line_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct line items (material/item requests) included in this requisition. Sourced directly from the requisition header record in Infor Lawson or SAP MM — not a derived aggregate. Used for complexity classification and processing time estimation.

attributes.name: udi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more items on this requisition are implantable devices or Class II/III medical devices requiring FDA Unique Device Identifier (UDI) tracking. Triggers UDI capture workflow at fulfillment and patient implant documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830 (UDI); FDA UDI Rule; The Joint Commission; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: urgency_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the requisition indicating how quickly the requested materials are needed. STAT (immediate clinical need), Urgent (same-day), or Routine (standard replenishment cycle). Drives fulfillment prioritization and storeroom workflow.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Requisitions; SAP MM Priority; The Joint Commission Supply Standards

products.name: udi_record
products.description: Unique Device Identifier (UDI) tracking record for implantable devices and high-risk medical devices as required by FDA UDI regulations. Captures device identifier (DI), production identifier (PI), lot number, serial number, expiration date, manufacturer, device description, implant status, patient association, and recall status. Supports FDA 21 CFR Part 830 compliance and implant registry reporting.
products.reference: FDA UDI Database (GUDID) / 21 CFR Part 830

attributes.name: udi_record_id
attributes.description: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each UDI tracking record in the lakehouse silver layer. System-generated BIGINT for internal referencing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, surgical center) where the device was received, stored, or implanted. Supports facility-level inventory and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM; FDA 21 CFR Part 830

attributes.name: clinical_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.clinical_order. Business justification: UDI tracking for implanted devices MUST link to the clinical order that authorized implantation. FDA regulatory requirement for device traceability, recall management, and adverse event reporting. Cri

attributes.name: clinician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed clinician (surgeon or interventionalist) who performed the device implantation procedure. Required for implant registry reporting, credentialing verification, and provider-level quality analytics.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; CMS Implant Registry; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; NPI (National Provider Identifier)

attributes.name: consent_reference_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.consent_reference. Business justification: FDA MDR regulations and Joint Commission standards require documented patient consent linked to implantable device records. Linking udi_record to consent_reference supports implant audit trails, regul

attributes.name: coverage_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.coverage_policy. Business justification: Payers maintain specific coverage policies for implantable devices (e.g., CMS NCDs/LCDs). Linking UDI records to coverage_policy supports reimbursement validation, MDR reportability determination, and

attributes.name: demographics_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient in whom the device was implanted or used. Populated when the device has been associated with a specific patient encounter or implant event. Null for devices not yet implanted.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; HL7 FHIR Device Resource

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.goods_receipt. Business justification: A UDI record for an implantable or high-risk device is physically received via a goods receipt. Linking udi_record.goods_receipt_id -> goods_receipt.goods_receipt_id provides direct procurement-to-imp

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.hcpcs_code. Business justification: Implantable devices tracked via UDI require HCPCS codes for billing and reimbursement. Mandatory for device registry reporting, charge capture validation, and payer claims submission—regulatory and re

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to patient.insurance_coverage. Payers require this for reimbursement claims, MDR repor

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_location. Business justification: udi_record currently stores location_code as a denormalized STRING. The inventory_location table is the authoritative master for all physical and logical storage locations in the supply chain. Replaci

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: UDI records track implanted devices that must link to supply master for: FDA recall management requiring device master data, warranty claim processing, cost capture for implant billing, inventory repl

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: FDA MDR reporting (21 CFR Part 830) and CMS implant tracking require UDI records to identify the implanting organizational provider entity, distinct from the care site. Regulatory compliance for impla

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to insurance.payer. Business justification: Implantable device tracking requires linking to the payer who covered the implant for warranty claims, recall remediation, and reimbursement disputes. Real business process: FDA MDR reporting, payer-s

attributes.name: primary_udi_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or manufacturer from whom the device was procured. Used for vendor performance tracking, recall management, and procurement analytics.
attributes.references: Infor Lawson Supply Chain; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: procedure_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surgical or procedural event record during which the device was implanted or used. Enables direct linkage between the UDI record and the clinical procedure documentation in the EHR.
attributes.references: Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet; HL7 FHIR Procedure Resource; FDA 21 CFR Part 830

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order_line. Business justification: FDA UDI regulations require end-to-end traceability from device procurement through implantation. Linking udi_record directly to the purchase_order_line that procured the specific device instance (ide

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.unit. Business justification: UDI records for implantable devices must track the clinical unit where the procedure occurred for FDA MDR reporting and recall management. Unit-level UDI tracking is a regulatory requirement under 21

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical encounter (e.g., surgical procedure, inpatient admission) during which the device was implanted or used. Links UDI record to the clinical event for traceability.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; HL7 FHIR Encounter Resource; Epic OpTime

attributes.name: visit_procedure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to encounter.visit_procedure. Business justification: FDA UDI rule (21 CFR Part 830) and CMS implant reporting require device traceability to the specific procedure where the device was used. udi_record has visit_id but not procedure-level linkage; visit

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this UDI record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR §164.312; ISO 27001; HITRUST CSF; SOC 2

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: The mandatory, fixed portion of the Unique Device Identifier (UDI) that identifies the labeler and the specific version or model of a device. Corresponds to the Device Identifier (DI) component of the FDA UDI system. Sourced from the FDA Global Unique Device Identification Database (GUDID).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA GUDID; HL7 FHIR Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the device should not be used, as labeled by the manufacturer. Critical for sterile device management, expiration tracking, and preventing use of expired devices. Part of the Production Identifier (PI) component of the UDI.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; The Joint Commission (TJC) EC.02.04.01; Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: explant_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously implanted device was surgically removed (explanted) from the patient. Populated when implant_status transitions to 'explanted'. Used for device lifecycle tracking and adverse event reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; FDA MedWatch; CMS Implant Registry Requirements

attributes.name: explant_reason
attributes.description: The clinical or administrative reason for device explantation. Used for adverse event reporting, quality improvement, and FDA MedWatch reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: device_failure|infection|patient_request|end_of_life|recall|revision|death|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA MedWatch; FDA 21 CFR Part 803 (MDR); The Joint Commission (TJC); AHRQ

attributes.name: gmdn_code
attributes.description: The Global Medical Device Nomenclature (GMDN) code assigned to the device type, providing an internationally recognized classification for medical devices. Supports interoperability with international device registries.

attributes.name: implant_date
attributes.description: The date on which the device was surgically implanted into the patient. Populated when implant_status transitions to 'implanted'. Required for implant registry reporting and patient safety tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; CMS Implant Registry Requirements; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: implant_site
attributes.description: The anatomical location in the patient's body where the device was implanted (e.g., left hip, thoracic cavity, lumbar spine). Supports clinical documentation, implant registry reporting, and post-market surveillance.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms); HL7 FHIR Device.location; CMS Implant Registry

attributes.name: implant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the implantable device. Tracks whether the device is available in inventory, has been implanted in a patient, has been explanted (removed), wasted, recalled, or quarantined pending investigation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; HL7 FHIR Device.status; The Joint Commission (TJC); Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: implantable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device is classified as implantable per FDA UDI regulations. Implantable devices require mandatory UDI documentation at the point of care and patient-level tracking in the medical record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; FDA 21 CFR Part 801.45; HL7 FHIR Device.implantable

attributes.name: issuing_agency
attributes.description: The FDA-accredited issuing agency that assigned the UDI system used for this device. Valid values include GS1 (Global Standards One), HIBCC (Health Industry Business Communications Council), ICCBBA (International Council for Commonality in Blood Banking Automation), and IFA (Informationsstelle für Arzneispezialitäten).

attributes.name: laterality
attributes.description: The side of the body where the device was implanted (left, right, bilateral, or not applicable). Used for surgical documentation, implant registry reporting, and clinical analytics.
attributes.references: SNOMED CT; HL7 FHIR; Epic OpTime; Cerner SurgiNet

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer-assigned lot or batch number for the device. Used for recall management, quality investigations, and traceability to the manufacturing batch. Part of the Production Identifier (PI) component of the UDI.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (Quality System Regulation); Infor Lawson Supply Chain

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which the device was manufactured, as labeled by the manufacturer. Used for shelf-life calculations, quality investigations, and traceability. Part of the Production Identifier (PI) component of the UDI.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA GUDID; HL7 FHIR Device.manufactureDate

attributes.name: mdr_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse event or malfunction associated with this device has been determined to be reportable to the FDA under Medical Device Reporting (MDR) regulations. Triggers mandatory FDA MedWatch reporting workflow.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 803 (Medical Device Reporting); FDA MedWatch; OIG

attributes.name: production_identifier
attributes.description: The conditional, variable portion of the UDI that identifies one or more of the following: lot/batch number, serial number, expiration date, manufacturing date, and distinct identification code. Corresponds to the Production Identifier (PI) component per FDA UDI regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830.3; FDA GUDID; HL7 FHIR Device.udiCarrier.carrierHRF

attributes.name: recall_class
attributes.description: The FDA classification of the recall by severity: Class I (serious adverse health consequences or death), Class II (temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences), Class III (unlikely to cause adverse health consequences). Drives urgency of recall response.

products.name: vendor_contract_item
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between vendor_contract and material_master. It captures the specific negotiated terms for a supply item under a vendor or GPO contract — the operational 'contract line item' managed by supply chain contracting staff. Each record links one vendor_contract to one material_master and carries the contracted price, effective dates, order quantity constraints, price tier, and formulary status that are unique to that contract-item combination. This is the authoritative source for item-level contract pricing used in purchase order validation, formulary compliance, and GPO rebate calculation.. Existence Justification: In healthcare supply chain operations, GPO and vendor contracts explicitly enumerate covered items (contract line items), where each contract covers multiple materials at negotiated prices, and each material can appear on multiple contracts simultaneously (e.g., a surgical glove may be on a Vizient GPO contract AND a local sole-source agreement). This is a well-recognized operational entity — the 'contract item' or 'contract line item' — actively managed by supply chain contracting staff in systems like Infor Lawson and SAP MM. The relationship carries its own data (contracted unit price, effective/expiration dates, min/max order quantities, price tier, formulary status per contract) that belongs to neither the contract nor the material alone.

products.name: vendor_item
products.description: This association product represents the formal approval and contractual sourcing relationship between a specific material and a specific vendor in the healthcare supply chain. It captures the vendor-specific pricing, lead time, item number, and approval status for each vendor-material combination. Equivalent to the SAP MM Purchasing Info Record and the Infor Lawson Vendor Item Master. Each record links one material_master to one vendor and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific sourcing relationship — they cannot reside on either the material or the vendor alone.. Existence Justification: In healthcare supply chain operations, a single material (e.g., a surgical stapler) is actively sourced from multiple approved vendors at different prices, lead times, and minimum order quantities — and a single vendor supplies hundreds or thousands of distinct materials. This is the classic SAP MM 'Purchasing Info Record' / Infor Lawson 'Vendor Item Master' pattern: the healthcare organization formally approves each vendor-material combination, negotiates vendor-specific pricing, and tracks per-combination performance data. The relationship is not derivable from transactional data — it is a standing master record that procurement staff create, maintain, and deactivate as part of daily supply chain operations.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current status of voluntary accreditation. Accredited status may grant deemed status for Medicare Conditions of Participation and is often required for payer contracting.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the care site including street number, street name, and unit/suite if applicable. Used for facility licensing, patient navigation, and emergency services dispatch.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building name, floor, department, or mail stop. Optional field for complex campus environments.

attributes.name: ccn
attributes.description: Six-character CMS Certification Number (formerly Provider Number) assigned to Medicare-certified facilities. First two digits indicate state, third-fourth indicate facility type.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the care site is physically located. Used for geographic reporting, service area analysis, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date the care site permanently ceased operations. Used for historical analysis, medical records retention planning, and network capacity reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Supports international IDN operations and cross-border care coordination.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish where the care site is located. Used for public health reporting, certificate of need (CON) analysis, and regional health planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this care site record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_access_hospital
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is designated as a Critical Access Hospital under the Medicare Rural Hospital Flexibility Program. CAH status provides cost-based reimbursement and reduced regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: disproportionate_share_hospital
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility qualifies for Medicare DSH payments due to serving a disproportionate share of low-income patients. Affects Medicare reimbursement rates.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for administrative and clinical correspondence. Used for referral notifications, quality reporting, and payer communications.

attributes.name: emergency_services_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the care site operates a 24/7 emergency department. Determines EMTALA obligations, EMS transport protocols, and trauma network participation.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the care delivery location based on services provided and regulatory designation. Determines applicable licensing, staffing, and quality reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acute_care_hospital|critical_access_hospital|ambulatory_surgery_center|clinic|urgent_care|rehabilitation_facility|skilled_nursing_facility — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services Current Files

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for medical records requests, prior authorizations, and clinical documentation exchange. Still widely used in healthcare for HIPAA-compliant transmission.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Date the care site began operations and started accepting patients. Used for historical trending, market entry analysis, and anniversary planning.

attributes.name: hierarchy_effective_date
attributes.description: Date the current organizational hierarchy relationship became effective. Supports time-variant hierarchy reporting for mergers, acquisitions, and reorganizations.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Position of this care site within the IDN organizational hierarchy. Supports multi-level reporting, cost allocation, and governance structure representation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this care site record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and downstream system synchronization.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the care site in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, service area mapping, and distance-based referral routing.

attributes.name: license_effective_date
attributes.description: Date the current facility license became effective. Used to track license renewal cycles and ensure continuous compliance.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the current facility license expires. Triggers renewal workflows and compliance monitoring to prevent operational disruption.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: State-issued facility license number. Required for legal operation and must be displayed publicly per state regulations.

attributes.name: licensed_bed_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of inpatient beds the facility is licensed to operate by the state health department. Determines staffing requirements, certificate of need compliance, and CMS cost report bed counts.

attributes.name: licensure_status
attributes.description: Current state of the facility license issued by the state health department. Active status is required for legal operation and Medicare/Medicaid participation.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the care site in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analysis, service area mapping, and distance-based referral routing.

attributes.name: medicaid_provider_number
attributes.description: State-specific Medicaid provider identification number. Required for Medicaid claims submission and varies by state Medicaid program.

attributes.name: medicare_provider_number
attributes.description: Legacy Medicare provider identification number, now replaced by CCN but still used in some legacy systems and historical reporting.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the care site. Active status indicates the site is open and accepting patients. Used for capacity planning, referral routing, and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the care site. Determines tax status, regulatory oversight, and eligibility for certain federal programs and grants.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the care site. Used for patient inquiries, referral coordination, and emergency contact.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code for the care site location. Used for geographic market segmentation, service area mapping, and population health analytics.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the care delivery location as registered with state licensing authorities and used in patient-facing communications.

attributes.name: site_npi
attributes.description: Type 2 NPI assigned to the organizational care site by CMS for billing and identification purposes. Required for Medicare/Medicaid claims submission.
attributes.references: CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES)

attributes.name: sole_community_hospital
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is designated as a Sole Community Hospital, providing enhanced Medicare reimbursement for rural hospitals that are the sole source of care in their area.

attributes.name: staffed_bed_capacity
attributes.description: Number of beds currently staffed and available for patient occupancy. May be less than licensed capacity due to staffing constraints or seasonal demand patterns.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory postal abbreviation. Determines applicable state licensing board, Medicaid program, and health department jurisdiction.

attributes.name: teaching_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is a teaching hospital with approved residency programs. Teaching status affects CMS reimbursement through Graduate Medical Education (GME) payments and indirect medical education (IME) adjustments.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the care site location. Used for scheduling, appointment coordination, and timestamp normalization across multi-site IDN operations.

attributes.name: trauma_level
attributes.description: American College of Surgeons trauma center verification level. Indicates capability to provide comprehensive trauma care and determines EMS transport protocols.
attributes.references: American College of Surgeons Committee on Trauma

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public-facing website URL for the care site. Provides patient access to services information, provider directories, and online scheduling.

products.name: building
products.description: Physical building or structure associated with a care site. Tracks building name, code, address, construction year, square footage, number of floors, building type (clinical, administrative, research, parking), fire safety classification, seismic zone, HVAC system type, electrical capacity, emergency generator coverage, and current operational status. Supports facilities management, capital planning, and environmental services operations.
products.reference: SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the building. Primary key.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the care site or facility that owns or operates this building.

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building meets Americans with Disabilities Act accessibility requirements including ramps, elevators, restrooms, and signage.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the building including street number and name. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, floor, or building designation. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: annual_property_tax_amount
attributes.description: Annual property tax liability for the building in US dollars. Used for budgeting and financial planning.

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the building for internal identification and facility management systems. Used in SAP PM and facility operations.

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Official name of the building as recognized by the organization and used in signage, wayfinding, and facility documentation.

attributes.name: building_type
attributes.description: Primary functional classification of the building indicating its predominant use within the healthcare delivery network.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the building is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number
attributes.description: CMS-issued certification number (CCN) authorizing participation in Medicare and Medicaid programs. Required for federal reimbursement.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year the building was originally constructed. Used for capital planning, depreciation calculations, and facility lifecycle management.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the building is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this building record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the building record became active in the system or when the building was placed into service.

attributes.name: electrical_service_capacity_kva
attributes.description: Total electrical service capacity of the building measured in kilovolt-amperes. Used for load planning, equipment installation approval, and utility management.

attributes.name: emergency_generator_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Total capacity of emergency backup generator systems in kilowatts. Critical for life safety systems, operating rooms, intensive care units, and emergency departments.

attributes.name: emergency_generator_coverage_type
attributes.description: Scope of building systems and areas covered by emergency generator backup power. Determines operational resilience during utility outages.

attributes.name: facility_license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the state facility license. Tracked for renewal planning and regulatory compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: facility_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued license number authorizing operation of healthcare services within the building. Required for regulatory compliance and reimbursement.

attributes.name: fire_safety_classification
attributes.description: Building construction type classification based on fire resistance ratings and combustibility of structural elements per International Building Code.

attributes.name: gross_square_footage
attributes.description: Total interior floor area of the building measured in square feet, including all floors and spaces. Used for space utilization analysis and facility cost allocation.

attributes.name: helipad_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building has a rooftop or ground-level helipad for emergency medical transport. Critical for trauma centers and tertiary care facilities.

attributes.name: hvac_system_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) System Type
attributes.description: Primary type of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system serving the building. Critical for infection control, environmental services, and energy management.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Property and casualty insurance policy number covering the building. Used for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: joint_commission_accreditation_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of The Joint Commission accreditation. Tracked for survey preparation and continuous compliance.

attributes.name: joint_commission_accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status from The Joint Commission indicating compliance with national healthcare quality and safety standards.

attributes.name: last_major_renovation_year
attributes.description: Year of the most recent major renovation or significant capital improvement project affecting the building structure or systems.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this building record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the building in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, emergency response, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: leed_certification_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Level
attributes.description: Level of LEED green building certification achieved by the building. Indicates sustainability performance and environmental design standards.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the building in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, emergency response, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: medical_gas_system_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the building has a medical gas distribution system for oxygen, medical air, nitrous oxide, and vacuum services. Required for clinical buildings.

attributes.name: net_usable_square_footage
attributes.description: Usable interior floor area excluding mechanical spaces, circulation, and structural elements. Used for space planning and departmental allocation.

attributes.name: number_of_elevators
attributes.description: Total count of passenger and service elevators installed in the building. Used for vertical transportation capacity planning and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: number_of_floors
attributes.description: Total count of floors in the building including basement and sub-basement levels. Used for elevator planning, emergency evacuation, and vertical transportation analysis.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the building indicating whether it is in service, under construction, renovation, or decommissioned.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership or control arrangement for the building. Impacts financial reporting, capital planning, and operational decision-making.

attributes.name: parking_spaces_count
attributes.description: Total number of parking spaces associated with or adjacent to the building. Used for access planning, patient experience, and workforce management.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the building location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: property_tax_parcel_number
attributes.description: Local government assessor parcel number used for property tax assessment and real estate records.

attributes.name: replacement_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost to replace the building at current construction prices. Used for insurance coverage determination and capital planning.

attributes.name: seismic_zone
attributes.description: Seismic design category or zone classification indicating the level of earthquake risk and required structural design standards for the building location.

attributes.name: sprinkler_system_type
attributes.description: Type of automatic fire sprinkler system installed in the building. Critical for fire safety compliance and insurance underwriting.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the building is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the building was decommissioned, sold, or otherwise removed from active service. Null for active buildings.

products.name: unit
products.description: Clinical or administrative unit within a building, such as ICU, ED, OR suite, NICU, med-surg floor, radiology department, pharmacy, or administrative wing. Captures unit name, unit code, unit type (inpatient, outpatient, procedural, diagnostic, administrative), specialty service line, licensed bed count, staffed bed count, isolation room count, negative pressure room count, unit manager, and operational hours. Supports ADT workflows, bed management, and staffing.
products.reference: Epic ADT Department, HL7 FHIR Location

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical or administrative unit within the healthcare facility. Primary key.

attributes.name: accreditation_status_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accreditation_status. Business justification: Clinical units (Chest Pain Center, Stroke Unit, NICU) hold unit-level accreditation status (ACC, AHA, state designations). accreditation_status links to care_site but not unit. Unit-level accreditatio

attributes.name: building_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to facility.building. Business justification: A clinical or administrative unit (ICU, ED, OR suite floor) physically resides within a specific building. While unit already links to care_site, a care site may span multiple buildings, so the unit-t

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility or building where this unit is located. Links to the facility master data product.

attributes.name: manager_clinician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.clinician. Business justification: Unit management accountability requires linking the manager to their clinician record for credentialing verification, privileging status, and regulatory reporting. Hospitals must track which credentia

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Clinical units (ICU, ED, NICU) are governed by specific compliance programs (CMS Conditions of Participation, infection control programs). Compliance officers track unit-level program enrollment for d

attributes.name: specialty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Hospital units are organized by specialty service line (cardiology, oncology, neurology). Linking unit to specialty supports specialty-based staffing models, nurse-to-patient ratio planning, and servi

attributes.name: accepts_admissions
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is currently accepting new patient admissions. False when the unit is at capacity, under diversion, or temporarily closed to new admissions.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ADT Bed Management, HL7 ADT A01 Message

attributes.name: accepts_transfers
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is currently accepting patient transfers from other units or facilities. Used in bed management and patient flow coordination.
attributes.references: Epic EHR ADT Bed Management, HL7 ADT A02 Message

attributes.name: acuity_level
attributes.description: Typical patient acuity level served by the unit. Critical (ICU, CCU), acute (step-down, telemetry), intermediate (med-surg), general (rehab, skilled nursing), ambulatory (outpatient clinics).
attributes.references: AHRQ Patient Acuity Classification, CMS Case Mix Index (CMI)

attributes.name: age_restriction
attributes.description: Age restriction policy for the unit. Pediatric-only (NICU, PICU, pediatric floors), adult-only (most general units), geriatric-only (specialized elder care), or all ages (ED, some outpatient clinics).
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation, Joint Commission Patient Rights Standards

attributes.name: air_changes_per_hour
attributes.description: Number of complete air changes per hour in the unit. Minimum 6 ACH for general patient rooms, 12+ ACH for isolation rooms, 15+ ACH for operating rooms per ASHRAE and CDC guidelines.
attributes.references: ASHRAE Standard 170, CDC Environmental Infection Control Guidelines

attributes.name: chest_pain_center_accreditation
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit (typically ED or cardiac unit) holds accreditation as a Chest Pain Center from the American College of Cardiology or Society of Cardiovascular Patient Care.
attributes.references: ACC Chest Pain Center Accreditation, SCPC Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the unit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, HITRUST Audit Logging Requirements

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric department code used in operational systems for grouping units into clinical or administrative departments. Used for reporting, scheduling, and organizational hierarchy.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Department Master, Workday HCM Organizational Structure

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the unit became operational or when the current configuration became effective. Used for historical tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: electronic_health_record_system
attributes.description: Name and version of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system used in the unit, such as 'Epic Hyperspace 2023', 'Cerner Millennium PowerChart', or 'MEDITECH Expanse'. Used for interoperability and training planning.
attributes.references: ONC Certified EHR Technology, HL7 FHIR Interoperability Standards

attributes.name: emergency_power_backup
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit has emergency generator backup power. Required for critical care units (ICU, OR, ED, NICU) per NFPA 99 and Joint Commission Life Safety Standards.
attributes.references: NFPA 99 Health Care Facilities Code, Joint Commission Life Safety Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the unit was closed, decommissioned, or when the current configuration expired. Null for active units. Used for historical tracking and capacity planning.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Physical floor or level within the building where the unit is located. May be numeric (1, 2, 3) or alphanumeric (G for ground, B1 for basement 1, M for mezzanine).

attributes.name: gender_restriction
attributes.description: Gender restriction policy for the unit. Male-only or female-only for certain inpatient units (e.g., obstetrics, urology). Mixed for most units. Not applicable for procedural or diagnostic units.
attributes.references: CMS Conditions of Participation, Joint Commission Patient Rights Standards

attributes.name: hvac_system_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) System Type
attributes.description: Type of HVAC system serving the unit, such as 'Central Air', 'Variable Air Volume (VAV)', 'Dedicated Outdoor Air System (DOAS)', or 'Negative Pressure Isolation System'. Critical for infection control and environmental safety.
attributes.references: ASHRAE Standard 170, CDC Environmental Infection Control Guidelines

attributes.name: infection_control_zone
attributes.description: Infection control risk classification for the unit. Standard (general units), enhanced (oncology, transplant), high-risk (ICU, burn unit), isolation (dedicated infectious disease units). Drives environmental services protocols.
attributes.references: CDC Healthcare Infection Control Practices, Joint Commission Infection Prevention Standards

attributes.name: is_twenty_four_seven
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. True for ICU, ED, inpatient floors. False for outpatient clinics, procedural units with scheduled hours.

attributes.name: isolation_room_count
attributes.description: Number of isolation rooms within the unit designed for patients requiring infection control precautions (contact, droplet, or airborne isolation). Critical for infection prevention and Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) management.
attributes.references: CDC Isolation Precautions Guidelines, Joint Commission Infection Control Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the unit record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, HITRUST Audit Logging Requirements

attributes.name: licensed_bed_count
attributes.description: Total number of beds the unit is licensed to operate by state or federal regulatory authorities. This is the maximum legal capacity and is reported to CMS and state health departments.
attributes.references: CMS Provider of Services File, State Health Department Licensing

attributes.name: magnet_recognition
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is part of a Magnet-recognized nursing program by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC). Magnet recognition signifies excellence in nursing care and patient outcomes.

attributes.name: medical_gas_system
attributes.description: Type of medical gas system installed in the unit, such as 'Oxygen, Medical Air, Vacuum', 'Full Surgical Suite Gases (O2, N2O, Medical Air, Vacuum)', or 'None'. Critical for clinical operations and safety inspections.
attributes.references: NFPA 99 Medical Gas Systems, Joint Commission Environment of Care Standards

attributes.name: negative_pressure_room_count
attributes.description: Number of negative pressure (airborne infection isolation) rooms within the unit, used for patients with airborne infectious diseases such as tuberculosis, measles, or COVID-19. Subset of isolation rooms.
attributes.references: CDC Guidelines for Environmental Infection Control, ASHRAE Standard 170

attributes.name: nurse_call_system_type
attributes.description: Type of nurse call system installed in the unit, such as 'Wired Pillow Speaker', 'Wireless Badge System', 'Integrated EMR Alert System', or 'Mobile App-Based'. Used for patient safety and response time monitoring.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Patient Safety Standards, AHRQ Patient Safety Indicators

attributes.name: nurse_to_patient_ratio
attributes.description: Target nurse-to-patient staffing ratio for the unit, expressed as 1:X (e.g., 1:2 for ICU, 1:4 for step-down, 1:6 for med-surg). Used for staffing planning and quality benchmarking.
attributes.references: State Nurse Staffing Laws, Joint Commission Staffing Standards

attributes.name: operational_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time for unit operations in HH:MM 24-hour format. For 24/7 units, this is typically 23:59. For outpatient or procedural units, this reflects scheduled closing time.

attributes.name: operational_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time for unit operations in HH:MM 24-hour format. For 24/7 units (ICU, ED), this is typically 00:00. For outpatient or procedural units, this reflects scheduled opening time.

attributes.name: revenue_center_code
attributes.description: Four-digit revenue center code used on UB-04 claims for billing and reimbursement. Maps to CMS revenue code standards (e.g., 0100-0219 for room and board, 0300-0329 for laboratory).
attributes.references: CMS UB-04 Revenue Code List, NUBC Revenue Code Standards

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total square footage of the unit's physical space. Used for facility planning, space utilization analysis, and environmental services scheduling.
attributes.references: Facility Management Standards, SAP PM Asset Master

attributes.name: staffed_bed_count
attributes.description: Number of beds currently staffed and available for patient occupancy. Staffed bed count is typically less than or equal to licensed bed count and reflects actual operational capacity based on workforce availability.
attributes.references: CMS Hospital Compare, AHRQ Hospital Survey

attributes.name: stroke_center_designation
attributes.description: Stroke center certification level for units providing acute stroke care. Comprehensive (highest), primary, acute stroke ready, or not designated. Impacts patient routing and quality reporting.
attributes.references: Joint Commission Stroke Certification, CMS Stroke Quality Measures

attributes.name: teaching_unit_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit is designated as a teaching unit where medical residents, fellows, nursing students, or other trainees receive clinical education. Impacts staffing models and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ACGME Accreditation Standards, CMS Graduate Medical Education (GME) Reporting

attributes.name: telemetry_monitoring_capability
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the unit has continuous cardiac telemetry monitoring capability. True for ICU, CCU, step-down, and telemetry units. False for general med-surg and outpatient units.
attributes.references: American Heart Association Telemetry Standards, Joint Commission Critical Care Standards

attributes.name: trauma_level
attributes.description: Trauma center level designation for Emergency Department (ED) units. Level 1 is highest capability (comprehensive trauma care), Level 4 is basic. Not applicable for non-ED units.
attributes.references: American College of Surgeons Trauma Center Verification, State EMS Trauma System

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the unit in operational systems, scheduling, and Admit Discharge Transfer (ADT) workflows. Typically 2-10 characters.
attributes.references: Epic EHR Cadence Unit Code, HL7 ADT Message PV1-3

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the unit, such as 'Medical Surgical Floor 3 West', 'Intensive Care Unit (ICU) North', 'Emergency Department (ED) Main', or 'Operating Room (OR) Suite B'.

attributes.name: unit_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the unit. Active units are open and accepting patients. Inactive or temporarily closed units are not operational. Under construction units are being built or renovated. Decommissioned units are permanently closed.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the unit's operational purpose: inpatient (patient stays overnight), outpatient (same-day care), procedural (OR, cath lab), diagnostic (radiology, lab), administrative (offices), or support (pharmacy, supply).
attributes.references: HL7 FHIR Location.type, CMS Facility Type Codes

attributes.name: wing_or_section
attributes.description: Wing, section, or zone designation within the floor, such as 'North', 'South', 'East', 'West', 'Tower A', 'Pavilion B'. Used for wayfinding and spatial organization.

products.name: room
products.description: Individual room within a unit, including patient rooms, procedure rooms, operating rooms (OR suites with laminar airflow class, imaging integration, boom configuration), exam rooms, consultation rooms, and support rooms. Tracks room number, room name, room type (patient, OR, procedure, exam, consultation, support, isolation, negative pressure), room class (private, semi-private, ward), square footage, isolation capability, negative pressure flag, telemetry capability, ventilator outlet count, medical gas outlets (O2, vacuum, air, N2O), hand hygiene station count, OR-specific features (airflow class, HVAC air exchange rate per ASHRAE 170, equipment inventory), current room status (available, occupied, cleaning, out-of-service), last deep-clean date, and assigned department. Also captures space allocation and occupancy assignments linking rooms to departments, cost centers, and service lines with effective dating, allocated square footage, occupancy percentage, lease/ownership indicator, and monthly space cost. Supports ADT workflows, perioperative scheduling, bed management, space utilization analysis, infection prevention (isolation room tracking), and cost center chargebacks.
products.reference: Epic ADT Room, HL7 FHIR Location

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the room. Primary key for the room entity.

attributes.name: care_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility or hospital where this room is located. Links to the facility master data.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent unit or department within the facility where this room is located. Links to the unit master data.

attributes.name: accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current accreditation status of the room by relevant accrediting bodies (e.g., The Joint Commission, AAAHC). Impacts operational authorization and reimbursement eligibility.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is currently active and available for use in operational systems. Supports soft-delete patterns and historical record retention.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room meets ADA accessibility requirements for patients and staff with disabilities. Required for regulatory compliance and patient access.

attributes.name: bariatric_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is equipped and structurally reinforced to accommodate bariatric patients (typically over 350 lbs). Includes specialized beds, lifts, and wider doorways.

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: Number of patient beds or stretchers that can be accommodated in the room. Used for bed management, capacity planning, and CMS reporting.

attributes.name: boom_configuration
attributes.description: Description of ceiling-mounted equipment boom configuration in the room (e.g., single boom, dual boom, articulating arm). Relevant for OR and ICU rooms with suspended equipment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the room record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current room configuration, assignment, or status became effective. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which the current room configuration, assignment, or status is valid. Null indicates current/active record. Supports temporal tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: emergency_power_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room is connected to emergency backup power systems. Critical for life-safety equipment in ORs, ICUs, and emergency departments.

attributes.name: hand_hygiene_station_count

For PM schedules: captures schedule name, maintenance task template, frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual), estimated labor hours, required trade, regulatory driver (TJC EC.02.04.01, CMS, NFPA 99, NFPA 101, state DOH), risk-based assessment score (AEM/AHJ), last completed date, next due date, and schedule active status. Supports biomedical engineering PM compliance rates, facilities management KPIs, and regulatory audit evidence.

products.name: icd_code
products.description: Authoritative master catalog of ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and ICD-10-PCS procedure codes as published by WHO and maintained by CMS. Each record captures the full code, short and long descriptions, code category, chapter, validity dates, billable flag, and hierarchical parent code. Consumed by clinical documentation, billing, claims, and quality domains for diagnosis and procedure coding.
products.reference: ICD-10-CM / ICD-10-PCS (CMS, WHO)

attributes.name: icd_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: ICD (International Classification of Diseases) Code ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ICD code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: code_set_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reference.code_set_version.
